entry.defn: pronoun 1 I; me 2 we; us 敵退我追。 dí tuì wǒ zhuī. We pursue the enemy if they retreat. 3 my; our 我方 wǒfāng our side; we 我國 wǒguó our country 我家 wǒjiā my family; my home 我軍 wǒjūn our army 4 [with 你 in parallel structures] one; anyone 大家你幫我, 我幫你, 很快就把活兒幹完了。 Dàjiā nǐ bāng wǒ, wǒ bāng nǐ, hěn kuài jiù bǎ huór gàn wán le. Everyone pitched in and the job was soon done. 5 self 忘我 wàngwǒ oblivious of oneself 自我 zìwǒ self; oneself

pronoun 1 you [second person singular] 你爸 nǐ bà your Dad 你帶了多少錢？ Nǐ dài le duōshao qián？ How much money do you have on you? 2 you [second person plural] 你方 nǐ fāng your side; you 你校 nǐ xiào your school 3 [referring to any person] you; one; anyone 碰到這麼一個人, 你有什麼辦法？ Pèngdào zhème yī ge rén, nǐ yǒu shénme bànfǎ？ What can you do with a person like that? 4 [with 我 or 他 in parallel structures to indicate several or many people behaving the same way] 三個人你看看我, 我看看你, 誰也不說話。 Sān ge rén nǐ kànkan wǒ, wǒ kàn kàn nǐ, shuí yě bù shuōhuà. The three of them kept looking at each other without saying a word. 你一言, 我一語, 大家談得很熱鬧。 Nǐ yī yán, wǒ yī yǔ, dàjiā tán de hěn rènao. A lively conversation ensued with everybody joining in.

pronoun 1 he; him; his 他哥 tā gē his elder brother 他倆 tāliǎ the two of them; both 他老婆 tā lǎopo his wife 他家在農村。 Tā jiā zài nóngcūn. His home is in the countryside. 他家是新搬來的。 Tā jiā shì xīn bān lái de. He and his family moved here recently. 他剛纔給你送票來了。 Tā gāng cái gěi nǐ sòng piào lái le. He came just now with a ticket for you. 誰沒有票, 問他要。 Shuí méi yǒu piào, wèn tā yào. Anyone without a ticket can ask him for one. 2 [for either sex when it is either unknown or unimportant] 從遠處看不出他是男是女。 cóng yuǎnchù kànbuchū tā shì nán shì nǚ. I can’t tell if it’s a man or a woman from a distance. 每個孩子都講了他學習(雷鋒)的收穫。 Měi ge háizi dōu jiǎng le tā xuéxí Léi Fēng de shōuhuò. Each child described what he or she had learnt (from Lei Feng). 3 [before or after a person's name for emphasis] 老王他也提前到了。 Lǎo wáng tā yě tíqián dào le. Lao Wang also came early. 這事兒成與不成就看他老張了。 Zhè shìr chéng yǔ bù chéng jiù kàn tā lǎo zhāng le. The success or failure of this all depends on Lao Zhang alone. 4 [used as a meaningless object, for emphasis or in fun] 好好睡他一覺 Hǎohāo shuì tā yī jiào have a good sleep 咱們喝他幾杯去。 Zánmen hē tā jǐ bēi qù. Let’s go and have a few drinks. 你寫他兩三本書, 就出名了。 Nǐ xiě tā liǎng sān běn shū, jiù chūmíng le. If you can publish a couple of books, you’ll become famous. 5 usually literary other; another; some other 別無他求 Bié wú tā qiú have no other request 留作他用 liú zuò tāyòng keep for other uses 此人早已他去。 Cǐ rén zǎoyǐ tā qù. He has long since left. noun (Tā) a surname
pronoun we; us

pronoun 1 you [second person plural] 你們幹護士工作的真是夠辛苦的。 nǐmen gàn hùshi gōngzuò de zhēnshì gòu xīnkǔ de. You nurses are really working very hard. 這就是你們的責任所在。 Zhè jiùshì nǐmen de zérèn suǒzài. This is where your responsibility lies. 2 colloquial [in the same way as 你 1 2] 你們奶奶多大歲數了？ Nǐmen nǎinai duō dà suìshu le？ How old is your grandmother? 你們組最近情況怎麼樣？ Nǐmen zǔ zuìjìn qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng？ How is your group getting along these days?
noun this year

noun 1 this day; today 今天上午 jīntiān shàngwǔ this morning 今天下午 jīntiān xiàwǔ this afternoon 一年前的今天 yī nián qián de jīntiān a year ago today 今天是星期天。 Jīntiān shì Xīngqītiān. Today is Sunday. 我今天有客人來。 Wǒ jīntiān yǒu kèren lái. I’m expecting company today. 2 the present time or age; today 今天的青年有不同的道德觀念。 Jīntiān de qīngnián yǒu bùtóng de dàodé guānniàn. Young people today (or of today) have different moral values.
noun 1 tomorrow 2 near future 光輝燦爛的明天 Guānghuīcànlàn de míngtiān bright future
noun yesterday

(shuí) pronoun 1 who 他是誰？ Tā shì shéi？ Who is he? 他在跟誰說話？ Tā zài gēn shéi shuōhuà？ Who is he talking to? 這是誰的意見？ Zhè shì shéi de yìjian？ Whose idea is this? 2 [in rhetorical questions] who 誰不說他好？ Shéi bù shuō tā hǎo？ Who wouldn’t speak well of him? 誰言寸草心, 報得三春暉。(孟郊《遊子吟》) Shéi yán cùncǎo xīn, bào de sānchūn huī. Such kindness of warm sun, can’t be repaid by grass. 3 someone; anyone 你要找誰嗎？ Nǐ yào zhǎo shéi ma？ Are you looking for someone? 我沒跟誰說話。 Wǒ méi gēn shéi shuōhuà. I didn’t talk to anyone. 有誰能幫助我就好了。 Yǒu shéi néng bāngzhù wǒ jiù hǎo le. If only someone would help me! 4 [before 都 or 也] everyone; anyone 誰也不要。 Shéi yě bùyào. Nobody wants it. 誰都喜歡他。 Shéi dōu xǐhuan tā. Everybody likes him. 5 [repeated in two phrases] whoever 誰污染誰治理的原則 shéi wūrǎn shéi zhìlǐ de yuánzé principle of keeping pollution controlled by whoever making it 誰先到, 誰先吃。 Shéi xiān dào, Shéi xiān chī. Whoever arrives first will eat first. 大家看誰合適就選誰。 Dàjiā kàn shéi héshì jiù xuǎn shéi. You may elect whoever you think is suitable. 6 [as both subject and object to indicate two different people] 他們倆誰也說不服誰。 Tāmen liǎ shéi yě shuō bù fú shéi. Neither of them could convince the other.
noun surname and personal name; full name

noun 1 name; given name 您叫什麼名字？ Nín jiào shénme míngzi？ What’s your name? or May I know your name? 2 name (of a thing) 這種花的名字很特別。 Zhèzhǒng huā de míngzi hěn tèbié. This flower has a strange name. 3 dated linguistics noun

noun 1 human being; person; people 活人 huórén living person 人對自然界的認識 Rén duì zìránjiè de rènshi man’s knowledge of nature 團結得像一個人 tuánjié de xiàng yī ge rén (of many people) be united as one 來人了。 lái rén le. Someone has come. or There come some people. 他家有幾口人？ Tā jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén？ How many people are there in his family? 屋裡有人嗎？ Wū lǐ yǒurén ma？ Is there anyone inside? 2 adult human being 長大成人 zhǎngdà chéngrén grow up into an adult; be grown to manhood 3 other people; other(s) 他待人誠懇。 Tā dàirén chéngkěn. He’s sincere in his dealings with people. 這個座位有人嗎？ Zhè ge zuòwèi yǒurén ma？ Is this seat occupied? 自己做錯了事, 不應該怪人。 Zìjǐ zuò cuò liǎoshì, bù yīnggāi guàirén. When one has done something wrong one should not blame it on others. 4 [used rhetorically in place of the first personal pronoun, often expressing displeasure] 別小看人！ Bié xiǎokàn rén! Don’t look down on me! 真叫人著急。 Zhēn jiào rén zháojí. It really worries me. 5 person considered as a worker or employee; hand; manpower 人來了嗎？ rén lái le ma? Have they come? 我們這裡正缺人。 Wǒmen zhèlǐ zhèng quē rén. We are short-handed at the moment. 6 physical, psychological, or moral quality or condition of a given individual; personality 他人很好。 Tā rén hěn hǎo. He’s a very nice man. 這兩天我人不太舒服。 Zhè liǎng tiān wǒ rén bù tài shūfu. I haven’t been feeling very well lately. 他人在那兒, 心卻想著別的事。 Tā rén zài nàr, xīn què xiǎngzhe bié de shì. He was there all right, but his mind was elsewhere. 7 everybody; each 人各有所喜。 rén gè yǒusuǒ xǐ. Everyone has his liking. 8 [as a suffix] person of certain places, jobs or properties; person engaging in certain activity 四川人 Sìchuān rén native of Sichuan 文化人 wénhuàrén man of letters; intellectual 音樂人 yīnyuèrén musician; person engaging in music 他是你什麼人？ Tā shì nǐ shénmerén? What is your relation with him? 9 real person; true man; man of integrity 是人就得說人話。 Shì rén jiùděi shuō rén huà. A real man should talk like a real man. 這是人做的事嗎？ Zhè shì rén zuò de shì ma? Can this be the behaviour of a true man?
noun (early) morning 早上好。 Zǎoshang hǎo. Good morning.
noun morning; forenoon (opp. 下午)
noun noon; midday
noun afternoon (opp. 上午) 下午見！ Xiàwǔ jiàn! See you this afternoon! 下午有場電影。 Xiàwǔ yǒu chǎng diànyǐng. There’s a movie this afternoon.
noun (in the) evening; (at) night 晚上好。 Wǎnshang hǎo. Good evening.

noun 1 country; nation; state 大國 dàguó a big country 強國 qiángguó a powerful nation 諸侯國 zhūhóu guó feudal states 保家衛國 bǎojiāwèiguó protect our homes and defend our country 利國利民 lìguólìmín benefit both country and people; good for the country and for the people 2 best of the nation See 22188288國手guo2shou3國手;22186496國色guo2se4國色 3 abbreviation Kuomintang (KMT) 國共兩黨 Guó Gòngliǎngdǎng KMT and CPC 4 (Guó) a surname adjective 1 of the state; national See 22161408國花guo2hua1國花 2 of our country; Chinese See 22161664國畫guo2hua4國畫

noun China 中國大陸 Zhōngguó dàlù Chinese mainland; mainland of China 中國畫 Zhōngguóhuà traditional Chinese painting 中國話 Zhōngguóhuà Chinese (language) 中國結 zhōngguójié traditional Chinese knot 中國熱 Zhōngguórè Sinomania (great interest in Chinese culture) 中國人 Zhōngguórén Chinese 中國網 Zhōngguó wǎng Chinaweb 中國學 zhōngguóxué Sinology 中國字 zhōngguózì Chinese characters; Chinese writing 中國餐館 Zhōngguó cānguǎn Chinese restaurant 中國象棋 Zhōngguó xiàngqí Xiangqi; Chinese chess 中國猿人 Zhōngguó yuánrén Peking Man 中國概念股 Zhōngguó gàiniàn gǔ “China Concept” shares (sold on the Hong Kong stock market by a large Hong Kong firm whose business is based in China) 中國工程院 Zhōngguó Gōngchéngyuàn Chinese Academy of Engineering 中國共產黨 Zhōngguó Gòngchǎndǎng Communist Party of China (CPC); the Chinese Communist Party 中國科學院 Zhōngguó Kēxuéyuàn Chinese Academy of Sciences 中國同盟會 Zhōngguó Tóngménghuì United League of China (1905-1912, predecessor of the Kuomintang 國民黨) 中國證監會 Zhōngguó Zhèngjiànhuì China Securities Regulatory Commission 中國工農紅軍 Zhōngguó Gōng-Nóng Hóngjūn Chinese Workers’and Peasants’ Red Army (1928-1937); the Red Army 中國人民解放軍 Zhōngguó Rénmín Jiěfàngjūn Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) 中國人民志願軍 Zhōngguórénmínzhìyuànjūn Chinese People’s Volunteers 中國社會科學院 Zhōngguó Shèhuì Kēxuéyuàn Chinese Academy of Social Sciences 中國新經濟峰會 Zhōngguó xīn jīngjì fēnghuì China New Economy Summit 中國移動互聯網 Zhōngguó yídòng hùliánwǎng China Mobile Net; CM Net 中國工農民主政府 Zhōngguó Gōng-Nóng Mínzhǔ Zhèngfǔ Chinese Workers’ and Peasants’ Democratic Government (in the revolutionary base areas during the Second Revolutionary Civil War, 1927-1937) 中國出口商品交易會 Zhōngguó chūkǒu shāngpǐn jiāoyìhuì China Export Commodities Fair (Guangzhou Fair) 中國共產主義青年團 Zhōngguó Gòngchǎnzhǔyì Qīngniántuán Communist Youth League of China 中國人民政治協商會議 Zhōngguó Rénmín Zhèngzhì Xiéshāng Huìyì Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC)
noun the United States of America (USA); the United States; America 美國國會 Měiguó Guóhuì the US Congress
Japan

noun 1 family; household 張家和王家 Zhāng jiā hé wáng jiā the Zhangs and the Wangs 他全家都是工人。 Tā quánjiā dōu shì gōngrén. They’re all workers in his family. 小區裡家家都愛養花。 Xiǎoqū lǐ jiājiā dōu ài yǎnghuā. In this neighbourhood, every family loves growing flowers. 2 home 回家 huíjiā go home 不在家 bù zàijiā not be in; be out 上我家去吧。 Shàng wǒ jiā qù ba. Come to my place. 3 person or family engaged in a certain trade 船家 chuánjiā boatman 4 specialist in a certain field 畫家 huàjiā painter 科學家 kēxuéjiā scientist 5 school of thought 儒家 Rújiā Confucian school 6 self-deprecating my [in speaking of relatives older than oneself] See 23637248家父jia1fu4家父 7 (in playing cards, mah-jong, etc.) party; side See 59564771對家dui4jia1對家;29587456上家shang4jia1上家;36692480莊家zhuang1jia5莊家 adjective domestic; tamed (opp. 野) 家兔 jiātù rabbit measure word [for families or business establishments] 兩家人家 Liǎng jiā rénjia two families 三家商店 sān jiā shāngdiàn three shops 一家電影院 yī jiā diànyǐngyuàn a cinema

noun 1 telephone; phone 請別把電話掛上。 Qǐng bié bǎ diànhuà guà shàng. Hold the line, please. 他把電話掛了。 Tā bǎ diànhuà guà le. He hung up. 2 phone call 打電話 dǎ diànhuà make a phone call; phone sb.; call (or ring) sb.; give sb. a ring 他正在打電話。 Tā zhèngzài dǎ diànhuà. He’s on the phone. 有你的電話。 Yǒu nǐ de diànhuà. There’s a call for you. or You’re wanted on the phone.

noun 1 (the concept of) time 時間與空間 Shíjiān yǔ kōngjiān time and space 時間就是金錢。 shíjiān jiùshì jīnqián. Time is money. 時間過得真快呀, 不知不覺三年過去了。 shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài ya, bùzhībùjué sān nián guòqule. Where has the time gone! Three years have slipped by unnoticed. 2 (the duration of) time 時間掌握得好 shíjiān zhǎngwò de hǎo good timing; well-timed 費時間 fèi shíjiān time-consuming 辦公時間 bàngōng shíjiān office hours 不給對手喘息的時間 bù gěi duìshǒu chuǎnxī de shíjiān give one’s opponent no breathing space 時間到了。 Shíjiān dào le. Time’s up. 時間緊, 任務重。 shíjiān jǐn, rènwu zhòng. Time is pressing and the task heavy. 你做這事用了多少時間？ Nǐ zuò zhè shì yòng le duōshaoshíjiān? How much time did you spend on this? 3 (a point in) time 北京時間十九點整 Běijīng shíjiān shíjiǔ diǎn zhěng 19 hours Beijing Time 現在的時間是四點(零)五分。 Xiànzài deshíjiān shì sì diǎn wǔfēn. The time now is five minutes past four.
noun hour 按小時計費 àn xiǎoshí jìfèi pay by the hour
noun now; at present; today
noun Taiwan

noun 1 (the duration of) time 農忙的時候 nóngmáng de shíhou busy farming season 戰爭的時候 Zhànzhēng deshíhou during the war 2 (a point in) time; moment 就在這時候 jiù zài zhèshí hou just at this moment 時候不早了。 shíhou bù zǎo le. It’s getting late. 到時候我來叫你。 Dào shíhou wǒ lái jiào nǐ. I’ll call you when it’s time. 現在是什麼時候了？ Xiànzài shì shénme shíhou le？ What time is it?

number hundred 百花盛開 Bǎihuā shèngkāi a hundred flowers in bloom; luxuriant 幾百本書 jǐ bǎi běn shū several hundred books 數以百計的聽眾 shùyǐbǎijì de tīngzhòng hundreds of listeners adjective numerous; all kinds of 百忙之中 bǎi máng zhīzhōng in the midst of pressing affairs; despite many claims on one’s time 百吃不厭 bǎi chī bù yàn never tire of eating sth.

adverb 1 still; yet 廢物還是可以利用的。 Fèiwù háishi kěyǐ lìyòng de. Waste materials can still be made use of. 這次還是他做我們的向導。 Zhècì háishi tā zuò wǒmen de xiàngdǎo. He is still our guide for this trip. 儘管旱情嚴重, 今年的小麥還是豐收了。 Jǐnguǎn hànqíng yánzhòng, jīnnián de xiǎomài háishi fēngshōu le. Despite the serious drought, the wheat harvest this year was good. 2 [expressing a preference for an alternative] 還是坐飛機快。 Hái shi zuò fēijī kuài. It’s much faster to travel by air after all. 還是你來吧, 我在家等你。 Hái shi nǐ lái ba, wǒ zài jiā děng nǐ. It would be better for you to come; I’ll be at home waiting for you. 天冷了, 你還是多穿點兒吧。 Tiān lěng le, nǐ hái shi duō chuān diǎnr ba. It’s getting cold, you’d better put on more clothes. 3 [expressing realization or discovery] 還是厲害的人有辦法。 háishi lìhai de rén yǒu bànfǎ. It’s the pushing type that gets on. 這個人還是真了不起。 Zhège rén hái shi zhēn liǎobuqǐ. This chap is really great. conjunction 1 or 你去, 還是他去？ Nǐ qù, háishi tā qù? Are you going or is he? 先去上海還是先去西安還沒有定。 Xiān qù Shànghǎi háishi xiān qù Xī'ān hái méiyǒu dìng. We haven’t decided yet whether we go to Shanghai or Xi’an first. 2 no matter what; whether...or...; regardless of 不管颳風還是下雨, 他天天準時到校。 Bùguǎn guāfēng háishi xiàyǔ, tā tiāntiān zhǔnshí dào xiào. He goes to school on time every day no matter whether it rains or blows. 無論唱歌還是跳舞, 她都行。 Wúlùn chànggē háishi tiàowǔ, tā dōu xíng. Singing or dancing, she is good at both.

auxiliary 1 [after a verb or an adjective to indicate the completion of an action, at a point in the past or before the beginning of another action, or an expected or presumed action] 把書讀了兩遍 bǎ shū dú le liǎng biàn have read the book twice 我下了班就去。 wǒ xià le bān jiù qù. I’ll go right after work. 水位低了兩米。 Shuǐwèi dī le liǎng mǐ. The water level fell by two metres. 2 [at the end of a sentence, usu. after 了 for completed action, to indicate that sth. has taken place] 小說看了一半了。 Xiǎoshuō kàn le yībàn le. I have read half of the novel. 我等了半天了。 Wǒděng le bàntiān le. I’ve been waiting a long time. 3 [at the end of a sentence to indicate a change of situation or state, whether actual or envisaged] 他胖了。 Tā pàng le. He’s put on weight. 下雨了。 Xiàyǔ le. It’s raining. 東西貴了。 Dōngxi guì le. Things have gone up. or Things are expensive now. 樹葉紅了。 Shùyè hóng le. The leaves are turning red. 今天去不成了。 Jīntiān qù bù chéng le. We can’t go today. (Before the situation changed, we had thought we could go.) 你早來一天就見著他了。 Nǐ zǎo lái yī tiān jiù jiàn zhe tā le. If you’d come a day sooner you would have seen him. 我喝了五杯了, 不能再喝了。 Wǒ hē le wǔ bēi le, bùnéng zài hē le. I have drunk five glasses and can’t drink any more. 4 [after an adjective, with or without 太 “too”, to express an excessive degree, i.e. to indicate that sth. has gone to the extreme] 湯鹹了。 Tāng xián le. The soup is too salty. 袖子長了。 Xiùzi cháng le. The sleeves are too long. 這種工作太累了。 Zhèzhǒng gōngzuò tài lèi le. This job is too fatiguing. 他現在太老了, 不能工作了。 Tā xiànzài tài lǎo le, bù néng gōngzuò le. He’s too old to work now. 5 [in commands or requests in response to a changed situation] 吃飯了！ Chīfàn le! Let’s eat now. 別說話了！ Bié shuōhuà le! Stop talking! 走了, 不能再等了！ Zǒu le, bùnéng zài děng le! Let’s go. We can’t wait any longer.

verb colloquial 1 need 這項工程得三個月才能完。 Zhè xiàng gōngchéng děi sān ge yuè cáinéng wán. This project will take three months to complete. 2 must; have to 有錯誤就得批評。 Yǒu cuòwù jiù děi pīpíng. Whoever makes a mistake must be criticized. 3 certainly will 要不快走, 我們就得遲到了。 Yào bù kuài zǒu, wǒmen jiù děi chídào le. We’ll be late if we don’t hurry.

verb 1 cross; pass 過河 guòhé cross a river 爬雪山, 過草地 pá xuěshān, guò cǎodì climb snow-topped mountains and cross the grasslands 遊行隊伍要從我們街區過。 yóuxíng duìwu yào cóng wǒmen jiēqū guò. The parade will pass through our neighbourhood. 2 spend (time); pass (time) 過生日 guò shēngri celebrate one’s birthday 春節在工地上過 Chūnjié zài gōngdì shàng guò spend the Spring Festival at the construction site 假期過得怎樣？ Jiàqī guò de zěnyàng？ How did you spend your holiday? 日子越來越好過了。 Rìzi yuèláiyuè hǎo guò le. Life is getting better and better. 3 transfer; move to 你的工資已過到賬上。 nǐ de gōngzī yǐ guò dào zhàng shàng. Your salary has been transferred to your account. 4 go through; undergo (a process) See 22212864過秤guo4cheng4過秤 5 review; go over 咱們把稿子再過一遍。 Zánmen bǎ gǎozi zài guò yī biàn. Let’s go over the draft once again. 6 go beyond; after (a certain point of time) 我過兩天再來。 Wǒ guò liǎng tiān zài lái. I’ll come again in a couple of days. 過了夏至, 天就開始變短。 Guò le Xiàzhì, tiān jiù kāishǐ biàn duǎn. The days get shorter after the Summer Solstice. 過了好幾個月我才收到他的信。 Guò le hǎojǐ ge yuè wǒ cái shōudào tā de xìn. Several months passed before I heard from him. 7 exceed; go beyond 雪深過膝。 Xuě shēn guò xī. The snow is more than knee-deep. 畝產過千斤。 Mǔchǎn guò qiān jīn. The yield is over 1,000 jin per mu. 樹長得過了房。 Shù zhǎng de guò le fáng. The tree has grown taller than the house. 小心別坐過了站。 Xiǎoxīn bié zuò guò le zhàn. Make sure you don’t go past your station. 8 visit See 22216192過訪guo4fang3過訪 9 euphemistic pass away; die 老太太過了好幾天了。 Lǎotàitaiguò le hǎojǐtiān le. The old woman died several days ago. noun fault; mistake (opp. 功) See 22213376過錯guo4cuo4過錯 adverb 1 excessively; over 過長 guò cháng too long; unduly long 過早 guòzǎo too early; premature 雨水過多 Yǔshuǐ guò duō excessive rainfall; too much rain 2 physics chemistry per-; super-; over- 過熔 guò róng superfusion See 61551843過氧化物guo4yang3hua4wu4過氧化物 3 [after a verb plus 得 or 不 to indicate winning or deserving] 要說跑, 咱們誰也比不過他。 Yào shuō pǎo, zánmen shuí yě bǐ bù guò tā. None of us runs as fast as he. 這樣的大學生, 我們信得過。 Zhèyàng de dàxuéshēng, wǒmen xìndeguò. We have confidence in college students like this sort.

verb 1 request; ask 請人來修機器 Qǐng rén lái xiū jīqì get sb. to repair the machine; get the machine repaired 請他進來。 Qǐng tā jìnlai. Ask him in. 請你多加指導。 Qǐng nǐ duō jiā zhǐdǎo. It is hoped you will give us guidance. 2 invite; engage 請醫生 qǐng yīshēng send for a doctor 請總工程師來講課 qǐng zǒnggōngchéngshī lái jiǎngkè invite the chief engineer to give a lecture 3 courteous please 請坐。 Qǐngzuò. Won’t you sit down? or Please be seated. 請安靜。 Qǐng ānjìng. Be quiet, please. 請速回信。 Qǐngsùhuíxìn. Please reply as soon as possible. 4 dated buy holy sacrificial things, such as joss sticks, candles, paper horses and Buddha shrines

auxiliary classical 1 [at the end of a sentence, indicating an explanation or a judgment] 陳勝者, 陽城人也。(《史記》) Chén shèng zhě, yáng chéng rén yě. Chen Sheng was a native of Yangcheng. 何其毒也！ Héqídúyě! How pernicious! 2 [at the end of a question or rhetorical question] 何也？ Hé yě？ How is that? or Why so? 是可忍, 孰不可忍也？ Shì kě rěn, shú bùkě rěn yě? If this can be tolerated, what cannot? 3 [in the middle of a sentence, marking off a sentence element about which there is to be a statement] 大道之行也, 天下為公。(《禮記》) Dàdào zhī xíng yě, tiānxiàwéigōng. (《Lǐjì》) When the Great Tao prevailed, the whole world was one community. adverb 1 also; too; as well; either 你不去, 我也不去。 Nǐ bù qù, wǒ yě bù qù. If you’re not going, I’m not going either. 我妹妹也是售貨員。 Wǒ mèimei yě shì shòuhuòyuán. My sister is a shop assistant too. 中國是一個社會主義國家, 也是一個發展中國家。 Zhōngguó shì yī ge shèhuìzhǔyì guójiā, yě shì yī ge fāzhǎnzhōng guójiā. China is a socialist country, and a developing country as well. 2 [for emphasis, often before a negative expression] 她一天假也沒請過。 Tā yī tiān jià yě méi qǐng guò. She has never asked for leave, not even for a day. 他忙得連飯也顧不上吃。 Tā máng de lián fàn yě gù bù shàng chī. He is so busy that he can’t even stop for a meal. 3 [used correlatively with 雖然, 即使, etc.] still; yet 你不說我也知道。 Nǐ bù shuō wǒ yě zhīdao. You don’t have to tell me. I know already. 我雖然沒見過, 也聽人說過。 Wǒ suīrán méi jiàn guò, yě tīng rén shuō guò. I’ve heard about it, though I have never seen it. 我怎麼想也想不起來。 Wǒ zěnme xiǎng yě xiǎng bù qǐlai. I simply couldn’t recall it however hard I tried. 4 [in a hesitant or guarded statement] 也只好這樣了。 Yě zhǐhǎo zhèyàng le. We’ll have to leave it at that. 他的英語也還可以。 Tā de Yīngyǔ yě hái kěyǐ. His English is passable. 這袋土豆也就一百公斤。 Zhè dài tǔdòu yě jiù yībǎi gōngjīn. This sack of potatoes weighs a hundred kilos at most.

verb 1 not have; be without 沒有矛盾, 就沒有世界。 Méiyǒu máodùn, jiù méiyou shìjiè. Without contradictions nothing would exist. 我沒有多餘的錄音帶。 Wǒ méiyou duōyú de lùyīndài. I don’t have cassettes to spare. 2 there is not 屋裡沒有人。 Wū lǐ méiyou rén. There is no one in the room. 3 [before 誰 or 哪個 to mean “nobody”] 沒有哪個說過這樣的話。 méiyou nǎge shuō guò zhèyàng de huà. No one ever said that. 4 not be as...as 誰都跑得沒有他快。 Shuí dōu pǎo de méiyou tā kuài. No one runs as fast as he. 5 [before numerals] less than; not more than 他來了還沒有三天就走了。 Tā lái le hái méiyou sān tiān jiù zǒu le. He was here less than three days. 這間屋子沒有十平方米。 Zhè jiān wūzi méiyou shí píngfāngmǐ. This room is not more than 10 square metres. adverb 1 [before a verb to deny the occurrence or accomplishment of action] 昨天沒有下雨。 zuótiān méiyou xiàyǔ. It didn’t rain yesterday. 2 [before an adjective to deny condition] not yet 衣服還沒有幹。 Yīfu hái méiyou gān. The clothes aren’t dry yet. 3 [at the end of a sentence to indicate objective question] 去了沒有？ Qùleméiyou? Did you go there? 4 [in an interrogative sentence to express suspicion or surprise] 你沒有聽到這個消息(嗎)？ Nǐ méiyou tīngdào zhège xiāoxi? You didn’t hear the news? 5 [answering questions] 你看見他了沒有？——沒有。 Nǐ kànjian tā le méiyou？ —— méiyou. Did you see him? — No, I didn’t.

verb 1 have; possess; own 有辦法 yǒubànfǎ be resourceful; have a way 有背景 yǒu bèijǐng have powerful connections 有奔頭 yǒu bèntóu have a bright prospect 有出息 yǒu chūxī be promising 有版權的作品 yǒu bǎnquán de zuòpǐn work in private domain 有百利而無一弊 Yǒu bǎi lì ér wú yī bì have every advantage and no drawback 有兒才知父母恩。 yǒu r cái zhī fùmǔ ēn. Only when one has children does he know what parental love is. 她有熱情, 有朝氣。 Tā yǒu rèqíng, yǒu zhāoqì. She is full of vigour and enthusiasm. 2 there is; exist; contain 有必要 yǒu bìyào oblige; be necessary 有電話找你。 yǒu diànhuà zhǎo nǐ. A phone call for you. 有飯大家吃。 yǒu fàn dàjiā chī. If there is food, let everyone share it. 屋裡有人嗎？ Wū lǐ yǒurén ma？ Anybody in the room? 這座位有人嗎？ Zhè zuò wèi yǒu rén ma？ Is this seat taken? 還有許多工作要做。 Háiyǒu xǔduō gōngzuò yào zuò. Much still remains to be done. 3 [making an estimate or a comparison] 他有十歲了吧？ Tā yǒu shí suì le ba？ He is about ten, I guess. 問題有那麼嚴重嗎？ Wèntí yǒu nàme yánzhòng ma？ Is the problem that serious? 我不知道魚還有那麼貴。 Wǒ bù zhīdao yú háiyǒu nàme guì. I didn’t know fish was that expensive. 4 [indicating action] 有很大進步 yǒu hěn dà jìnbù make great progress 一有問題就去解決 yī yǒu wèntí jiù qù jiějué deal with a problem as soon as it crops up 有消息就通知我。 yǒu xiāoxi jiù tōngzhī wǒ. Keep me informed. 形勢有了新發展。 Xíngshì yǒu le xīn fāzhǎn. There are new developments in the situation. 5 [denoting condition or concession] 有水便有魚。 yǒu shuǐ biànyǒu yú. If there’s water, there must be fish. 6 [expressing the idea of having plenty of or lasting a long period] 有本事 yǒu běnshi be capable 有經驗 yǒu jīngyàn be experienced 有學問 yǒuxuéwèn be well-learned; be a scholar 有了年紀 yǒu le niánjì be getting on in years 她結婚可有些年頭了。 Tā jiéhūn kě yǒu xiē niántóu le. She has married for years. 7 [expressing an indefinite reference] 有保留 yǒu bǎoliú with a hook at the end 有時候 yǒushíhou sometimes 有人說可以, 有人說不可以。 Yǒurén shuō kěyǐ, yǒurén shuō bù kěyǐ. Some say yes, some say no. 有些事還需要商量。 Yǒuxiē shì hái xūyào shāngliang. Certain things are still open to discussion. 有一天我在街上碰見他了。 Yǒu yī tiān wǒ zài jiēshang pèngjiàn tā le. One day I ran into him in the street. 這個措施有地方適用, 有地方不適用。 Zhège cuòshī yǒu dìfang shìyòng, yǒu dìfang bù shìyòng. This measure is suited to some localities, but not to others. 8 [after certain monosyllabic verbs to form single words] 這家伙懷有不可告人的目的。 Zhè jiāhuo huáiyǒu bùkěgàorén de mùdì. That fellow has an underhand scheme. 這種水果含有多種維生素。 Zhèzhǒng shuǐguǒ hányǒu duōzhǒng wéishēngsù. This fruit contains vitamins. 9 [expressing politeness] See 35079936有勞you3lao2有勞;35090944有請you3qing3有請 10 [answering a roll call] here; present “王鋼！”“有！” “wáng gāng!” “yǒu!” “Wang Gang!” “Present!” auxiliary dialect have 我有去過那裡。 Wǒ yǒu qù guò nàli. I have been there. affix literary [before the names of certain dynasties] 有夏 Yǒuxià the Xia Dynasty 有宋一代 yǒu Sòng yīdài the Song period 詩至有唐為極盛。 Shī zhì yǒu táng wéi jí chéng. During the Tang period poetry attained the acme of its development.

verb 1 think; ponder; consider 想辦法 xiǎng bànfǎ think of a way; seek a solution (or a way out) 想問題 xiǎng wèntí think over a problem 讓我想一想。 Ràng wǒ xiǎng yī xiǎng. Let me think it over. or Let me see. 你想得真周到。 Nǐ xiǎng de zhēn zhōudao. You have really thought of everything. 你想清楚了沒有？ Nǐ xiǎng qīngchu le méiyǒu？ Have you thought it out (or through)? 我們也要想想困難。 Wǒmen yě yào xiǎngxiǎng kùnnan. We must also anticipate difficulties. 我在想下一步棋該怎麼走。 Wǒ zài xiǎng xià yī bù qí gāi zěnme zǒu. I’m considering my next (chess) move. 2 think back; try to remember; recall; recollect 回想往事 huí xiǎng wǎngshì recall the past 你好好想想鑰匙擱哪兒了。 Nǐ hǎohāo xiǎngxiǎng yàoshi gē nǎr le. Think back carefully where you could have put the key. 3 suppose; reckon; consider; think 我想不至於吧。 Wǒ xiǎng bùzhìyú ba. I don’t believe things could get that bad. or Surely as bad as that! 我想我該走了。 Wǒ xiǎng wǒ gāi zǒu le. I’m afraid I must be going now. 你想他能買到票嗎？ Nǐ xiǎng tā néng mǎi dào piào ma？ Do you suppose he can get the tickets? 我想他今天不會來。 Wǒ xiǎng tā jīntiān bù huì lái. I don’t think he’ll come today. 4 want to; wish to; feel like (doing sth.) 我也想試試。 Wǒ yě xiǎng shìshi. I’d like to try too. 他很想上大學。 Tā hěn xiǎng shàng dàxué. He longs to go to college. 你想看足球賽嗎？ Nǐ xiǎng kàn zúqiúsài ma？ Do you want to see (or feel like seeing) a football match? 她不想跟我們去。 Tā bù xiǎng gēn wǒmen qù. She doesn’t wish to come with us. 5 remember with longing; miss 你走了以後, 我們都很想你。 Nǐ zǒu le yǐhòu, wǒmen dōu hěn xiǎng nǐ. After you left, we all missed you. 王大娘想女兒都想病了。 Wáng dàniáng xiǎng nǚ'ér dōu xiǎng bìng le. Auntie Wang misses her daughter so much she’s fallen ill.

number 1 how many 幾點了？ Jǐ diǎn le？ What’s the time? or What time is it? 你幾號？ Nǐ jǐ hào？ What’s your number? 四乘六等於幾？ Sì chéng liù děngyú jǐ？ What’s four times six? 2 a few; several; some 幾十 jǐshí tens; dozens; scores 幾萬萬 jǐ wàn wàn several hundred million; hundreds of millions 說幾句話 shuō jǐ jù huà say a few words 有幾個人 yǒu jǐ gèrén some people 二十幾個人 èrshí jǐ ge rén twenty odd people 十幾歲的孩子 shíjǐ suì de háizi teenager 每隔幾分鐘 měigé jǐ fēnzhōng every few minutes 村子很小, 沒有幾戶人家。 Cūnzi hěn xiǎo, méiyǒu jǐ hù rénjia. The village is quite small, with a few households. 來了十幾二十個人。 Lái le shíjǐ èrshí ge rén. About twenty people came. 他過不了幾天就會回來的。 Tā guòbuliǎo jǐ tiān jiù huì huílai de. He’ll be back in a couple of days.

noun 1 piece; lump; chunk 塊煤 kuàiméi lump coal 糖塊兒 Táng kuàir hard candy; fruit drops; lumps of sugar 把肉切成塊兒 bǎ ròu qiē chéng kuàir cut the meat into cubes 2 computing block 塊複製 kuài fùzhì block copy 數據塊 shù jù kuài data block measure word 1 piece; lump 兩塊肥皂 liǎng kuài féizào two cakes of soap 一塊麵包 yī kuài miànbāo a piece (or hunk) of bread 一塊手錶 yī kuài shǒubiǎo a wrist watch 一塊桌布 yī kuài zhuōbù a table cloth 2 colloquial [for gold or silver dollars, Renminbi, and certain paper money] 三塊錢 sān kuài qián three yuan 塊兒八毛 kuàirbāmáo one yuan or slightly less 兩塊銀洋 liǎng kuài yínyáng two silver dollars 一千塊港幣 yīqiān kuài Gǎngbì 1, 000 1,000 Hong Kong dollars

adverb 1 [before verbs, adjectives, and other adverbs; never before the verb 有] not; won't; not want to 我不會。 Wǒ bù huì. I don’t know how. 我不去。 Wǒ bù qù. I’m not going. or I won’t go. 他不是學生。 Tā bù shì xuésheng. He isn’t a student. 他的病不(很)嚴重。 Tā de bìng bù (hěn) yánzhòng. His illness is not (very) serious. 他昨天不來, 可是今天來了。 Tā zuótiān bù lái, kěshì jīntiān lái le. He didn’t come yesterday, but came today. 2 [before certain nouns to form an adjective] un-; in- 不法 bùfǎ illegal; lawless 不軌 bùguǐ against the law 不道德 bùdàodé immoral 不自在 bùzìzai ill at ease; uncomfortable 3 [used alone or with a particle in responses] not so; no 您再吃一點兒吧。——不了, 謝謝。 Nín zài chī yīdiǎnr ba. —— Bù liǎo, xièxie. How about having some more? —No more, thanks. 他不知道吧？——不, 他知道。 Tā bù zhīdao ba？ —— bù, tā zhīdao. He doesn’t know, does he? —Yes, he does. 他是上海人。——不是吧。 Tā shì Shànghǎi rén. ——bù shìba. He comes from Shanghai. —No, I don’t think so. 他知道嗎？——不, 他不知道。 Tā zhīdao ma？ —— bù, tā bù zhīdao. Does he know? —No, he doesn’t. 4 colloquial [at the end of a sentence to indicate a question] 你要咖啡不？ Nǐ yào kāfēi bù? Some coffee? 他現在身體好不？ Tā xiànzài shēntǐ hǎo bù？ Is he in good health now? 5 [between a verb and its complement] cannot 打不開 dǎbùkāi unable to open 進不去 jìnbùqù cannot go in 拿不動 nábùdòng (find sth.) too heavy to carry 6 [inserted within a reduplication, usu. preceded by 什麼] no matter (how, where, etc.) 什麼難學不難學, 我保證學會。 Shénme nán xué bù nán xué, wǒ bǎozhèng xuéhuì. No matter how hard I’ll learn it. 什麼學歷不學歷, 要有真才實學才行。 Shénme xuélì bù xuélì, yào yǒu zhēncáishíxué cái xíng. Formal schooling is all very well, but what matters is real knowledge and ability. 7 [used correlatively with 就] if not... (then...); either...or 他這會兒不(是)在教室, 就(是)在圖書館。 Tā zhèhuìr bù shì zài jiàoshì, jiùshì zài túshūguǎn. At this time, he’s either in the classroom or in the library. 晚上他不是看書, 就是看報。 Wǎnshang tā bù shì kànshū, jiùshì kànbào. In the evening he either reads a book or a newspaper. 8 [in polite formulas only] don't; needn't 不謝。 bù xiè. Don’t mention it.

verb colloquial 1 not have 沒病 méi bìng in good health; not bad 沒朋友 méi péngyou have no friends 2 there is not; be without 用沒了。 Yòng méi le. It’s all used up. 票賣沒了。 Piào mài méi le. The tickets are all sold out. 這兒沒人。 Zhèr méi rén. There’s nobody here. 鋼筆沒水了。 gāngbǐ méi shuǐ le. The pen has run dry. 3 be not as ... as 我沒你高。 Wǒ méi nǐ gāo. I’m not so tall as you. 誰都沒他會說話。 Shuí dōu méi tā huì shuōhuà. No one is more eloquent than him. 4 less than; not more than 他去了沒多大工夫。 Tā qù le méi duō dà gōngfu. He wasn’t gone for long. adverb colloquial have not; did not 你買了嗎？——沒買。 Nǐ mǎi le ma？ —— méi mǎi. Did you buy it? — No, I didn’t. 銀行昨天沒開門。 Yínháng zuótiān méi kāimén. The bank was closed yesterday.

adverb 1 all 大家都到了嗎？ Dàjiā dōu dào le ma？ Is everybody here? 什麼都行。 Shénme dōu xíng. Anything will do. 我父母都不在了。 Wǒ fùmǔ dōu bù zài le. My parents are both deceased. 2 [with 是 to show the cause] 都是你, 把他灌成這樣。 Dōu shì nǐ, bǎ tā guàn chéng zhèyàng. It’s all your fault making him drunk. 都是你老磨蹭, 害得我們遲到了。 Dōu shì nǐ lǎo móceng, hài de wǒmen chídào le. It is because you dawdled that we were late. 3 even 今天天氣真怪, 中午比早晨都冷。 Jīntiān tiānqì zhēn guài, zhōngwǔ bǐ zǎochen dōu lěng. What strange weather, it’s colder at noon than early in the morning! 連他都不知道。 Lián tā dōu bù zhīdao. Even he doesn’t know. 4 already 他都八十歲了, 身子骨還那麼硬朗。 Tā dōu bāshí suì le, shēnzi gǔ hái nàme yìnglang. He’s already eighty but still going strong.

adverb only; just; merely 只剩一個了。 Zhǐ shèng yī ge le. There is only one left. 我只想問一個問題。 Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng wèn yī ge wèntí. I have just one question. 這只是個時間問題。 Zhè zhǐ shìge shíjiān wèntí. It is merely a question of time. 我們這車只能帶三個人。 Wǒmen zhè chē zhǐ néng dài sān ge rén. We can only take three people in our car. 屋子裡只老王一個人。 Wūzi lǐ zhǐ lǎo wáng yī ge rén. Old Wang was alone in the room. 只那塊地就打了八百斤小麥。 Zhǐ nà kuài dì jiù dǎ le bābǎi jīn xiǎomài. That plot alone yielded 800 jin of wheat.

conjunction but; yet; however 他嘴裡不說, 可是心裡卻想著呢！ tā zuǐlǐ bù shuō, kěshì xīnli què xiǎngzhe ne! He wouldn’t say it, but he sure was thinking it! adverb [for emphasis] 這魚可是新鮮的。 Zhè yú kě shì xīnxiān de. The fish is really fresh. 說話可是要算數的。 Shuōhuà kě shì yào suànshù de. You can never go back on your word.

verb 1 give; grant; present 給某人顏色看 gěi mǒurén yánsè kàn give sb. a lesson; make it hot for sb. 給我一杯水喝。 Gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ hē. Give me a cup of water (to drink). 公司給他一個月的假。 Gōngsī gěi tā yī ge yuè de jià. The company granted him a month’s leave. 杭州給我的印象很好。 Hángzhōu gěi wǒ de yìnxiàng hěn hǎo. Hangzhou left a very good impression on me. 這本書是給你的。 Zhè běn shū shì gěi nǐ de. This book is for you. 我給他一個不理睬。 Wǒ gěi tā yī ge bù lǐcǎi. I just ignored him. 2 let; allow; make 給我看看。 Gěi wǒ kànkan. Let me have a look. 開完運動會, 給我累得夠嗆。 Kāi wán yùndònghuì, gěi wǒ lèi de gòuqiàng. After the sports meet, I was tired out. preposition 1 [after a verb, indicating the handing over of sth.] 交給他一封信 jiāo gěi tā yī fēngxìn hand him a letter 我把鑰匙留給你。 Wǒ bǎ yàoshi liúgěi nǐ. I’ll leave the key with you. 2 for the benefit of; for the sake of; for 給旅客送水倒茶 gěi lǚkè sòng shuǐ dàochá bring drinking water and tea for the passengers 我給你當翻譯。 Wǒ gěi nǐ dāng fānyì. I’ll act as interpreter for you. 3 [introducing the recipient of an action] 他給我道歉了。 Tā gěi wǒ dàoqiàn le. He’s apologized to me. 4 [in passive sentence to introduce what has happened] 衣服給汗水濕透了。 yīfugěi hànshuǐ shītòu le. Clothes were soaked with sweat. auxiliary [before a verb for emphasis] 我差點兒把這事給忘了。 Wǒ chàdiǎnr bǎ zhè shì gěi wàng le. I almost forgot that. 質量不合格給換。 Zhìliàng bù hégé gěi huàn. Substandard products will be exchanged.

adjective 1 expensive; costly; dear (opp. 賤) 我買貴了。 Wǒ mǎi guì le. I paid too much for it. 絲綢比棉布貴。 Sīchóu bǐ miánbù guì. Silk is more expensive than cotton. 2 highly valued; valuable 兵貴精, 不貴多。 Bīng guì jīng, bù guì duō. Troops are valued for their quality, not their number. 3 of high rank; noble (opp. 賤) 貴婦人 guìfùrén a noble lady 4 courteous your 貴國 guìguó your (honourable) country 喜得貴子 xǐ de guì zǐ (gratulate you on) having just got your son 請問(您)貴姓？ qǐngwèn guì xìng? noun VARIANT OF 22431744好處hao3chu5好處 2 gain; profit See 31242496討便宜tao3pian2yi5討便宜;35779328占便宜zhan4pian2yi5占便宜 verb let sb. off lightly; give sb. unmerited advantage 這次便宜了他。 Zhècì piányi le tā. adjective 1 big; large; great (opp. 小) 大城市 dà chéngshì big city 這張照片不夠大。 Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn bù gòu dà. It’s already broad daylight. 2 in a big way; on a big (or large) scale; with all-out efforts; vigorously 大刪大改 Dà shān dà gǎi do a thorough job in revising 3 [before a time word, etc. to show emphasis] 大清早 dàqīngzǎo early in the morning noun dialect 1 father 2 father's brother; uncle

noun 1 little ones; children 一家大小 yī jiā dà xiǎo the whole family, old and young 上有老下有小 shàngyǒulǎoxiàyǒuxiǎo have the old above and the young below—have parents and children to care for 2 dated concubine 討個小 tǎo ge xiǎo take a concubine adjective 1 small; little; petty; minor (opp. 大) 小國 xiǎoguó small country 小河 xiǎohé small river 小事 xiǎoshì small matter 小屋 xiǎowū small room (or house) 小姑娘 xiǎogūniang little girl 小手術 xiǎoshǒushù minor operation 小問題 xiǎo wèntí minor question 風小些了。 Fēng xiǎo xiē le. The wind has dropped a little. 那個數量很小。 Nàge shùliàng hěn xiǎo. That’s a very small amount. 你的聲音太小。 Nǐ de shēngyīn tài xiǎo. Your voice is too soft. 鞋小了點兒。 xié xiǎo le diǎnr. These shoes are a bit too tight. 2 young (opp. 大, 老) 你也不小了。 Nǐ yě bù xiǎo le. You’re not young any more. 她比我小。 Tā bǐ wǒ xiǎo. She is younger than I am. 他還小呢。 Tā hái xiǎo ne. He’s still young. 3 the last in order of seniority; youngest 小兒子 xiǎo'érzi the youngest son 他是我的小弟弟。 Tā shì wǒ dexiǎo dìdi. He is my youngest brother. 4 [before names of animals to indicate the young] 小狗 xiǎo gǒu pup; puppy 小雞 xiǎojī chick 小鹿 xiǎolù deerlet; fawn 小馬 xiǎomǎ pony; foal; colt 小貓 xiǎomāo kitten; kitty 小牛 xiǎoniú calf; heifer 小鴨 xiǎoyā duckling 小羊 xiǎoyáng lamb; kid 小豬 xiǎozhū piggy; piglet; shoat 小老虎 xiǎolǎohǔ tiger cub 5 [before family name, given name, etc.] 小強 xiǎo qiáng Xiao Qiang 小三兒 xiǎo sānr Xiao Sanr (childhood name for one’s third child) 小張 xiǎo zhāng Xiao Zhang 6 self-deprecating my; our 小店 xiǎodiàn my store 小女 xiǎonǚ my daughter adverb of short duration; for a while 小坐片刻 xiǎozuòpiànkè sit for a while

pronoun 1 where 你哪裡不舒服？ Nǐ nǎli bù shūfu？ What is bothering you? or Where do you feel pain? 你到哪裡去？ Nǐ dào nǎli qù？ Where are you going? 你是哪裡人？ Nǐ shì nǎli rén？ Where are you from? 2 wherever; where 哪裡最艱苦就在哪裡幹 nǎli zuì jiānkǔ jiù zài nǎli gàn go where is hardest 哪裡有壓迫, 哪裡就有反抗。 Nǎli yǒu yāpò, nǎli jiù yǒu fǎnkàng. Where there is oppression, there is resistance. 3 [in rhetorical questions to express negation] 我哪裡知道他會改變主意的？ Wǒ nǎli zhīdao tā huì gǎibiàn zhǔyi de？ How was I to know he should change his mind? 4 polite expression [a polite reply to a compliment] 你的英語說得真好。——哪裡, 哪裡。 Nǐ de Yīngyǔ shuō de zhēn hǎo. —— Nǎli, nǎli. You speak very good English. — I’m flattered. 你對我們幫助很大。——哪裡, 哪裡。 Nǐ duì wǒmen bāngzhù hěn dà. —— Nǎli, nǎli. You helped us a lot. — It was nothing.

pronoun that place; there 那裡出產香蕉。 nàlǐ chūchǎn xiāngjiāo. That place produces bananas. 那裡的氣候怎麼樣？ nàlǐ de qìhòu zěnmeyàng？ What’s the weather like there? 我剛從那裡回來。 Wǒ gāng cóng nàlǐ huílai. I’ve just come back from there. or I’ve just been there. 這個星期天, 老張那裡有個聚會。 zhège Xīngqītiān, lǎo zhāng nàlǐ yǒu ge jùhuì. There’ll be a get-together at Lao Zhang’s place this coming Sunday.

verb 1 drive a car, train, etc. 開車的時候精神要集中。 Kāichē de shíhou jīngshén yào jízhōng. You should concentrate when driving. 2 set a machine going verb (of a train, etc.) start 快開車了, 大家上車吧。 Kuài kāichē le, dàjiā shàngchē ba. The bus is about to leave. Hurry up, everybody!

noun 1 copper coin; cash 銅錢 tóngqián copper cash 2 money; wealth 有錢有勢 yǒuqiányǒushì be wealthy and powerful 這個多少錢？ Zhège duōshao qián？ How much is this? 3 fund; sum 買房的錢 mǎi fáng deqián the wherewithal to buy a flat 這筆錢是專為保健事業用的。 Zhè bǐ qián shì zhuān wèi bǎojiàn shìyè yòng de. noun number; amount; quantity 多少不等 duōshǎobùděng vary in amount (or number) adverb somewhat; more or less; to some extent; rather 多少有點兒失望 duōshǎo yǒudiǎnr shīwàng feel a bit disappointed 他多少會說幾句英語。 Tā duōshǎo huì shuō jǐ jù Yīngyǔ. He speaks a little English. 他講的多少有點兒道理。 tā jiǎng deduōshǎo yǒudiǎnr dàoli. There’s something in what he says. 她對這消息多少是相信的。 Tā duì zhè xiāoxi duōshǎo shì xiāngxìn de. She pretty much believes the news. 我多少有點兒喜歡他, 不過他很驕傲。 Wǒ duōshǎo yǒudiǎnr xǐhuan tā, buguò tā hěn jiāo'ào. I rather like him, but he is very proud.

adjective 1 difficult; hard; troublesome (opp. 易) 很難想象 Hěn nán xiǎngxiàng (it’s) hard to imagine 山路難走。 Shānlù nán zǒu. Mountain paths are hard to travel. 說起來容易做起來難。 Shuō qǐlai róngyì zuò qǐlai nán. adjective 1 easy 好(不)容易 hǎobùróngyì not at all easy; in a hard way 容易的題先做。 Róngyì de tí xiān zuò. Do the easy problems first. 說起來容易做起來難。 Shuō qǐlai róngyì zuò qǐlai nán. It’s easier said than done. 2 likely; liable; apt 他容易生病。 Tā róngyì shēngbìng. He often gets ill. 這容易引起誤會。 Zhè róngyì yǐnqǐ wùhuì. This is liable to cause misunderstanding. 人們容易把這兩個問題混淆起來。 Rénmen róngyì bǎ zhè liǎng ge wèntí hùnxiáo qǐlai. People are apt to confuse the two issues.

noun 1 place; location 座位 zuòwèi seat 2 position; post; rank 位卑言輕 wèi bēi yán qīng be of a low rank and not have any say 3 throne 即位 jíwèi ascend to the throne 4 mathematics place; figure; digit 個位 gèwèi unit’s place 十位 shíwèi ten’s place 四位數 sì wèi shù four-figure (or four-digit) number 小數位 xiǎo shùwèi decimal place 計算到小數點後五位 jìsuàn dào xiǎoshùdiǎn hòu wǔ wèi calculate to five decimal places 5 computing bit measure word courteous [for people] 各位代表！ Gèwèi dàibiǎo! Fellow Delegates! 今天我們家要來幾位朋友。 Jīntiān wǒmen jiā yào lái jǐ wèi péngyou. We have some friends coming to see us today.

noun 1 cooked rice or other cereals 小米飯 Xiǎo mǐfàn (cooked) millet 2 meal 一天三頓飽飯 yī tiān sān dùn bǎo fàn three square meals a day 飯前洗手。 Fànqián xǐshǒu. Wash your hands before meals. 3 means of living; livelihood; job 混口飯吃 hùn kǒu fàn chī make a living; earn one’s bread

verb 1 eat; take 吃茶 chīchá drink tea 吃糖 chītáng have some sweets 吃藥 chīyào take medicine 吃蘋果 chī píngguǒ eat an apple 吃得很飽 chī de hěn bǎo have eaten one’s fill; be quite full 2 have one's meals; eat somewhere 吃食堂 chī shítáng have one’s meals in the mess 3 live on (or off) 吃利息 chī lìxī live on interest 4 annihilate; wipe out 吃掉敵軍一個師 chī diào díjūn yī ge shī annihilate an enemy division 吃一個子兒 chī yī gèzir take a piece (in chess) 5 exhaust; be a strain on 吃力 chīlì strenuous; difficult 6 absorb; soak up 茄子很吃油。 Qiézi hěn chī yóu. verb 1 arrive; reach 到！ Dào! [answer to roll call] Here! 到了多少人？ Dào le duōshao rén？ How many people were present? 火車到站了。 Huǒchē dào zhàn le. The train has arrived at the station. 時間到了。 Shíjiān dào le. Time’s up. 2 go to; leave for 到蘭州去 Dào Lánzhōu qù go to Lanzhou 3 [as a verb complement to show the result of an action] 辦得到 bàndedào can be done 說到做到 shuōdàozuòdào be as good as one’s word 想不到你來了。 Xiǎng bù dào nǐ lái le. I didn’t expect you would come. preposition up until; up to 到目前為止 dào mùqián wéizhǐ up to the present; until now; so far 工作到深夜 Gōngzuò dào shēnyè work late into the night 從星期三到星期五 cóng Xīngqīsān dào Xīngqīwǔ from Wednesday to Friday 溫度降到零下二十度。 Wēndù jiàng dào língxià èrshí dù. The temperature dropped to minus 20 degrees centigrade. adjective thoughtful; considerate 不到之處請原諒。 Bù dào zhī chù qǐng yuánliàng. Please excuse me if I have been inconsiderate in any way.

verb 1 go; go to (a place) 我去。 Wǒ qù. I’ll go. 他已經去了。 Tā yǐjing qù le. He has already gone. 我要去南京了。 Wǒ yào qù Nánjīng le. I’m going to Nanjing. 我想去南京一趟。 Wǒ xiǎng qù Nánjīng yī tàng. I think I’ll take a trip to Nanjing. 我要去車站接人。 Wǒ yào qù chēzhàn jiē rén. I’m going to the station to meet someone. 他去了三天, 還沒回來。 Tā qù le sān tiān, hái méi huílai. He’s been away for three days, and hasn’t come back yet. 昨天已經去了三個人。 Zuótiān yǐjing qù le sān ge rén. Three people went there yesterday. 我去了好幾趟, 都沒碰到他。 Wǒ qù le hǎojǐ tàng, dōu méi pèngdào tā. I went there several times, but never saw him. 2 cause to go; send there 給她去個電話。 Gěi tā qù ge diànhuà. Give her a call. 我給他去過兩封信。 Wǒ gěi tā qù guò liǎng fēng xìn. I sent him two letters. 我們只去了個代表。 Wǒmen zhǐ qù le ge dàibiǎo. We only sent a representative. 已經去了一個電報。 Yǐjing qù le yī ge diànbào. A telegram has been sent (to him). 3 remove; get rid of 去頭屑 Qù tóu xiè get rid of dandruff 去殖民化 qù zhímínhuà decolonize 去了皮再吃。 Qù le pí zài chī. Peel it before you eat it. 汽油能去油跡。 Qìyóu néng qù yóujì. Gas is good for taking out oil stains. 裙子太長了, 去兩公分吧。 qúnzi tài cháng le, qù liǎng gōngfēn ba. The skirt is too long—shorten it by two centimetres. 這句話去幾個字就簡潔了。 Zhè jù huà qù jǐ ge zì jiù jiǎnjié le. Take out one or two words and the sentence will be more concise. 4 [before and / or after a verb] go in order to; be going to (do sth. there) 咱們去看電影。(= 咱們看電影去。= 咱們去看電影去。) Zánmen qù kàn diànyǐng. (or) zánmen kàn diànyǐng qù. (or) zánmen qù kàn diànyǐng qù. Let’s go to see a movie. 這件事我去辦吧。 Zhè jiàn shì wǒ qù bàn ba Let me (go and) arrange this. 你去打水, 我來生爐子。 Nǐ qù dǎ shuǐ, wǒ lái shēng lúzi. You get some water and I’ll light the stove. 你別管, 讓他自己去想辦法。 Nǐ bié guǎn, ràng tā zìjǐ qù xiǎng bànfǎ. Don’t bother, let him figure it out for himself. 你們去研究研究, 看該怎麼辦。 Nǐmen qù yánjiū yánjiū, kàn gāi zěnme bàn. Go and make a study of it, and see what’s the best thing to do. 5 [between two verbal expressions, and / or after the second expression] in order to (do sth. there) 用科學的觀點去觀察事物 Yòng kēxué de guāndiǎn qù guānchá shìwù look at things from a scientific point of view 他回家吃飯去了。 Tā huíjiā chī fàn qù le. He went home to eat. 她上街去買東西了。(= 她上街買東西去了。= 她上街去買東西去了。) Tā shàngjiē qù mǎi dōngxi le. (or) tā shàngjiē mǎi dōngxi qù le. (or) tā shàngjiē qù mǎi dōngxi qù le. She went to the market to do some shopping. 他提了一桶水去澆花。 Tā tí le yī tǒng shuǐ qù jiāo huā. He took a bucket of water to water the flowers. 6 literary be apart from in space or time 去今五十年 Qù jīn wǔshí nián 50 years ago 兩地相去四十裡。 Liǎng de xiāng qù sìshí lǐ. The two places are 40 li apart. 7 literary depart from; leave See 28802304去國qu4guo2去國 8 euphemistic pass away; die 老太太昨夜去了。 lǎotàitai zuóyè qù le. The old lady died last night. noun abbreviation VARIANT OF 28804096去聲qu4sheng1去聲 1 falling tone (third of the four tones in classical Chinese pronunciation) 2 falling tone (fourth of the four tones in modern standard Chinese pronunciation) adjective just gone (or elapsed) 去秋 qù qiū last autumn 去冬今春 qùdōng jīnchūn last winter and this spring adverb dialect [with 了 as an intensive complement to certain adjectives with了] very; extremely 他家遠了去了。 Tā jiā yuǎn le qù le. His home is far far away. 那片林子可大了去了。 Nà piàn línzi kě dà le qù le. That’s a really huge forest. 他到過的地方多了去了。 Tā dào guò de dìfang duō le qù le. He’s been to a great many places. verb play (a part or character) 他在京劇《鬧天宮》裡去猴王。 Tā zài Jīngjù 《Nào Tiāngōng》 lǐ qù hóuwáng. He played the Monkey King in the Beijing opera Trouble in Heaven.

verb circle; wind 巡回 xúnhuí tour; make a tour of verb 1 return; go back 回國 huíguó return to one’s native land 回家 huíjiā go home 回到原地 huídào yuándì return to the source; go back to where they were 回到生產第一線 huí dào shēngchǎn dì-yī xiàn go back to one’s post on the production front 2 turn round 回過身來 huí guò shēn lái turn round 3 answer; reply 回函 huíhán reply; letter in reply 4 dated report back (to one's superior) 回大人的話 huí dàren dehuà let me report, Sir 5 decline (an invitation, etc.); refuse; cancel; dismiss 我把保姆回了。 wǒ bǎ bǎomǔ huí le. I sent away my maid. measure word 1 chapter 這部小說共一百回。 Zhè bù xiǎoshuō gòng yībǎi huí. This novel has one hundred chapters. 2 time; occasion 來過一回 Lái guò yī huí have been here once 完全是兩回事 Wánquán shì liǎng huí shì two entirely different matters 有一回我在路上碰到他。 Yǒu yī huí wǒ zài lùshang pèngdào tā. Once, I ran into him in the street. noun Hui ethnic group See 23152384回族hui2zu2回族

verb 1 sit 請坐。 Qǐngzuò. Please sit down. 請進來坐坐。 Qǐng jìnlai zuò zuò. Please come in and sit for a while. 他忽然坐起來了。 Tā hūrán zuò qǐlai le. He sat up suddenly. 我願意站著, 你坐下吧。 Wǒ yuànyi zhànzhe, nǐ zuòxia ba. I’ll love to stand, you sit. 2 travel by or on (any conveyance except those which are straddled) 坐火車去 zuò huǒchē qù go by train 坐公共汽車 zuò gōnggòng qìchē ride on a bus 坐電梯上去 zuò diàntī shàng qù go up by lift; take the elevator 3 (of a building) have its back towards 這所房子坐北朝南。 Zhè suǒ fángzi zuò běi cháo nán. This house faces south. 4 put (a pan, pot, kettle, etc.) on a fire 把壺坐上 Bǎ hú zuò shàng put the kettle on (the fire) 5 (of a building) sink; subside 這個房子向后坐了。 Zhège fángzi xiàng hòu zuò le. This house is beginning to lean backwards. 6 (of rifles, guns, etc.) recoil; kick back See 37131008坐力zuo4li4坐力 7 bear (fruit) See 37127168坐果zuo4guo3坐果 8 be punished See 20743680反坐fan3zuo4反坐 9 contract (or have) a disease; suffer from a disease 年輕時坐下了腿寒的毛病 niánqīng shí zuòxià le tuǐ hán de máobing got one’s cold legs during one’s youth noun VARIANT OF 37165824座zuo4座1 seat; place preposition literary because; for the reason that 坐此解職 zuòcǐxièzhí be dismissed for this reason adverb literary without any reason or cause; for no reason 驚砂坐飛 jīngshā zuò fēi dust flew without wind
pronoun here 我們這裡一年種兩季稻子。 Wǒmen zhèlǐ yī nián zhòng liǎng jì dàozi. We grow two crops of rice a year here.

common phrase I'm sorry; sorry; excuse me; pardon me; I beg your pardon 對不起, 給你添麻煩了。 Duìbuqǐ, gěi nǐ tiān máfan le. Sorry to have given you so much trouble. 對不起, 是我的錯。 Duìbuqǐ, shì wǒ de cuò. I am sorry, it was my fault. 對不起, 我得走了。 Duìbuqǐ, wǒ děi zǒu le. Excuse me, but I must go now. 對不起, 請你再講一遍好嗎？ Duìbuqǐ, qǐng nǐ zài jiǎng yī biàn hǎo ma？ I beg your pardon, would you repeat what you said? or I beg your pardon? verb let sb. down; unworthy of; unfair to (opp. 對得起) 球隊輸了球, 大伙兒覺得對不起教練。 Qiúduì shū le qiú, dàhuǒr juéde duìbuqǐ jiàoliàn. The team lost and felt they had let the coach down. 他對不起她, 本來答應跟她結婚, 後來卻把她甩了。 Tā duìbuqǐ tā, běnlái dāying gēn tā jiéhūn, hòulái què bǎ tā shuǎile. He treated her shabbily by first promising to marry her and then jilting her.

verb 1 courteous excuse me; please 請問, 到火車站怎麼走？ Qǐngwèn, dào huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu？ Excuse me, but could you tell me how to get to the station? 2 we should like to ask; it may be asked; one may ask 請問, 要不是改革開放, 我們的經濟建設能有今天嗎？ Qǐngwèn, yào bù shì gǎigé kāifàng, wǒmen de jīngjì jiànshè néng yǒu jīntiān ma？ I’d like to ask, without reform and the open policy, could our economic development be what it is today?

pronoun 1 this 這地方 zhè dìfang this place 這一回 zhè yī huí this time 這就對了。 Zhè jiù duì le. Now you’re on the right track. or Now that’s better. 這是新產品。 zhè shì xīnchǎnpǐn. These are new products. 這究竟是怎麼回事？ Zhè jiūjìng shì zěnme huí shì？ What’s all this about? 這才是好孩子！ Zhè cái shì hǎo háizi! That’s a good boy (girl)! or That’s a dear! 這消息我知道了。 Zhè xiāoxi wǒ zhīdao le. I’ve heard that news already. or Yes, so I’ve heard. 2 now 我這就走。 Wǒ zhè jiù zǒu. I’m leaving right now. 他這才知道鍛煉身體的好處。 Tā zhè cái zhīdao duànliàn shēntǐ de hǎochu. Only now does he see the benefit of exercise.

pronoun that 那人 nà rén that man 那時候 nà shíhou at that time 那兩棵樹 nà liǎng kē shù those two trees 那是 2008 年的事。 Nà shì 1958nián de shì. That was in 2008. 那是誰？ Nà shì shuí？ Who is that? 那是我的錯。 Nà shì wǒ de cuò. That was my fault. 我們說這道那的, 不知不覺已到凌晨。 Wǒmen shuō zhè dào nà de, bùzhībùjué yǐ dào língchén. We talked about this and that, and before we knew it, it was almost dawn. conjunction then; in that case 那我們就不再等了。 Nà wǒmen jiù bùzài děng le. In that case, we won’t wait any longer. 你要想跟我們一塊走, 那就得快點兒。 nǐ yào xiǎng gēn wǒmen yīkuài zǒu, nà jiùděi kuàidianr. If you’re coming with us, you must hurry.

noun 1 book 一本關於中國曆史的新書 yī běn guānyú Zhōngguó lìshǐ de xīnshū a new work on Chinese history 2 style of calligraphy; script 楷書 kǎishū regular script 3 literary letter 家書 jiāshū letter from home 4 document 證書 zhèngshū certificate; credential verb literary write 振筆直書 zhènbǐzhíshū take up the pen and write vigorously

noun (public) bus 上公共汽車 shàng gōnggòng qìchē get on the bus 下公共汽車 Xià gōnggòngqìchē get off the bus 雙層公共汽車 shuāngcénggōnggòngqìchē double-decker bus 乘1路公共汽車去西單。 chéng 1 lù gōnggòngqìchē qù xī dān. Take Bus No.1 to Xidan.
noun 1 state-owned (or office) vehicle (opp. 私車) 2 dialect public bus
noun 1 small vehicle (such as a car, pushcart, etc.) 2 dialect bicycle

verb 1 come near; move towards 大家就攏來烤火取暖。 Dàjiā jiù lǒng lái kǎohuǒ qǔnuǎn. They all gathered round the fire to get warm. 你就著桌子吃西瓜。 Nǐ jiù zhe zhuōzi chī xīguā. Eat your watermelon over the table. 我們就著路燈下棋。 Wǒmen jiù zhe lùdēng xiàqí. We played chess by the light of a street lamp. 2 undertake; engage in; enter upon 就農 jiù nóng engage in farming 3 accomplish; make 這個鼎是青銅鑄就的。 Zhège dǐng shì qīngtóng zhùjiù de. This tripod is made of bronze. 4 take advantage of; accomodate oneself to 我們就這個機會談談。 Wǒmen jiù zhège jīhuì tán tán. We’ll take this opportunity to have a talk. 只好就這塊料子做了。 Zhǐhǎo jiù zhè kuài liàozi zuò le. We’ll have to make do with this little piece of fabric. 我反正有空, 就你的時間吧。 Wǒ fǎnzheng yǒu kòng, jiù nǐ de shíjiān ba. Make it anytime that suits you; I’m free anyway. 5 be eaten with; go with 炒雞蛋就飯 Chǎo jīdàn jiù fàn scramble eggs to go with the rice 他用花生就酒。 Tā yòng huāshēng jiù jiǔ. He nibbles peanuts with his drink. preposition 1 with regard to; concerning; on 就我所知 jiùwǒsuǒzhī as far as I know 雙方就共同關心的問題進行了會談。 Shuāngfāng jiù gòngtóng guānxīn de wèntí jìnxíng le huìtán. The two sides held talks on matters of common interest. 2 [used to form a set phrase with a passive meaning] 就捕 jiù bǔ be arrested adverb 1 at once; right away 我就來。 Wǒ jiù lái. I’ll come right away. or I’m on my way. 我這就去。 Wǒ zhè jiù qù. I’ll go right away. 一會兒就得。 Yīhuìr jiù děi. It’ll be ready in a minute. 2 as early as; already 我星期一就給你錢。 Wǒ Xīngqīyī jiù gěi nǐ qián. I’ll pay you on Monday. 今天我七點鐘就來了。 Jīntiān wǒ qī diǎn zhōng jiù lái le. I was here by 7 o’clock today. 3 as soon as; right after 說幹就幹 shuōgànjiùgàn act without delay 我吃了飯就出去了。 Wǒ chī le fàn jiù chūqu le. As soon as I finished eating, I went out. 我一見他就生氣。 Wǒ yī jiàn tā jiù shēngqì. Whenever I see him, I get angry. 他每天下了課就回家。 Tā měitiān xià le kè jiù huíjiā. He comes home every day right after class. 4 in that case; then 要是你來, 我就高興了。 Yào shì nǐ lái, wǒ jiù gāoxìng le. If you come, (then) I’ll be very happy. 不經過艱苦奮鬥, 就不能勝利。 Bù jīngguò jiānkǔfèndòu, jiù bù néng shènglì. All victories are won through arduous struggle. 5 as much as; as many as 光襯衫他就有二十件。 Guāng chènshān tā jiù yǒu èrshí jiàn. He has as many as 20 shirts. 光回收廢品一項, 他們就給公司節約了二十萬元。 guāng huíshōu fèipǐn yī xiàng, tāmenjiù gěi gōngsī jiéyuē le èrshí wàn yuán. Just by collecting scrap, they saved all of 200,000 yuan for the company. 6 [between two identical elements to express resignation] 丟了就丟了吧, 以後小心點。 Diū le jiù diū le ba, yǐhòu xiǎoxīn diǎn. If it’s lost, it’s lost. Just be more careful from now on. 7 to begin with; as expected 我就料到他會等我們的。 Wǒ jiù liàodào tā huì děng wǒmen de. I knew he’d be waiting for us. 我本來就不懂法語。 Wǒ běnlái jiù bù dǒng fǎ yǔ. I never said I knew any French in the first place. 8 only; merely; just 就這一本了, 看完請馬上還。 Jiù zhè yī běn le, kàn wán qǐng mǎ shàng huán. This is the only copy left. Please return it as soon as you finish reading it. 我就要幾張紙。 Wǒ jiùyào jǐ zhāng zhǐ. I just want a few sheets of paper. 我就去過一次上海。 Wǒ jiù qù guò yī cì Shànghǎi. I’ve been to Shanghai only once before. 我們就等你的決定了。 Wǒmen jiù děng nǐ de juédìng le. All we need is your decision. 9 just; simply 我就不信我們婦女幹不了這一行。 Wǒ jiù bù xìn wǒmen fùnǚ gànbuliǎo zhè yīháng. I just don’t believe we women can’t do this job. 不知道為什麼, 我就不喜歡他。 Bùzhīdào wèishénme, wǒ jiù bù xǐhuan tā. I don’t know why I don’t like him. 10 exactly; precisely 醫務室就在這兒。 Yīwùshì jiù zài zhèr. This is where the clinic is. conjunction even if 你就生氣也沒用。 Nǐ jiù shēngqì yě méiyòng. Even getting angry won’t help. 你就不說, 我也會知道的。 Nǐ jiù bù shuō, wǒ yě huì zhīdao de. Even if you don’t tell me, I’ll know anyway.
noun film; movie; motion picture 彩色電影 cǎisè diànyǐng colour movie 黑白電影 hēi-bái diànyǐng black-and-white movie 有聲電影 yǒushēng diànyǐng sound film 無聲電影 wúshēng diànyǐng silent film

auxiliary 1 [at the end of a question] 你找我有事嗎？ Nǐ zhǎo wǒ yǒu shì ma？ Do you want to see me about something? 明天他來嗎？ Míngtiān tā lái ma？ Will he come tomorrow? 下午有會嗎？ Xiàwǔ yǒu huì ma？ Is there a meeting this afternoon? 2 [as a pause in a sentence before introducing the main point] 特殊情況嗎, 還得特殊對待。 Tèshū qíngkuàng ma, hái dé tèshū duìdài. Special cases, of course, need special consideration. 這件事嗎, 其實也不能怪他。 Zhè jiàn shì ma, qíshí yě bù néng guài tā. This problem, actually, is not his fault. 3 [at the end of a rhetorical question] 你發這麼大脾氣像話嗎？ Nǐ fā zhème dà píqi xiànghuà ma？ Aren’t you ashamed of flying into such a rage? 你難道沒看見我正忙著嗎？ Nǐ nándào méi kànjian wǒ zhèng mángzhe ma？ Don’t you see I’m busy at the moment? 這不是很明白的嗎？ Zhè bù shì hěn míngbai de ma？ Isn’t this perfectly clear?

verb 1 look for; try to find; seek 找礦 Zhǎo kuàng look for mineral deposits 找出路 zhǎo chūlù seek a way out 找答案 zhǎo dá'àn search for the answer 找工作 zhǎo gōngzuò look (or hunt) for a job 找機會 zhǎo jīhuì look for (or seek) an opportunity 找到油田 zhǎodào yóutián discover an oil field 2 want to see; call on; approach; ask for 找我有什麼事？ Zhǎo wǒ yǒu shénme shì？ What can I do for you? or What do you want to see me about? 有人找你。 Yǒu rén zhǎo nǐ. Someone wants to see you. 明天再來找你。 Míngtiān zài lái zhǎo nǐ. I’ll call on you again tomorrow. 出了問題可得找你。 Chū le wèntí kě dé zhǎo nǐ. If anything goes wrong, we’ll hold you responsible. 幹嗎不去找老楊幫忙？ Gànmá bù qù zhǎo lǎo yáng bāngmáng？ Why not go and ask Lao Yang for help? verb give change 甭找了。 Béng zhǎo le. Keep the change. [as a tip] 她找我二十元。 Tā zhǎo wǒ èrshí yuán. She gave me 20 yuan change (or in change).

verb 1 do; make; produce; manufacture 做結論 zuò jiélún pass a verdict; reach a conclusion 做衣服 zuò yīfu make clothes 做長期打算 zuò chángqī dǎsuan plan for the long term 這種糖是甜菜做的。 Zhèzhǒng táng shì tiáncài zuò de. This sugar is made from beets. 這是你自己做的嗎？ Zhè shì nǐ zìjǐ zuò de ma？ Did you make this yourself? 2 cook; prepare 做菜 zuòcài cook a dish 3 do; act; engage in 做好本職工作 zuòhǎo běnzhí gōngzuò do one’s best at one’s job 從點滴的事情做起 cóng diǎndī de shìqing zuò qǐ start with little things 大事做不來, 小事又不做 dàshì zuò bù lái, xiǎoshì yòu bù zuò incapable of big jobs yet despise small ones 照正確的意見去做 zhào zhèngquè de yìjian qù zuò act upon correct views 共做了兩萬多個勞動日 gòng zuò le liǎngwàn duō ge láodòngrì did a total of more than 20,000 workdays 4 be; become 做演員 zuò yǎnyuán become an actor or actress; go on the stage 後來她做保育員了。 Hòulái tā zuò bǎoyùyuán le. Later she became a child-care worker. 今天開會由你做主席。 Jīntiān kāihuì yóu nǐ zuò zhǔxí. You’ll be the chairman at today’s meeting. 5 write; compose See 37179904做文章zuo4wen2zhang1做文章 6 hold a family (or home) celebration See 37179648做壽zuo4shou4做壽 7 used as; used for 這篇文章可以做教材。 Zhè piān wénzhāng kěyǐ zuò jiàocái. This article may be used as teaching material. 樹皮可以做造紙的原料。 Shùpí kěyǐ zuò zàozhǐ de yuánliào. Bark may be used as raw material for paper. 8 form or contract a relationship 做對頭 zuò duìtóu set oneself against sb. 做朋友 zuò péngyou make friends with 9 pretend; feign; do sth. for form's sake See 37181184做樣子zuo4yang4zi5做樣子 10 dialect kill 把人質做了 bǎ rénzhì zuòle kill the hostage
verb polite expression goodbye; see you again

pronoun colloquial 1 how; what 你覺得怎麼樣？ Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng？ How are you feeling? 你能把他怎麼樣？ Nǐ néng bǎ tā zěnmeyàng？ What can you do to him? or You can’t touch him! 後來這孩子怎麼樣了？ Hòulái zhè háizi zěnmeyàng le？ What became of the child? 演出的情況怎麼樣？ Yǎnchū de qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng？ How was the performance? 2 what's it like; how are things; what do you think 怎麼樣, 忙嗎？抽支煙吧。 Zěnmeyàng, máng ma？ Chōu zhī yān ba. How are things, busy? Have a cigarette. 騎車去怎麼樣？ Qíchē qù zěnmeyàng？ How (or What) about going by bike? 四個菜, 一個湯, 怎麼樣？ Sì ge cài, yī ge tāng, zěnmeyàng？ Four dishes and one soup—what do you think? 3 in a certain way; in any way; no matter how 人家怎麼樣做, 你也怎麼樣做。 Rénjia zěnmeyàng zuò, nǐ yě zěnmeyàng zuò. Do as everybody does. 我怎麼樣做都不對。 Wǒ zěnmeyàng zuò dōu bù duì. No matter what I do, I’m always wrong. 4 [used in the negative as a mild understatement] (not) up to much 她唱歌不怎麼樣。 Tā chànggē bù zěnmeyàng. She’s not much of a singer. 這個電影不怎麼樣。 Zhège diànyǐng bù zěnmeyàng. The film is pretty lousy. 他一時不小心, 我們也不好把他怎麼樣。 Tā yīshí bù xiǎoxīn, wǒmen yě bù hǎo bǎ tā zěnmeyàng. We couldn’t be too hard on him because he was just careless.

pronoun 1 [before a noun or by itself] what 什麼時候啦？ Shénme shíhou la？ What time is it? 什麼叫超現實主義？ Shénme jiào chāoxiànshízhǔyì？ What is surrealism? 你找什麼？ Nǐ zhǎo shénme？ What are you looking for? 你找什麼人？ Nǐ zhǎo shénme rén？ Who are you looking for? 她喜歡做什麼工作？ Tā xǐhuan zuò shénme gōngzuò？ What sort of job would she like to take? 什麼風把你吹來的？ shénme fēng bǎ nǐ chuī lái de? What fortunate breeze blew you here? 2 something; anything 我想吃點兒什麼。 Wǒ xiǎng chī diǎnrshénme. I want something to eat. 沒有什麼, 您不必介意。 Méiyǒu shénme, nín bùbì jièyì. Never mind, it’s nothing. 你讀過他的什麼作品嗎？ Nǐ dú guò tā de shénme zuòpǐn ma？ Have you read any of his books? 我講不出什麼新鮮玩意兒。 Wǒ jiǎng bù chū shénme xīnxiān wányìr. There won’t be anything new in my story. 種什麼花結什麼果。 zhòng shénme huājié shénme guǒ. As the flower so the fruit. 3 [before 也 or 都] any; every 他什麼都不怕。 Tā shénme dōu bù pà. He’s afraid of nothing. 經理正忙著, 什麼人也不見。 Jīnglǐ zhèng mángzhe, shénme rén yě bù jiàn. The manager is too busy to see anybody. 時間比什麼都寶貴。 Shíjiān bǐ shénme dōu bǎoguì. Time is more precious than anything else. 4 [used correlatively with another 什麼] whatever 有什麼, 咱們就吃什麼。 Yǒu shénme, zánmen jiù chī shénme. We’ll eat whatever we can find. 我有什麼說什麼, 絕對沒有保留。 Wǒ yǒu shénme shuō shénme, juéduì méiyǒu bǎoliú. I’ll just say what’s on my mind, withholding nothing. 5 [expressing anger, surprise, censure or negation] 什麼！ 沒有水？ Shénme! Méiyǒu shuǐ？ What! No water? 他知道什麼！ Tā zhīdao shénme! What the hell does he know? 你說的是什麼話！ Nǐ shuō de shì shénme huà! You’re talking sheer nonsense! 笑什麼？有什麼可笑的？ Xiào shénme？ Yǒu shénme kěxiào de？ What’s so funny? 你說呀！ 裝什麼啞巴？ Nǐ shuō ya! Zhuāng shénme yǎba？ Speak up! Stop playing dumb. 你嚷嚷什麼！ 有話好好兒的對她說嘛。 Nǐ rāngrang shénme! Yǒu huà hǎohāor de duì tā shuō ma. Stop shouting! Speak to her nicely. 6 [expressing disapproval or disagreement] 什麼不懂！ 裝糊塗就是了。 Shénme bù dǒng! Zhuāng hútu jiùshìle. What do you mean—not understand? You’re just pretending. 年輕什麼呀, 我都五十多了。 Niánqīng shénme ya, wǒ dōu wǔshí duō le. Young indeed! I’m past 50 already. 給您添麻煩了！ —— 麻煩什麼！ Gěi nín tiān máfan le! —— Máfan shénme! Sorry to have troubled you.—It’s nothing. 7 things like; such as; and so on; and what not 什麼縫縫補補, 洗洗涮涮, 都是奶奶的事兒。 Shénme féngféngbǔbǔ, xǐ xǐ shuàn shuàn, dōu shì nǎinai de shìr. In our house it’s Grandma who does all the sewing, mending, washing and what not. 什麼乒乓球啊, 羽毛球啊, 籃球啊, 他都會玩。 Shénme Pīngpāngqiú a, yǔmáoqiú a, lánqiú a, tā dōu huì wán. He can play table tennis, badminton, basketball, anything.
noun 1 friend 廣交朋友 Guǎngjiāo péngyou make many friends 2 boyfriend or girlfriend 談朋友 tánpéngyou have a boyfriend (or girlfriend); go steady; date

noun 1 east and west 東西方對抗 dōngxī fāng duìkàng West-East confrontation 東西方關係 dōngxī fāng guānxi West-East relations 2 from east to west 這地方東西三裡, 南北五裡。 Zhè dìfang dōngxī sān lǐ, nán-běi wǔ lǐ. This district is three li across from east to west and five li from north to south.

auxiliary 1 [indicating a suggestion, request or mild command] 咱們走吧。 Zánmen zǒu ba. Let’s go. 你好好兒想想吧！ Nǐ hǎohāor xiǎngxiang ba! Just think it over. 2 [indicating consent or approval] 明天就明天吧。 Míngtiān jiù míngtiān ba. All right, let’s make it tomorrow. 好吧, 就這麼辦吧！ Hǎo ba, jiù zhème bàn ba! O.K., that’s what we’ll do. 3 [in a leading question which asks for confirmation of a supposition] 他會來吧？ Tā huì lái ba？ He’ll come, won’t he? 你是中國人吧？ Nǐ shì Zhōngguó rén ba？ You are Chinese, I suppose (or I take it)? 4 [indicating some doubt in the speaker's mind] 他們走了吧。 Tāmen zǒu le ba. I suppose they’ve left. 他好像是這麼說的吧。 Tā hǎoxiàng shì zhème shuō de ba. That seems to be what he said. 5 [marking a pause after suppositions as alternatives] 去吧, 不好；不去吧, 也不好。 qù ba, bù hǎo; bù qù ba, yě bù hǎo. If I go, it’s no good; if I don’t, it’s no good either.

auxiliary 1 [at the end of a special, alternative, or rhetorical question] 你剛纔到哪兒去了呢？ Nǐ gāngcái dào nǎr qù le ne？ Where were you just now? 你到底認不認得她呢？ Nǐ dào dǐ rèn bù rèn de tā ne？ Do you know her or not? 你對這件事是贊成呢, 還是反對呢？ Nǐ duì zhè jiàn shì shì zànchéng ne, hái shì fǎnduì ne？ Are you for or against this? 他們都有任務了, 我呢？ Tāmen dōu yǒu rènwu le, wǒ ne? They’ve got assignments, what about me? 我錯在哪兒呢？ Wǒ cuò zài nǎr ne？ What is my mistake? 我怎麼能不記得呢？ Wǒ zěnme néng bù jìde ne？ How could I forget this? 這點子事, 何必大驚小怪呢？ Zhè diǎnzi shì, hébì dàjīngxiǎoguài ne？ Why get so excited over such a little thing? 2 [at the end of a declarative sentence to reinforce the assertion] 遠得很, 有好幾千里地呢。 Yuǎn de hěn, yǒu hǎo jǐqiān lǐ dì ne. It’s a long way off—thousands of li away. 3 [at the end of a declarative sentence to indicate the continuation of an action or a state] 他還在生氣呢。 Tā hái zài shēngqì ne. He’s still angry. 張先生, 有人找你呢。 Zhāng xiānsheng, yǒurén zhǎo nǐ ne. Mr Zhang, somebody is looking for you. 4 [used to mark a pause] 不下雨呢, 就去;下雨呢, 就不去。 Bù xià yǔ ne, jiù qù ； xiàyǔ ne, jiù bù qù. If it doesn’t rain, we’ll go; if it does, we won’t. 如今呢, 可比以往任何時候都要強。 Rújīn ne, kě bǐ yǐwǎng rènhé shíhou dōu yào qiáng. As for the present, things are far better than at any time in the past.

verb 1 cry; shout 大叫一聲 dà jiào yī shēng give a loud cry; shout; cry out loudly 2 call; greet 外邊有人叫你。 Wàibian yǒu rén jiào nǐ. Somebody outside is calling you. 這孩子很靦腆, 不愛叫人。 Zhè háizi hěn miǎntiǎn, bù ài jiào rén. The child is shy and doesn’t like to greet people. 3 hire; order 叫個出租車 jiào ge chūzūchē hire (or call) a taxi 叫一份外賣的比薩餅 jiào yī fèn wàimài de bǐsàbǐng order a takeaway pizza 4 name; call 人們叫他小張。 Rénmen jiào tā xiǎo zhāng. People call him Xiao Zhang. 他叫什麼名兒？ Tā jiào shénme míngr？ What’s his name? 這棉花長得真叫棒。 Zhè miánhua zhǎng de zhēn jiào bàng. That’s what I call a really good crop of cotton. 這能叫虛心接受批評嗎？ zhè néng jiào xūxīn jiēshòu pīpíng ma? Can this be called readiness to accept criticism? adjective dialect male (animal) See 24034560叫驢jiao4lv2叫驢 verb 1 ask; order; tell 叫他進來嗎？ Jiào tā jìnlai ma？ Shall I ask him (to come) in? 醫生叫她臥床休息。 Yīshēng jiào tā wòchuáng xiūxi. The doctor told her to stay in bed. 2 permit; allow 他哥哥不叫他去。 Tā gēge bù jiào tā qù. His brother did not allow him to go. preposition [in a passive sentence to introduce the doer of the action] 叫你猜著了。 Jiào nǐ cāizháo le. You’ve guessed right. 你叫雨淋濕了嗎？ Nǐ jiào yǔ lín shī le ma？ Did you get wet?
verb thank 謝謝！ Xièxie! Thanks! or Thank you! 謝謝你的好意。 Xièxie nǐ de hǎo yì. Thank you for your kindness. 請替我謝謝他。 Qǐng tì wǒ xièxie tā. Please pass on my thanks to him.

verb 1 walk; go 走遍全國 zǒubiàn quánguó travel the length and breadth of the country 走很遠的路 zǒu hěn yuǎn de lù walk a long distance 走下主席臺 zǒu xià zhǔxítái step down from the rostrum 走群眾路線 zǒu qúnzhòng lùxiàn follow the mass line 走社會主義道路 zǒu shèhuìzhǔyì dàolù take the socialist road 走在遊行隊伍的前列 zǒu zài yóuxíng duìwu de qiánliè march in the van of the procession 走前人沒有走過的道路 zǒu qiánrén méiyǒu zǒu guò de dàolù break new paths; take untrodden paths 一直往前走 Yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu go straight ahead 這船一小時走十五海里。 Zhè chuán yī xiǎoshí zǒu shíwǔ hǎilǐ. The ship makes 15 knots. 2 run; move 鐘不走了。 Zhōng bù zǒu le. The clock has stopped. 你這步棋走壞了。 Nǐ zhè bù qí zǒu huài le. You’ve made a bad move. 這個錶走得很準。 Zhège biǎo zǒu de hěn zhǔn. This watch keeps good time. 打得贏就打, 打不贏就走。 Dǎ de yíng jiù dǎ, dǎ bù yíng jiù zǒu. Fight when you can win, leave when you can’t. 3 leave; go away 走開！ Zǒukāi! Get away! or Clear off! 我們該走了。 Wǒmen gāi zǒu le. It’s time we left. or We must be off now. 他把藍圖拿走了。 tā bǎ lántú ná zǒu le. He’s taken the blueprint away. 4 demonstrate a certain tendency See 78185187走高zou3gao1走高;78194147走強zou3qiang2走強 5 visit; call on 他們兩家走得很近。 Tāmen liǎng jiā zǒu de hěn jìn. The two families often visit each other. 6 euphemistic pass away 昨夜他安詳地走了。 Zuóyè tā ānxiáng de zǒu le. He died peacefully last night. 7 through; from 咱們走這個門進去吧。 Zánmen zǒu zhège mén jìnqu ba. Let’s go in through this door. 8 leak; let out; escape 走氣了。 Zǒu qì le. The gas is leaking. or The air is escaping. 9 depart from the original; lose the original shape, flavour, etc. 把原來的意思講走樣了 bǎ yuánlái de yìsi jiǎng zǒu yàng le fail to get the original meaning across; distort the original meaning

noun 1 class; grade; rank 分為三等 fēnwéi sān děng classify into three grades 2 kind; sort 此等人 cǐ děng rén this kind of person 這等事 zhè děng shì this sort of thing verb wait; await 等車 děng chē wait for a train, bus, etc. 等上級批准 děng shàngjí pīzhǔn await approval by the higher authorities 請等一下。 Qǐng děng yīxià. Would you mind waiting a minute, please. or Please wait a minute. adjective equal; equivalent 相等 xiāngděng equal preposition when; till 等我做完再走。 Děng wǒ zuò wán zài zǒu. Stay till I'm through. auxiliary 1 literary [after a personal pronoun or name to show plurality] 彼等 bǐděng they 我等 wǒděng we 該犯等 gāi fàn děng the aforesaid criminals 2 and so on; and so forth; etc. 購置書籍, 紙張文具等 gòuzhì shūjí, zhǐzhāng wénjù děng buy books, stationery and so on 赴瀋陽, 鞍山等地視察 fù Shěnyáng, ān shān děng de shìchá go to Shenyang, Anshan and other places on a tour of inspection 3 [indicating the end of an enumeration] 長江, 黃河, 黑龍江, 珠江等四大河流 Cháng Jiāng, Huáng Hé, Hēilóng Jiāng, Zhū Jiāng děng sìdà héliú the four large rivers—the Chang Jiang, the Huang He, the Heilong Jiang and the Zhu Jiang

verb 1 see; look at; watch 看電視 kàn diànshì watch TV 看電影 kàn diànyǐng see a film; go to the movies 看球賽 kàn qiú sài watch a ball game 看演出 kàn yǎnchū attend a performance 看展覽 kàn zhǎnlǎn visit an exhibition 2 read (silently) 看報 kànbào read a newspaper 看譜 kànpǔ read music score 看書 kànshū read (a book) 3 think; consider; judge 看清形勢 kàn qīng xíngshì make a correct appraisal of the situation 全面地看問題 quánmiàn de kàn wèntí look at (or approach) an issue from all angles 你看她這個人可靠嗎？ Nǐ kàn tā zhège rén kěkào ma？ Do you think she’s reliable? 你對這件事怎麼看？ Nǐ duì zhè jiàn shì zěnme kàn？ What’s your view on this matter? 4 look upon; regard 把公眾的利益看得高於一切 bǎ gōngzhòng de lìyì kàn de gāoyú yīqiè put the interests of the public above all else 5 see (or consult) (a doctor); treat (a patient or an illness) 李大夫把她的肺炎看好了。 Lǐ dàifu bǎ tā de fèiyán kàn hǎo le. Dr. Li has cured her of pneumonia. 有病就該去看。 Yǒu bìng jiù gāi qù kàn. You ought to go and see a doctor when you are ill. 6 look after 衣帽自看。 Yī-mào zì kàn. Take care of your own hats and coats. 7 call on; visit; see 我明天去看他。 Wǒ míngtiān qù kàn tā. I’ll go and see him tomorrow. 有空我來看你。 Yǒukòng wǒ lái kàn nǐ. I’lldrop in on you when I have time. 8 depend on; rely on; fall back on 我們明天是不是出遊, 得看天氣。 wǒmen míngtiān shìbushì chūyóu, děikàn tiānqì. Whether we’ll go on a sightseeing trip tomorrow will depend on the weather. 9 mind; watch out 別跑這麼快！看摔著！ Bié pǎo zhème kuài! Kàn shuāi zhe! Don’t run so fast! Mind you don’t fall. 10 [before some verbs or adjectives] tend to; be expected See 24863488看跌kan4die1看跌 auxiliary 1 [after a reduplicated verb or a verb phrase] try and see (what happens) 試試看 shìshikàn have a try 等一等看 děng yī děng kàn wait and see 嘗嘗看。 Chángchang kàn. Just taste this. 2 [in exclamations to express surprise or rebuke, esp. in the phrase 看你 or 你看你] 看你, 水都燒乾了。 Kàn nǐ, shuǐ dōu shāo gān le. Look what you’ve done! The water has all boiled away. 你看你！怎麼滿頭大汗啊！ Nǐ kàn nǐ! Zěnme mǎntóudàhàn a! Look at yourself! How come you’re bathed in sweat!

noun (of time) before; formerly; previously 以前各版 yǐqián gè bǎn all the preceding (or previous) editions 解放以前 Jiěfàng yǐqián before liberation 十年以前 shí nián yǐqián ten years ago 我以前的同事 wǒ yǐqián de tóngshì former colleague of mine 以前他當過理髮員。 Yǐqián tā dāng guò lǐfàyuán. He used to be a barber. 我以前沒看過這個戲。 Wǒ yǐqián méi kàn guò zhège xì. I’ve never seen this opera before.

noun (of time) after; afterwards; later; hereafter 從今以後 cóngjīnyǐhòu from now on 從那以後 cóng nà yǐhòu from then on 全國解放以後 Quánguó jiěfàng yǐhòu after (or following) the liberation of the whole country 至於以後怎麼樣, 我就不知道了。 Zhìyú yǐhòu zěnmeyàng, wǒ jiù bù zhīdao le. I don’t know what happened later on. 別著急, 以後你會有機會去的。 Bié zháojí, yǐhòu nǐ huì yǒu jīhuì qù de. Don’t worry. You’ll have a chance to go. 會議今天開始, 大概一星期以後結束。 Huìyì jīntiān kāishǐ, dàgài yī xīngqī yǐhòu jiéshù. The conference begins today and will probably close in a week’s time.

verb know; realize; aware of 我不知道這事兒。 Wǒ bù zhīdao zhè shìr. I know nothing about it. 你的意思我知道。 Nǐ de yìsi wǒ zhīdao. I know what you mean. or I see your point. 他們知道問題的嚴重性。 Tāmen zhīdao wèntí de yánzhòngxìng. They realize the seriousness of the problem. 我們知道在前進的路上還會有困難。 Wǒmen zhīdao zài qiánjìn de lùshang hái huì yǒu kùnnan. We know there will still be difficulties ahead.

noun 1 water 請給我一杯水。 Qǐng gěi wǒ yī bēi shuǐ, Give me a glass of water, please. 2 river 漢水 Hànshuǐ Hanshui River 3 general term for rivers, lakes, seas, etc.; water 水陸運輸 shuǐ-lù yùnshū land and water transportation 水平如鏡。 Shuǐpíngrújìng. The surface of the water is as smooth as a mirror. 水往低處流。 shuǐ wǎng dīchù liú. Water seeks its own level. 4 liquid 汽水 qìshuǐ soft drink; soda water 5 extra charges or incomes 外水 wàishuǐ extra income 6 (Shuǐ) a surname adjective dialect poorly made; shoddy 這鞋做得太水了。 Zhè xié zuòdé tài shuǐ le. These shoes are very shoddily made. measure word washing (of a garment) 這件襯衫洗了三水了。 Zhè jiàn chènshān xǐ le sān shuǐ le. This shirt has gone through three washings.

verb 1 speak; talk; say 說風涼話 shuōfēngliánghuà make irresponsible and carping comments 說得多做得少 Shuō de duō zuò de shǎo talk much but do little 說的比唱的好聽 shuō de bǐ chàng de hǎo tīng mouth high-sounding words 說得好不如做得好。 shuō de hǎo bùrú zuòdé hǎo. Better to do well than to say well. 他說法語。 Tā shuō Fǎyǔ. He speaks French. 你說得很對。 Nǐ shuō de hěn duì. What you say is quite true. 那未免說得太輕了。 Nà wèimiǎn shuō de tài qīng le. That’s putting it too mildly. 2 explain 說不通 shuōbùtōng cannot hold water; do not make sense 我一說他就明白了。 Wǒ yī shuō tā jiù míngbai le. I told him how and he caught on at once. 他說了又說, 我還是不懂。 Tā shuō le yòu shuō, wǒ háishi bù dǒng. He explained and explained, but I still couldn’t understand. 3 scold 他父親說了他一頓。 Tā fùqin shuō le tā yī dùn. His father gave him a scolding (or talking-to). 4 act as matchmaker 給他說個媳婦兒 Gěi tā shuō ge xífùr find a wife for him 5 refer to; indicate 你的話是說誰呢？ Nǐ de huà shì shuō shuí ne？ Who did your remarks refer to? noun theory; teachings; doctrine 著書立說 zhùshūlìshuō write books to expound a theory

verb 1 write 寫封信 xiě fēng xìn write a letter 寫副對聯 Xiě fù duìlián write a couplet 寫得一手好字 xiě de yī shǒu hǎo zì have good handwriting; write a good hand 我喜歡寫鋼筆字, 不喜歡寫毛筆字。 Wǒ xǐhuan xiě gāngbǐ zì, bù xǐhuan xiě máobǐ zì. I like to write with a pen and not with a writing-brush. 這支筆不好寫。 Zhè zhī bǐ bù hǎo xiě.
