His portrayal of the character is vivid and true to life. 4 paint; draw See 33305344寫生xie3sheng1寫生

verb 1 listen; hear 聽廣播 Tīng guǎngbō listen to the radio 聽, 好像有人敲門。 tīng, hǎoxiàng yǒurén qiāo mén. Listen, it sounds like someone knocking at the door. 聽聲音不像他。 Tīng shēngyīn bù xiàng tā. The voice didn’t sound like him. 請聽我說完。 Qǐng tīng wǒ shuō wán. Please hear me out. 請聽一下電話。 Qǐng tīng yī xià diànhuà. Answer the phone, please. 廠長要你聽電話。 Chǎngzhǎng yào nǐ tīng diànhuà. The director wants you on the phone. 打開收音機聽聽新聞。 Dǎkāi shōuyīnjī tīngtīng xīnwén. Turn on the radio and listen to the news. 到群眾中走一走, 聽聽他們的意見。 Dào qúnzhòng zhōng zǒu yī zǒu, tīngtīng tāmen de yìjian. Go among the people and hear what they have to say. 你聽著, 我在給你講呢！ Nǐ tīng zhe, wǒ zài gěi nǐ jiǎng ne! Listen to me, I’m talking to you! 他的話聽起來不誠懇。 Tā de huà tīng qǐlai bù chéngkěn. He did not sound sincere. or His words rang hollow. 他的四川口音我聽不出來。 Tā de Sìchuān kǒuyin wǒ tīng bù chūlai. I can’t detect his Sichuan accent. 他唆了半天, 我實在聽不下去了。 Tā suō le bàntiān, wǒ shízài tīng bùxià qùle. He rambled on for hours and I could stand it no longer. 我沒聽過這樣好的音樂。 Wǒ méi tīng guò zhèyàng hǎo de yīnyuè. I’ve never heard such beautiful music before. 這一句我沒聽清。 Zhè yī jù wǒ méi tīng qīng. I didn’t quite catch that sentence. 這些話聽起來倒也有些道理。 Zhèxiē huà tīng qǐlai dào yě yǒuxiē dàoli. That actually sounds quite reasonable. 2 heed; obey; listen to 對批評聽不進去 Duì pīpíng tīng bù jìnqu turn a deaf ear to criticism 聽我的沒錯兒。 Tīng wǒ de méicuòr. Do as I say and you won’t go wrong. 我勸他別去, 他不聽。 Wǒ quàn tā bié qù, tā bù tīng. I advised him not to go, but he wouldn’t listen. 家裡的事我都聽她的。 Jiālǐ de shì wǒ dōu tīng tā de. When it comes to household matters, I listen to her. 工地上一切都聽他指揮。 Gōngdì shàng yīqiè dōu tīng tā zhǐhuī. Everything on the construction site is under his command. 老了, 胳膊腿兒不聽使喚了。 Lǎo le, gēbo tuǐr bù tīng shǐhuan le. I’m getting old. My limbs don’t obey me anymore 她要聽了我的話, 哪會有今天。 Tā yào tīng le wǒ dehuà, nǎ huì yǒu jīntiān. If she’d heeded me, things would be different today. 3 administer; manage 聽政 tīngzhèng conduct a hearing; hold count verb allow; let 聽由老闆擺布 tīng yóu lǎobǎn bǎibu be at the mercy of the boss measure word transliteration tin; can 六聽啤酒 liù tīng píjiǔ six cans of beer 三聽咖啡 Sān tīng kāfēi three tins of coffee

noun antithetical couplet; couplet 喜對 xǐ duì wedding couplet verb 1 answer; reply 無言以對 wúyányǐduì have nothing to say in reply 2 treat; cope with; counter 刀對刀, 槍對槍 dāo duì dāo, qiāng duì qiāng sword against sword and spear against spear 上海隊對北京隊 Shànghǎi duì duì Běijīng duì Shanghai versus Beijing 3 train on; direct at 槍口對著某人 qiāngkǒu duì zhe mǒurén train the gun on sb. 她的話不是對著你的。 Tā de huà bù shì duì zhe nǐ de. What she said was not directed at you. 4 bring (two things) into contact; fit together 這個榫頭對不上。 Zhège sǔntou duì bù shàng. This tenon does not fit. 5 suit; agree; get along 對心眼兒 duìxīnyǎnr suit one very well; compatible 6 compare; check; identify; verify 對筆跡 duì bǐjì identify the handwriting 對號碼 duì hàomǎ verify numbers 7 set; adjust 對好望遠鏡的距離 duì hǎo wàngyuǎnjìng de jùlí adjust the focus of a telescope 8 mix; add 茶太濃了, 給我對點兒水。 Chá tài nóng le, gěi wǒ duì diǎnr shuǐ. Add some water to the tea, it’s too strong for me. 9 divide into halves 對股劈 duìgǔ pī go halves; split fifty-fifty adjective 1 opposite; opposing See 59556067對岸dui4an4對岸 2 right; correct 猜對了 cāi duìle guess right 對, 就這麼辦。 Duì, jiù zhème bàn. All right, just do it. or Yes, that’s what we’ll do. 你說得很對。 Nǐ shuō de hěn duì. What you say is quite true. or You are quite right. 這事你做得對。 Zhè shì nǐ zuò de duì. You did the right thing. 他今天神色不對。 Tā jīntiān shénsè bùduì. He doesn’t look himself today. adverb mutual; face to face 對罵 duìmà call each other names; curse each other 對飲 duìyǐn (two people) drink together 對坐 duìzuò sit facing each other preposition with regard to; concerning 對健康不利 duì jiànkāng bùlì bad for one’s health; unhealthy 對青少年的教育工作 duì qīng-shàonián de jiàoyù gōngzuò educating young people; education of the young 對這個問題的不同意見 duì zhège wèntí de bùtóng yìjian different views on this question 對犯罪分子實行法律制裁 duì fànzuì fènzǐ shíxíng fǎlǜ zhìcái impose legal sanctions on criminals; punish criminals according to the law 他對父親很尊敬。 Tā duì fùqin hěn zūnjìng. He has great respect for his father. 這錄音機對我來說是夠好的了。 Zhè lùyīnjī duì wǒ láishuō shì gòu hǎo de le. This recorder is good enough for me. measure word pair; couple 一對夫婦 yī duì fūfù a married couple 一對花瓶 yī duì huāpíng a pair of vases

noun 1 ability; capability; skill 技能 jìnéng technical skill 無能 wúnéng incompetent 2 physics energy 波能 bō néng wave energy 風能 fēngnéng wind energy verb 1 can do; be able to; be capable of 他好多了, 能下床了。 Tā hǎo duō le, néng xià chuáng le. He’s much better and can get up now. 她一分鐘能打七十個字。 Tā yī fēnzhōng néng dǎ qīshí ge zì. She can type 70 words a minute. 我幹這個工作能行嗎？ Wǒ gàn zhège gōngzuò néng xíng ma？ Am I really fit for the job? 2 possibly 天這麼晚了, 他能來嗎？ Tiān zhème wǎn le, tā néng lái ma？ It’s already very late. Can he possibly come tonight? 這件事她能一點兒也不知道嗎？ Zhè jiàn shì tā néng yīdiǎnr yě bùzhīdào ma? How could she know nothing of this? or Could she be completely in the dark? 3 [between 不…不 to express obligation, certainty or great probability] 不能不 bùnéngbù must; have to; cannot but 4 may; can; have the permission to 這兒能停車嗎？——能停(不能停)。 Zhèrnéng tíngchē ma? ——néng tíng. Can we park here?—Yes, you can. (No. Parking is forbidden here.) adjective able; capable 她可能呢, 穿的衣服都是自己做的。 Tā kěnéng ne, chuān de yīfu dōu shì zìjǐ zuò de. She’s very clever with her hands and makes all her own clothes.

adjective 1 specified duration of time 兩個月之久 liǎng ge yuè zhī jiǔ for as long as two months 來了有多久？ Lái le yǒu duōjiǔ？ How long have you been here? 2 for a long time; long (opp. 暫) 久疏音問 jiǔshūyīnwèn I have been negligent in keeping up a correspondence (with) 很久以前 Hěn jiǔ yǐqián long ago 我們久不見面了。 Wǒmen jiǔ bù jiànmiàn le. We haven’t seen each other for a long time.

noun (early) morning 從早到晚 cóngzǎodàowǎn from morning till night adjective 1 early; in advance; beforehand 早兩天我還看見他的。 Zǎo liǎng tiān wǒ hái kànjian tā de. I saw him a couple of days ago. 早知如此, 我就不回去了。 Zǎo zhī rúcǐ, wǒ jiù bù huíqu le. If I’d know this beforehand I would not have gone back. 電影離開演還早哩。 Diànyǐng líkāi yǎn hái zǎo li. The film won’t start for a while yet. 火車早到了十分鐘。 Huǒchē zǎo dào le shí fēnzhōng. The train was ten minutes early. 你早點兒來。 Nǐ zǎo diǎnr lái. Come early. 他來得比我早。 Tā lái de bǐ wǒ zǎo. He came earlier than I. 爺爺睡得早。 Yéye shuì de zǎo. Grandfather goes to bed early. 2 polite expression good morning adverb long ago; as early as; for a long time 早在二十世紀初 Zǎo zài èrshí shìjì chū at the beginning of the twentieth century; in the early twentieth century 他早走了。 Tā zǎo zǒu le. He left a long time ago. 我早就想來看你了。 Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng lái kàn nǐ le. I’ve been wanting to see you for a long time. 我早知道了。 Wǒ zǎo zhīdao le. I knew that long ago. or That’s not news to me.

adverb 1 [for an action yet to take place, or contemplated] again; once more; further 再創新紀錄 Zài chuàng xīn jìlù try to set another new record 良機難再。 Liángjī nán zài. Opportunity knocks but once. 青春不再。 Qīngchūnbùzài. One’s youth never returns. 我不能再喝了。 Wǒ bùnéng zài hē le. I mustn’t drink any more. 我還得再去幾次。 Wǒ hái děi zài qù jǐ cì. I have to go a few more times. 我叫他別再來, 可他又來了。 Wǒ jiào tā bié zài lái, kě tā yòu lái le. I told him not to come again, but here he is. 我再也不去了。 Wǒ zài yě bù qù le. I won’t go again. 要是再下雨, 那還得改日子。 Yào shì zài xià yǔ, nà hái děi gǎi rìzi. If it rains again, the date will have to be changed. 有工夫, 請再來玩。 Yǒu gōngfu, qǐng zài lái wán. Please come again whenever you are free. 2 [before adjectives] more; -er 再好不過了。 Zài hǎo bù guò le. It couldn’t be better. 再冷的天我也不怕。 Zài lěng de tiān wǒ yě bù pà. I can stand colder weather than this. 還有再大點兒的嗎？ Háiyǒu zài dà diǎnr de ma？ Have you got a bigger one? 聲音再大一點兒。 shēngyīn zài dà yīdiǎnr. Louder, please. 3 [indicating a continuing situation in conditional or suppositional clauses] 再不走我們就趕不上火車了。 Zài bù zǒu wǒmen jiù gǎn bù shàng huǒchē le. We’ll miss the train if we delay any longer. 再過幾年, 這個村子就要整個變樣了。 Zài guò jǐ nián, zhège cūnzi jiù yào zhěnggè biànyàng le. A few more years and this village will change completely. 4 [for a delayed action, preceded by an expression of time or condition] then; only then 你做完了功課再出去。 Nǐ zuò wán le gōngkè zài chūqu. Finish your homework before you go out. 先到張家, 再到李家。 Xiān dào zhāng jiā, zài dào lǐ jiā. First go to the Zhangs’, and then to the Lis’. 雨住了再走吧。 Yǔ zhù le zài zǒu ba. Let’s leave when the rain stops. 這件事等明年再說。 Zhè jiàn shì děng míngnián zàishuō. This business can keep till next year. 5 in addition; on top of that 到會的有教職員工, 再就是學生代表。 Dàohuì de yǒu jiàozhíyuángōng, zài jiù shì xuésheng dàibiǎo. Present at the meeting were faculty, administration, and staff, and also student representatives. 6 [used correlatively with 也, followed by a negative expression] no matter how...still (not) 他再賣力也升不了職。 Tā zài màilì yě shēngbuliǎo zhí. No matter how hard he works, he’ll never get promoted. 你再勸他也沒有用。 Nǐ zài quàn tā yě méiyǒu yòng. Try as you may, you will never persuade him.

adjective 1 true; real; genuine (opp. 假,偽) 我真的要走了。 Wǒ zhēn de yào zǒu le. It’s true I’m leaving. 這幅宋人的畫是真的。 Zhè fú Sòng rén de huà shì zhēn de. This is a genuine Song painting. 2 clear; unmistakable 字音咬得真 zìyīn yǎo de zhēn pronounce words distinctly 你看得真麼？ Nǐ kàn de zhēn me？ Can you see clearly? adverb really; truly; indeed 真有你的！ Zhēn yǒu nǐ de! That was a smart! 他真信了。 Tā zhēn xìn le. He actually believed it. 你真不害臊。 Nǐ zhēn bù hàisào. You’ve got some nerve! 我真不知道。 Wǒ zhēn bù zhīdao. I really don’t know. 演出真精彩。 yǎnchū zhēn jīngcǎi. The performance was just splendid. 時間過得真快。 Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài. How time flies! 這家伙真能說。 Zhè jiāhuo zhēn néng shuō. That fellow is very glib. 你通過了考試, 真行！ Nǐ tōngguò le kǎoshì, zhēn xíng! You’ve passed the exams—good for you! 給你添了不少麻煩, 真過意不去。 Gěi nǐ tiān le bùshǎo máfan, zhēn guòyìbùqù. I’m very sorry to have put you to so much trouble. noun 1 abbreviation calligraphy regular script 2 portrait; image; exact copy of sth. 寫真 xiězhēn portrait 傳真 chuánzhēn fax 3 literary natural instincts (or character, disposition); nature; inherent quality; origin See 59954659返璞歸真fan3pu2gui1zhen1返璞歸真
noun computer 筆記本電腦 bǐjìběndiànnǎo laptop (computer); notebook

verb 1 can; may 這間屋子可以住四個人。 Zhè jiān wūzi kěyǐ zhù sì ge rén. This room can accommodate four people. 2 be worth (doing) 這個展覽我覺得可以一看。 zhège zhǎnlǎn wǒ juédekěyǐ yī kàn. I think the exhibition is worth a visit. 3 [indicating permission] can; may 你可以走了。 Nǐ kěyǐ zǒu le. You may go. 這裡不可以吸煙。 Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ xīyān. Smoking is not allowed here. or You can’t smoke here. adjective colloquial 1 passable; not bad 這篇文章寫得還可以。 Zhè piān wénzhāng xiě de hái kěyǐ. This article is pretty good. 2 terrible; awful 你這張嘴真可以啊！ Nǐ zhè zhāngzuǐ zhēn kěyǐ a! What a sharp tongue you’ve got! 他今天忙得真可以。 Tā jīntiān máng de zhēn kěyǐ. He’s awfully busy today.

verb 1 attend class; go to class (opp. 下課) 你昨天怎麼沒來上課？ Nǐ zuótiān zěnme méi lái shàngkè？ Why didn’t you come to class yesterday? 今天下午我們不上課。 Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒmen bù shàngkè. We have no classes this afternoon. 2 conduct a class; give a lesson (or lecture) 八點開始上課。 bā diǎn kāishǐ shàngkè. Classes begin at 8.
noun school; educational institution 高等學校 gāoděng xuéxiào institution of higher learning 師範學校 shīfàn xuéxiào teachers’ (or normal) school 專業學校 zhuānyè xuéxiào specialized (or vocational) school
noun Chinese (language or writing) (opp. 外文) 中文書刊 Zhōngwén shūkān books and magazines in Chinese 中文系 Zhōngwénxì Chinese department 中文信息處理 Zhōngwén xìnxī chǔlǐ Chinese data processing

noun 1 fellow student; schoolmate 2 [addressing a student] verb (-//-) attend the same school; be a schoolmate of 我和他同過三年學。 Wǒ hé tā tóng guò sān nián xué. He and I studied in the same school for three years. or We were schoolmates for three years.
noun 1 teacher; schoolmaster 2 courteous [in direct address] professor; Mr. (or Mrs., Miss, Ms.) 數學老師 shùxué lǎoshī maths master (or mistress) 老師再見！ lǎoshī zàijiàn Good-bye, Sir (or Madam, Miss)!

verb 1 buy; purchase 買東西 Mǎi dōngxi buy things; go shopping 太貴了, 買不起。 Tài guì le, mǎi bù qǐ. It’s too expensive. I can’t afford it. 2 buy off; bribe See 66410979買官mai3guan1買官 noun (Mǎi) a surname

adjective 1 busy; fully occupied (opp. 閑) 忙裡忙外 mánglǐ-mángwài bustle around 忙於工作 máng yú gōngzuò busy working 忙得團團轉 Máng de tuántuánzhuàn run round in circles; extremely busy 忙了一整天 máng le yī zhěngtiān be busy all day 2 imperative; anxious 不慌不忙 bùhuāngbùmáng calm; unhurried verb 1 hurry; hasten; make haste 忙什麼, 再坐一會兒吧。 máng shénme, zài zuò yīhuìr ba. What’s the hurry? Stay a bit longer. 別忙於下結論。 Bié mángyú xià jiélùn. Don’t jump to conclusions. 2 work; do 忙完一天工作 Máng wán yī tiān gōngzuò finish a long day’s work 他在忙論文。 Tā zài máng lùnwén. He’s working on a paper. 我一個人忙不過來。 Wǒ yī ge rén máng bù guòlai. I can’t manage all this by myself.

noun 1 student; pupil 醫科學生 yīkē xuésheng medical student 學生勤奮學習, 就是對老師的報答。 xuésheng qínfèn xuéxí, jiùshì duì lǎoshī de bàodá. A diligent scholar, and the master paid. 2 disciple; follower 3 dialect boy; lad
noun 1 university; college 2 (Dàxué) The Great Learning See 30836224四書si4shu1四書

noun 1 word; character 你這個字寫得不對。 Nǐ zhège zì xiě de bù duì. You wrote this character wrong. See 78122467字形zi4xing2字形;78123491字義zi4yi4 字義 2 pronunciation (of a word or character) 說話字字清楚 Shuōhuà zìzì qīngchu pronounce every word clearly; have clear articulation 3 form of a written or printed character; style of handwriting; print type 柳字 liǔ zì style of calligraphy of Liu Gongquan (柳公權, 778-865) 篆字 zhuànzì seal character 黑體字 hēitǐzì boldface type 他寫得一手好字。 Tā xiě de yī shǒu hǎo zì. He writes a good hand. or He has good handwriting. 4 scripts; writings 專藏字, 不藏畫 Zhuān cáng zì, bù cáng huà only collect calligraphy, not paintings 5 receipt; written pledge 收到款子, 寫個字兒給他。 Shōudào kuǎnzi, xiě ge zìr gěi tā. Write him a receipt when you get the money. 6 man's style name taken at the age of twenty 諸葛亮字孔明。 Zhūgě Liàng zì Kǒngmíng. Zhuge Liang styled himself Kongming. 7 dated (of a girl) be betrothed 未字 wèi zì not yet betrothed See 19547648待字閨中dai4zi4gui1zhong1待字閨中 8 common name for scale of electric meter, water meter, etc.

noun 1 pen, pencil, or writing brush 擱筆 gēbǐ lay down one’s pen; finish writing 提筆 tíbǐ put pen to paper; start writing 一管筆 yī guǎn bǐ a writing (or painting) brush 一支筆 yì zhī bǐ a pen (or pencil) 2 technique of writing, calligraphy, or drawing 敗筆 bàibǐ poor expression in otherwise good writing; fly in the ointment 文筆 wénbǐ style of writing literary style 神來之筆 shénláizhībǐ stroke of genius; inspired writing 3 stroke; touch “天”字有四筆。 “tiān” zì yǒu sì bǐ. The character 天 has four strokes. 你給他寫信時, 替我帶一筆。 Nǐ gěi tā xiěxìn shí, tì wǒ dài yī bǐ. Please remember me to him when you write. 這裡再添幾筆, 情節就更生動了。 Zhèlǐ zài tiān jǐ bǐ, qíngjié jiù gèng shēngdòng le. Add a few touches here and the episode will be more lively. verb literary write 筆之於書 bǐzhīyúshū put down in black and white; write down; record measure word 1 [for sums of money, financial accounts, debts, etc.] 一筆錢 yī bǐ qián a sum of money; a fund 有三筆賬要算 Yǒu sān bǐ zhàng yào suàn have three scores to settle 2 [for skill in calligraphy or painting] 能畫幾筆山水畫 néng huà jǐ bǐ shānshuǐhuà be a landscape painter of sorts 寫得一筆好字 xiě de yī bǐ hǎo zì write a good hand; good penmanship

noun 1 learning; knowledge 博學 bóxué learned; erudite 2 subject of study; branch of learning 數學 shùxué mathematics 文學 wénxué literature 3 school; college 大學 dàxué university; college 上學 shàngxué go to school; attend school; be at school verb 1 study; learn 學外語 xué wàiyǔ learn (or study) a foreign language 學文化 xué wénhuà acquire an elementary education; learn to read and write 學先進 xué xiānjìn emulate the advanced 學游泳 xué yóuyǒng learn swimming 把新技術學到手 bǎ xīn jìshù xué dào shǒu master a new skill 學而不化, 不如不學。 xué ér bù huà, bùrú bù xué. Better unlearned than ill-learned. 學而不思則罔；思而不學則殆。(《論語》) xué ér bù sī zé wǎng; sī ér bù xué zé dài. Learning without thought means labour lost; thought without learning is perilous. 2 imitate; mimic 這孩子學他爸爸走路的樣子。 Zhè háizi xué tā bàba zǒulù de yàngzi. The boy imitates his father’s way of walking.

verb 1 ask; inquire (opp. 答) 問個問題 wèn ge wèntí ask (or pose) a question 不懂就問。 Bù dǒng jiù wèn. Ask when you don’t know. 他在食堂問了一下開飯的時間。 Tā zài shítáng wèn le yīxià kāifàn de shíjiān. adjective 1 old; aged (opp. 少, 幼) 老馬 lǎo mǎ old horse 老樹 lǎoshù old tree 老婦人 lǎofùrén old woman 顯老 xiǎnlǎo look old for one’s age 不顯老 bù xiǎn lǎo bear (or carry) one’s age well 逐年見老 zhúnián jiànlǎo show signs of age year by year 我老了, 走路走不快了。 Wǒ lǎo le, zǒulù zǒu bù kuài le. I like steak quite well-done. 7 experienced; veteran; seasoned 老作家 Lǎo zuòjiā veteran writer 8 (of certain colours) dark 老綠 lǎo lǜ dark green 老紅 lǎo hóng dark red 這件上衣顏色太老了。 Zhè jiàn shàngyī yánsè tài lǎo le. This jacket is too dark. 9 colloquial last born; youngest 老閨女 lǎoguīnü youngest daughter noun 1 senior person; old people; venerable old man 敬老 jìnglǎo show respect for the aged 徐老 xú lǎo revered old Xu 養老院 yǎnglǎoyuàn home for the aged; senior citizens’ home 2 (Lǎo) a surname verb dialect euphemistic [followed by 了 le, usu. of an old person] pass away; die 王大爺前天老了。 wáng dàye qiántiān lǎo le. I haven’t seen you for ages. 2 always; all the time 老管閒 lǎo guǎn xiánshì be always meddling 老想不開 lǎo xiǎngbùkāi keep on worrying; cannot put sth. out of one’s mind 他老那麼幹。 Tā lǎo nàme gàn. He does it all the time. 3 very 老遠 lǎoyuǎn far away 老早 lǎozǎo very early 老長的鬍子 lǎo cháng de húzi very long beard 太陽已經老高了。 Tàiyáng yǐjing lǎo gāo le. The sun is already high. affix 1 [in terms of address before the surnames of acquaintances or friends to indicate intimacy or informality] 老王 lǎo wáng Lao Wang 2 [in kinship terms before numerals to indicate order of seniority] 老大 lǎodà eldest; number one (among sons, daughters, brothers, or sisters) 老二 lǎo'èr number two 老么 lǎoyāo youngest 3 [in certain names of animals and plants] See 25432576老虎lao3hu3老虎;25469696老玉米lao3yu4mi5 老玉米

adjective 1 good; fine; nice (opp. 壞) 好人 hǎorén nice person 祖國的好兒子 Zǔguó de hǎo érzi worthy (or fine) son of our country 莊稼長得真好。 Zhuāngjia zhǎng de zhēn hǎo. The crops are growing well. 2 friendly; kind 好朋友 Hǎo péngyou good (or great) friend 他們對我真好。 Tāmen duì wǒ zhēn hǎo. They are really kind to me. 倆孩子又好了。 Liǎ háizi yòu hǎo le. The two children are friends again. 3 be in good health; get well 你好哇！ Nǐ hǎo wa! How are you? 我的病好了。 Wǒ de bìng hǎo le. I’m well (or all right) now. 4 be ready; done 飯好了。 Fàn hǎo le. The food (or rice) is ready. 5 [after verbs to indicate finishing or finishing satisfactorily] 我把他的病治好了。 Wǒ bǎ tā de bìng zhì hǎo le. I cured his illness. 這件事他做不好。 Zhè jiàn shì tā zuò bù hǎo. He can’t do this job well. 坐好吧, 要開會了。 Zuò hǎo ba, yào kāihuì le. Take your seats, please. The meeting is going to begin. 6 [before verbs to denote what is satisfying] good; easy 好吃 hǎochī good to eat—delicious 暖瓶放在這兒好拿。 Nuǎnpíng fàng zài zhèr hǎo ná. It’s handy to have the thermos here. 這本書可不好買。 Zhè běn shū kě bù hǎo mǎi. This book is not easily available. 這個問題好回答。 Zhège wèntí hǎo huídá. This question is easy to answer. 7 [at the beginning of a sentence or clause, to express agreement, disapproval, surprise, etc.] 好, 就這麼辦。 Hǎo, jiù zhème bàn. OK, it’s settled. 好了, 不要再說了。 Hǎo le, bùyào zài shuō le. All right, no need to say any more. 好！ 那得多少錢！ Hǎo! Nà dé duōshao qián! Gosh! How much money will that cost! 好, 這下可麻煩了。 Hǎo, zhè xià kě máfan le. Well, we’re in for trouble now. adverb 1 [before adjectives with exclamatory force] very; quite; so 好大的工程！ Hǎo dà de gōngchéng! What a huge project! 你好大膽子。 Nǐ hǎo dà dǎnzi. You are so daring. 2 dialect [before adjectives in the same way as 多] to what extent; how 火車站離這兒好遠？ Huǒchēzhàn lí zhèr hǎo yuǎn？ How far is the railway station from here? 3 [before indefinite time or numbers] quite 好半天 hǎobàntiān quite a while 好幾個 hǎojǐgè quite a few 好幾天 hǎojǐtiān quite a few days verb produce favourable effects 這事可好了他了。 Zhè shì kě hǎo le tā le. This will benefit him. auxiliary 1 the better to; in order to; so that 把她的地址告訴我, 我好找她。 Bǎ tā de dìzhǐ gàosu wǒ, wǒ hǎo zhǎo tā. Tell me her address so that I can go and see her. 今兒早點睡, 明兒好早起趕火車。 Jīnr zǎodiǎn shuì, míngr hǎo zǎoqǐ gǎn huǒchē. Let’s turn in early, so as to get up early tomorrow to catch the train. 2 dialect may; can; should 我好進來嗎？ Wǒ hǎo jìnlai ma？ May I come in? 時間不早了, 你好走了。 Shíjiān bù zǎo le, nǐhǎo zǒu le. verb 1 divide; separate; part (opp. 合) 分組討論 fēnzǔ tǎolùn hold discussions in groups 分階段實行 Fēn jiēduàn shíxíng carry out stage by stage 一年分四季。 Yī nián fēn sìjì. The year is divided into four seasons. 這藥分三次吃。 Zhè yào fēn sān cì chī. This medicine is to be taken in three separate doses. 他的頭髮往右邊分。 Tā de tóufa wǎng yòubianfēn. A river divides the county town into two parts. 2 distribute; assign; allot 她分到了一套新房子。 Tā fēn dào le yī tào xīn fángzi. She has been allotted a new flat. 把這個任務分給我們吧。 Bǎ zhège rènwu fēn gěi wǒmen ba. Assign (or Give) this task to us, please. 音樂會的票都已經分完了。 Yīnyuèhuì de piào dōu yǐjing fēn wán le. The tickets for the concert have all been distributed. 大學畢業後, 他就分到外交部工作。 Dàxué bìyè hòu, tājiù fēn dào Wàijiāobù gōngzuò. After his graduation from college, he was assigned to work at the Foreign Ministry. 3 distinguish; differentiate 是非不分 shìfēibùfēn make no distinction between right and wrong 現在還分不出個勝負來。 Xiànzài hái fēn bù chū ge shèng-fù lái. It’s still quite impossible to tell who’ll win. 這對雙胞胎長得一模一樣, 簡直分不出誰是誰。 Zhè duì shuāngbāotāi zhǎng de yīmúyīyàng, jiǎnzhí fēn bù chū shuí shì shuí. The twins look so much alike that you can hardly tell them apart. adjective branch (of an organization) 新華社上海分社 Xīnhuáshè Shànghǎi fēnshè the Shanghai Branch of the Xinhua News Agency measure word 1 fraction 約分 yuēfēn reduction of a fraction 2 [in spoken forms of fractions and percentages] 三分之一 sānfēn zhīyī one-third 十分之七 shífēn zhī qī seven-tenths 百分之四 bǎifēn zhī sì four per cent 3 one tenth (of certain units of the metric system) 4 fen (of the traditional system of weights and measures) a a traditional unit of length, equal to 0.01 chi (市尺), and equivalent to 0.333 centimetre or 0.131 inch b a traditional unit of weight, equal to 0.001 jin (市斤), and equivalent to 0.5 gram or 0.175 ounce c a traditional unit of area, equal to 0.1 mu (市畝) and equivalent to 0.667 acre or 79.73 square yards d a unit of weight equal to 0.1 qian (錢) or 0.01 liang (兩) 5 fen (equal to one hundredth of a yuan (元)) 六元三角五分 liù yuán sānjiǎo wǔfēn 6.35 yuan 6 minute (equal to one sixtieth of an hour) 7 minute (equal to one sixtieth of a degree of angle or arc) 成 36 度 30分角 chéng 36 dù 30fēn jiǎo form an angle of 36 degrees 30 minutes (36°30′) 東經 129 度 15分 dōngjīng 129 dù 15 fēn 129 degrees 15 minutes (129°15′) east longitude 8 a unit of interest rate a 1% monthly interest 月利一分二釐. yuèlì yī fēn èr lí 1.2% monthly interest b 10% annual interest 年利一分二釐. niánlì yī fēn èr lí 12% annual interest 9 point; mark 六十分為及格。 Liùshí fēnwéi jígé. Sixty is the passing mark. 甲隊罰球連得二分。 Jiǎ duì fáqiú lián de èrfēn. Team A scored two successive points by free throws. 他今天考試得了一百分。 Tā jīntiān kǎoshì déle yībǎi fēn. He got full marks in today’s exam. 10 [for nonphysical things] one-tenth 七分成績, 三分錯誤 Qī fēn chéngjì, sānfēn cuòwù 70 per cent achievements, 30 per cent mistakes 他已經有三分醉了。 Tā yǐjing yǒu sānfēn zuì le. He’s a bit tipsy already. 我的牙痛好了幾分。 Wǒ de yátòng hǎo le jǐ fēn. My toothache has been partly relieved. 這消息使我多了一分希望。 Zhè xiāoxi shǐ wǒ duō le yī fēn xīwàng. The news raised my hopes a little.

noun 1 drop (of liquid) 雨點兒 yǔdiǎnr raindrop 2 spot; dot; speck 墨點兒 mòdiǎnr ink spots 3 dot stroke (in Chinese characters) 4 mathematics point 兩點成一直線。 Liǎng diǎn chéng yī zhíxiàn. A straight line is formed by connecting two points. 5 decimal point; point 三點兒五 Sāndiǎnr wǔ three point five (3.5) 6 place; point 突破一點 tūpò yīdiǎn make a breakthrough at one point 7 aspect; feature 從這點上看 cóng zhè diǎn shàng kàn viewed from this aspect 對這一點沒人懷疑。 Duì zhè yīdiǎn méi rén huáiyí. The Shanghai Composite Index ended up 44 points. verb 1 place a dot 點三個點兒表示省略 diǎn sān ge diǎnr biǎoshì shěnglüè a sequence of three dots marks an omission 2 touch on very briefly; skim 他用篙一點就把船撐開了。 Tā yòng gāo yīdiǎn jiù bǎ chuán chēng kāi le. Human knowledge cannot be separated from practice. 2 [for items] 我有幾點不成熟的想法。 Wǒ yǒu jǐ diǎn bù chéngshú de xiǎngfa. measure word 1 [before nouns without special measure words of their own] 兩個星期 liǎng gè xīngqī two weeks; a fortnight 三個蘋果 sān gè píngguǒ three apples 一個故事 yī gè gùshi a story 2 [used to replace certain measure words] 一個工廠 Yī gè gōngchǎng a factory 一個學校 yī gè xuéxiào a school 3 [before an approximate number] 哥兒倆也不過差個兩三歲。 Gērliǎ yě bùguò chà gè liǎng sān suì. verb 1 live; reside; stay 住城外 Zhù chéngwài live in the suburbs 住旅館 zhù lǚguǎn stay at a hotel 對面沒人住。 Duìmiàn méi rén zhù. Nobody lives opposite me. 他住在北京。 Tā zhù zài Běijīng. The rain has stopped. 等風住了再走。 Děng fēng zhù le zài zǒu. Go when the wind drops. 3 [after a verb] firmly; to a stop 支持不住 zhīchíbuzhù cannot withstand; cannot hold out 拿住了, 別撒手。 Ná zhù le, bié sāshǒu. Hold tight and don’t let go. 她擋住了我的去路。 Tā dǎngzhù le wǒ de qù lù. She blocked my way. 這一下你可把我問住了。 Zhè yī xià nǐ kě bǎ wǒ wèn zhù le. You’ve got me there. or I don’t know what to say. 聽到這個消息我一下子愣住了。 Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi wǒ yīxiàzi lèng zhù le. I was struck dumb at the news. 悠揚的小提琴聲把我吸引住了。 Yōuyáng de xiǎotíqín shēng bǎ wǒ xīyǐn zhù le. The beautiful notes of a violin held me spellbound.

verb 1 come (to); arrive 來得不巧 Láide bùqiǎo come at an unsuitable time (or moment) 來得正好 láide zhènghǎo come in good time; come just at the right time 就來！ jiù lái! I’m coming. 快來！ Kuài lái! Come along! 來客人了。 Lái kèren le. We have a guest. 客人來了。 Kèren lái le. The guests are here. 他今天來過兩次。 Tā jīntiān lái guò liǎng cì. He came twice today. 他已經來了。 Tā yǐjinglái le. He has already come. 她明天來北京。 Tā míngtiān lái Běijīng. She is coming to Beijing tomorrow. 有空來玩。 Yǒukòng lái wán. Come round when you have time. 遠處來了一條小船。 Yuǎnchù lái le yī tiáo xiǎochuán. A small boat came into view in the distance. 2 cause to come; happen; crop up; take place 問題來了。 Wèntí lái le. A problem has come up. 這事兒怎麼來的？ Zhè shìr zěnme lái de？ How did it come about? 3 obtain; get 這差事來得不容易。 Zhè chāishilái de bù róngyì. This job is hard to come by. 4 [as a substitute for some other verb] 來份糖醋魚。 lái fèn tángcùyú. A sweet-and-sour fish, please. 你來塊糖。 Nǐ lái kuài táng. Have some candy. 再來一個！ Zàilái yī ge! [call for another performance] Encore! 慢慢兒來, 別忙。 Mànmànr lái, bié máng. Take it easy. No hurry. 我累了, 你來吧。 Wǒ lèi le, nǐ lái ba. I’m tired. Why don’t you take over (or carry on). 咱們來一盤棋。 Zánmenlái yī pán qí. Let’s have a game of chess. 你歇歇, 讓我來吧。 Nǐ xiēxie, ràng wǒ lái ba. You take a rest. Let me do it. 我自己來吧, 別客氣。 Wǒ zìjǐ lái ba, bié kèqi. Please don’t bother. I’ll do it myself. 我們打籃球, 你來不來？ Wǒmen dǎ lánqiú, nǐ lái bù lái？ We’re going to play basketball. Will you join in? 5 [with 得 or 不, indicating possibility or impossibility, capability or incapability] 上海話我說不來。 Shànghǎi huà wǒ shuō bù lái. I don’t speak Shanghai dialect. 我吃不來四川菜。 Wǒ chī bù lái Sìchuān cài. I can’t get used to Sichuan cuisine. 西餐我吃得來。 Xīcān wǒ chī de lái. Western food suits me all right. 這道題我做不來。 Zhè dào tí wǒ zuò bù lái. I can’t do this problem. 這個歌我唱得來。 Zhège gē wǒ chàng de lái. I can sing this song. 6 [before a verb, indicating an intended or suggested action] 你來試試。 Nǐ lái shìshi. Have a try. 我來說兩句。 Wǒ láishuō liǎng jù. Let me say a few words. 大家來想辦法。 Dàjiā lái xiǎng bànfǎ. Let’s think of a way (to solve the problem). or Let’s put our heads together and see how to do it. 7 [after a verb or verbal expression] come in order to 他回家探親來了。 Tā huíjiā tànqīn lái le. He’s come home to see his parents. 我們道喜來了。 Wǒmen dàoxǐ lái le. We’ve come to congratulate you (or offer our congratulations). 8 [between two verbs or verbal expressions to indicate the purpose of the former] in order to 想辦法來解決問題 Xiǎng bànfǎ lái jiějué wèntí think of a way to solve the problem 你又能用什麼理由來說服他呢？ Nǐ yòu néng yòng shénme lǐyóu lái shuōfú tā ne？ And what arguments can you use to convince him? 9 (of electricity, tap water, gas, etc.) be on again 來電了。 lái diàn le. The power is on again. 來水了。 lái shuǐ le. There’s running water again. auxiliary 1 colloquial [at the end of a sentence to indicate what has happened in the past, same as 來著] 你這是何苦來？ Nǐ zhè shì hékǔlái? Why did you do that (and made yourself unhappy)? 2 [after a time expression, indicating a period of time that extends from the past up to the present] ever since 幾天來 jǐ tiān lái for the last few days 一年來 yī nián lái during the past year 3 [after a round number or after a numeral plus a measure] approximately; about; around; round 二十來個 èrshí lái ge about 20 四十來歲 sìshí lái suì round 40 (years old) 十來塊錢 shí lái kuài qián somewhere over 10 yuan 兩米來高 liǎng mǐ lái gāo about two metres high 百十來裡地 bǎishí lái lǐ dì a distance of about 100 li 4 [after the numerals 一, 二, and 三, indicating points in an explanation or argument] 我不要, 一來我不喜歡, 二來我也沒錢。 Wǒ bùyào, yī lái wǒ bù xǐhuan, èr lái wǒ yě méiqián. I don’t want it. In the first place, I don’t like it; in the second place, I don’t have the money. adjective future; coming; next 來月 láiyuè coming month noun (Lái) a surname auxiliary [as a syllable filler in folk ballads] 正月裡來是新春。 Zhēngyuè lǐ lái shì xīnchūn. The first month is the beginning of spring. 你敲鑼來我打鼓。 Nǐ qiāoluó lái wǒ dǎgǔ. You beat the gong while I play the drum.

verb 1 [used like “be” before nouns or pronouns to identify, describe or amplify the subject] 我是醫生。 wǒ shì yīshēng. I am a doctor. 《阿Ｑ正傳》的作者是魯迅。 《Ā Q Zhèng Zhuàn》 de zuòshì shì Lǔ Xùn. The author of The True Story of Ah Q is Lu Xun. 他真心愛的是你。 Tā zhēn xīn'ài de shì nǐ. You are the girl he truly loves. 她還是一身中學生打扮。 Tā háishì yī shēn zhōngxuéshēng dǎban. She still dresses like a high school girl. 2 [after nouns denoting place or position to express existence] 遍地是鮮花。 Biàn dì shì xiānhuā. The place is covered with flowers. 前面是一片稻田。 Qiánmian shì yī piàn dàotián. There is a stretch of rice fields ahead. 他滿身是汗。 Tā mǎnshēn shì hàn. He is sweating all over. 3 [with 的 at the end of the sentence, to indicate category, characteristic, etc.] 我是教書的。 Wǒ shì jiāoshū de. I am a teacher. 那兒的房屋是木頭的。 Nàr de fángwū shì mùtou de. The houses there are built of wood. 馬路邊凈是看熱鬧的。 Mǎlù biān jìng shì kàn rènao de. The street was crowded with people watching the excitement. 4 [emphasizing a certain part of a sentence] a [before the subject to stress it] 是誰告訴你的？ Shì shuí gàosu nǐ de？ Who told you? 花瓶是我妹妹摔破的。 Huāpíng shì wǒ mèimei shuāi pò de. It was my sister who broke the vase. b [after a verb or adjective plus 的, to stress the predicate] 說的正是你。 Shuō de zhèngshì nǐ. It’s you we are talking about. 可惜的是浪費了這麼多時間。 Kěxī deshì làngfèi le zhème duō shíjiān. It’s a pity we’ve wasted so much time. 麻煩的是他生病來不了。 Máfan de shì tā shēngbìng láibuliǎo. The trouble is he’s taken ill and can’t come. c [before the object, adverbial, etc. to be stressed] 我是專程去看老王的。 Wǒ shì zhuānchéng qù kàn lǎo wáng de. I made a special trip to see Lao Wang. 他們看的是話劇, 不是電影。 Tāmen kàn de shì huàjù, bù shì diànyǐng. They went to see a play, not a film. or What they saw was a play, not a film. 好好的一次郊遊搞成這樣子, 都是你！ Hǎo hǎo de yī cì jiāoyóu gǎo chéng zhè yàngzi, dōu shì nǐ! It was all your fault the outing became such a flop. d [pronounced with stress; indicating certainty] 他是去了。 Tā shì qù le. He did go. 天氣是冷。 Tiānqì shì lěng. It is cold indeed. 他的工作效率是高。 Tā de gōngzuò xiàolǜ shì gāo. He is really efficient. 5 be just right 這場雨下的是時候。 Zhè cháng yǔ xià de shì shíhou. This rain has come at just the right time. 工具放的不是地方。 Gōngjù fàng de bù shì dìfāng. The tools are not put in the right place. 6 [before nouns at the beginning of the sentence, followed by 都 or 就] every; all; any 是公眾的事, 大家都要關心。 Shì gōngzhòng de shì, dàjiā dōu yào guānxīn. Whatever concerns the public concerns us all. 是什麼樣的老師, 就教出什麼樣的學生。 Shì shénmeyàng de lǎoshī, jiù jiào chū shénmeyàng de xuésheng. Like teacher, like student. 是什麼種子, 就開出什麼花。 Shì shénme zhǒngzi, jiù kāi chū shénme huā. Each kind of seed produces its own flowers. 7 [between two identical words] a [used together with 就 or 總 to indicate actuality] 事實總是事實, 誰也否認不了的。 Shìshí zǒng shì shìshí, shuí yě fǒurèn bùliǎo de. Facts are facts, and no one can deny them. 不懂就是不懂, 不要裝懂。 Bù dǒng jiù shì bù dǒng, bùyào zhuāng dǒng. If you don’t know, you don’t know, don’t pretend. b [in a clause of concession] 工作忙是忙, 可是大家很愉快。 Gōngzuò máng shì máng, kě shì dàjiā hěn yúkuài. We are busy to be sure, but every one is very happy. 詩是好詩, 就是長了點兒。 Shī shì hǎo shī, jiùshì cháng le diǎnr. It is a good poem all right, but it’s a bit too long. 這東西舊是舊, 但還可以用。 Zhè dōngxi jiù shì jiù, dàn hái kěyǐ yòng. Yes, it’s old, but it can still be used. c [in two parallel clauses to indicate mutual exclusiveness] 他是他, 我是我, 我們毫不相干。 Tā shì tā, wǒ shì wǒ, wǒmen háobùxiānggān. He is he, I am I; we have nothing to do with each other. d [in two or three parallel clauses to indicate thoroughness or excellence of performance] 他演得真好, 表情是表情, 身段是身段, 做功是做功。 Tā yǎn de zhēn hǎo, biǎoqíng shì biǎoqíng, shēnduàn shì shēnduàn, zuògōng shì zuò gōng. He is a marvellous actor; his expressions, movements, and gestures are the best. 8 [in yes-no questions] 你是不是明天去游泳？ (= 你是明天去游泳不是？) Nǐ shì bù shì míngtiān qù yóuyǒng？ (or) nǐ shì míngtiān qù yóuyǒng bù shì？ Are you going swimming tomorrow? 9 [in alternative questions] 你坐火車呢, 還是坐汽車？ Nǐ zuò huǒchē ne, hái shì zuò qìchē? Are you going by train or by bus? 這件事是真是假, 誰也搞不清。 Zhè jiàn shì shì zhēn shì jiǎ, shuí yě gǎo bù qīng. Nobody knows whether it’s true or not. verb 1 [in affirmative answers] yes; right 是, 我就去。 Shì, wǒ jiù qù. Yes, I’ll go right away. 是, 我們一定完成任務。 Shì, wǒmen yīdìng wánchéng rènwu. Right, we will complete the task. 2 literary praise; justify See 30253568是古非今shi4gu3fei1jin1是古非今 adjective correct; right 你說得是。 Nǐ shuō de shì. What you said is right. or You are quite right. 應當早做準備才是。 Yīngdāng zǎo zuò zhǔnbèi cái shì. Preparing early is the right thing to do. or It’s right to prepare early. noun right (opp. 非) See 30252288是非shi4fei1是非 pronoun literary this; that 如是 rúshì like this 由是可知 Yóu shì kězhī from this you can see 是日天氣晴朗。 Shì rì tiānqì qínglǎng. It was fine that day. or It was a fine day.

noun 1 side (of a geometrical figure) 三角形的一邊 Sānjiǎoxíng de yībiān one side of a triangle 2 side; margin; edge; brim; rim 碗邊兒 wǎn biānr rim of a bowl 寬邊草帽 kuān biān cǎomào broad-brimmed hat 田邊地頭 tián biān dìtóu edges of the fields 湖邊那座揚水站 hú biān nà zuò yángshuǐzhàn pumping station on the shore of the lake 每頁邊上的批註 měi yè biānshàng de pīzhù notes in the margin on every page 襯衣的邊兒 chènyī debiān r hem of a shirt 街道兩邊 jiēdào liǎngbiān both sides of the street 3 border; frontier; boundary See 17552896邊城bian1cheng2邊城 4 limit; bound 不著邊兒 bù zhe biān r not to the point; beside the point; miss the point 一望無邊 yīwàngwúbiān stretch as far as the eye can see; boundless 外層空間沒個邊兒。 Wài céng kōngjiān méi ge biānr. That’s just absurd. or The remark missed the point. 5 place next to; by the side of 坐在窗邊 zuò zài chuāng biān sit by the window 放本字典在手邊 fàng běn zìdiǎn zài shǒu biān keep a dictionary at hand; have a dictionary near 6 part; side 雙邊協定 shuāngbiān xiédìng bilateral agreement 7 [after numerals or words indicating time] close to; near 活到六十邊 huó dào liùshí biān close to (or getting on for) sixty 8 (Biān) a surname adverb [used with two verbs to indicate the simultaneous progression or development of two actions] 邊讀邊議 biān dú biān yì read and discuss as one goes along 邊幹邊學 biāngàn-biānxué learn while working; learn on the job 邊哭邊說 biān kū biān shuō speak with sobs 邊發展邊鞏固 biān fāzhǎn biān gǒnggù expand while consolidating 他邊唱歌邊工作。 Tā biān chànggē biān gōngzuò. He sang as he worked.

noun 1 ice 結冰 jiébīng freeze; ice up 水凍成冰。 shuǐ dòng chéng bīng. Water freezes into ice. 2 sth. resembling ice 冰糖 bīngtáng rock candy verb 1 put on ice; freeze; chill 把那瓶啤酒冰上。 Bǎ nà píng píjiǔ bīng shàng. Chill the bottle of beer. 2 feel cold 這水冰手。 Zhè shuǐ bīng shǒu. This water is freezing cold.
noun dumpling 水餃 shuǐjiǎo boiled dumplings 蝦餃 xiājiǎo dumplings with shrimp stuffing

noun 1 wheat flour; flour 大米麵 dà mǐmiàn rice flour 2 powder 藥麵兒 yàomiànr medicinal powder 胡椒麵兒 hújiāomiànr ground pepper 3 noodles 一碗麵 yī wǎn miàn a bowl of noodles adjective dialect mealy; soft and floury 這塊白薯真麵。 Zhè kuài báishǔ zhēn miàn. This sweet potato is very mealy.

noun 1 original meaning hot water; boiling water 溫湯浸種 wēntāng jìnzhǒng hot water treatment of seeds 2 [usu. in place names] hot springs 3 water used for boiling sth. 姜湯 jiāngtāng ginger tea 餃子湯 jiǎozi tāng jiaozi water; dumpling soup 4 soup; broth 雞湯 jītāng chicken soup 三菜一湯 sān cài yī tāng one soup and three other courses 喝點兒湯吧。 Hē diǎnr tāng ba. Have some soup. 5 medicine a liquid preparation of medicinal herbs; decoction 柴胡湯 Cháihú tāng a decoction of Chinese thorowax root (with other ingredients) 6 (Tāng) a surname
noun steamed stuffed bun

verb have (or be of) some; there is a little 水壺裡還有點水。 Shuǐhú lǐ hái yǒudiǎn shuǐ. There’s still some water in the kettle. 幹這事得要有點勇氣。 Gàn zhè shì děi yào yǒudiǎn yǒngqì. It requires some courage to do this. 現在看來還有點希望。 Xiànzài kànlai hái yǒudiǎn xīwàng. It still looks a bit hopeful now. adverb somewhat; rather; a bit 有點反感 yǒudiǎn fǎngǎn feel a bit resentful; have a touch of resentment 有點過分 yǒudiǎn guòfèn a bit too much; be a little overdue 有點不大舒服 yǒudiǎn bùdà shūfu feel a little under the weather 有點不好意思 yǒudiǎn bùhǎoyìsi somewhat embarrassed 好像有點不高興 hǎoxiàng yǒudiǎn bù gāoxìng seem a bit out of sorts
a little; somewhat

adverb 1 in the same place 住在一起 Zhù zài yīqǐ live in the same place 2 together; in company 我不跟他一起走。 Wǒ bù gēn tā yīqǐ zǒu. I won’t go along with him. 讓我們團結在一起, 戰鬥在一起, 勝利在一起。 Ràng wǒmen tuánjié zài yīqǐ, zhàndòu zài yīqǐ, shènglì zài yīqǐ. Let us stand together, fight together and win together. 3 dialect altogether; in all 這幾件東西一起多少錢？ Zhè jǐ jiàn dōngxi yī qǐ duōshao qián？ How much is that altogether? noun dialect same group; same side 你們是一起的嗎？ Nǐmen shì yīqǐ de ma? Are you of the same group?

verb 1 leave; part 別故鄉 bié gùxiāng leave one’s native place 辭別 cíbié say goodbye 不辭而別 bùcí'érbié take French leave; leave without saying goodbye 揮淚而別 huīlèi ér bié part in tears 久別重逢 jiǔbiéchóngféng meet after a long separation 2 dialect turn; change 她把頭別了過去。 Tā bǎ tóu bié le guòqu. She turned her head away. 這個人的脾氣一時別不過來。 Zhège rén de píqi yīshí bié bù guòlai. There is no changing his temper. adjective other; another See 56541667別處bie2chu4別處 noun 1 difference; distinction 男女有別 nánnǚyǒubié make a distinction between the sexes 天壤之別 tiānrǎngzhībié as different as light from darkness; totally different 2 classification; category 職別 zhíbié official rank verb literary differentiate; distinguish 別其真偽 Bié qí zhēn-wěi determine whether it’s genuine or false verb 1 fasten with a pin or clip 把表格別在一起 bǎ biǎogé bié zài yīqǐ pin (or clip) the forms together 胸前別著大紅花 xiōngqián bié zhe dà hónghuā with a big red flower pinned on one’s breast 2 stick in 腰裡別著旱煙袋 yāo lǐ bié zhe hànyāndài with a pipe stuck in one’s belt 把門別上。 Bǎ mén bié shàng. Bolt the door. adverb 1 [giving commands or advice] don't; better not 別忙。 Bié máng. No hurry. or Take your time. 別管我。 bié guǎn wǒ. Leave me alone. 別忘了。 Bié wàng le. Don’t forget. 2 [expressing anxiety that sth. undesirable may happen] 明天可別下雨。 Míngtiān kě bié xià yǔ. I hope it doesn’t rain tomorrow. 他別睡過頭了, 誤了火車。 Tā bié shuì guò tóu le, wù le huǒchē. Hope he won’t oversleep and miss the train.

adverb 1 at once; immediately; straight away; right away 馬上集合！ Mǎshàng jíhé! Fall in immediately! 你馬上就走嗎？ Nǐ mǎshàng jiù zǒu ma？ Are you leaving right away? 我馬上就回來。 Wǒ mǎshàng jiù huílai. I won’t be a minute. or I’ll be back in a minute. 我們馬上動手。 Wǒmen mǎshàng dòngshǒu. We’ll start working straight away. 演出馬上就要開始了。 Yǎnchū mǎshàng jiùyào kāishǐ le. The performance is about to begin. 2 in the near future; soon 馬上就要高考了。 Mǎshàng jiùyào gāokǎo le. The college entrance examinations are coming up soon.
noun cake
verb 1 drink 喝茶 hēchá drink tea 喝湯 hē tāng drink soup 2 drink liquor 喝醉了 hē zuì le get drunk 愛喝兩盅 ài hē liǎng zhōng be fond of drinking VARIANT OF 22474752嗬he1嗬 hē/hè interjection ah; oh

verb 1 be short of; lack (opp. 多) 少管閒 shǎoguǎnxiánshì keep one’s nose out of other people’s affairs (or business) 缺醫少藥 quēyīshǎoyào be short of doctors and medicine 我們還少兩把椅子。 Wǒmen hái shǎo liǎng bǎ yǐzi. We’re still two chairs short. 咱們少一個好的守門員。 Zánmen shǎo yī ge hǎo de shǒuményuán. We lack a good goalkeeper. 2 owe 還少一百塊。 hái shǎo yībǎi kuài. There are still 100 yuan owing. 他還少我半年的房租。 Tā hái shǎo wǒ bànnián de fángzū. He still owes me half year’s rent. 3 lose; be missing 看看少不少人。 Kànkan shǎo bùshǎo rén. See if anyone is missing. 少了誰地球也轉。 shǎo le shuí dìqiú yě zhuǎn. No man is indispensable. 羊群裡少了幾只羊。 Yángqún lǐ shǎo le jǐ zhī yáng. A few sheep have been lost from the flock. 這裡肯定少了一個字。 Zhèlǐ kěndìng shǎo le yī ge zì. Surely, there’s a word missing here. 4 stop; quit 少廢話！ Shǎo fèihuà! Stop talking rubbish! 少給我裝蒜！ Shǎo gěi wǒ zhuāngsuàn! Stop pretending! 少來這一套。 Shǎo lái zhè yī tào. Cut it out. or Quit that! adjective few; little; less (opp. 多) 少吃多餐 shǎochīduōcān have many meals but little food at each 少得可憐 shǎo de kělián miserably little (or few) 少勞少得 shǎoláoshǎodé less pay for less work 少生優生 shǎoshēng-yōushēng have fewer but healthier babies 少生優育 shǎo shēng yōuyù fewer births and sound child care practice 少走彎路 shǎozǒuwānlù avoid detours in one’s progress 少花錢, 多辦事 Shǎo huāqián, duō bàn shì. accomplish more with less money 少講空話, 多做實事 shǎo jiǎng kōnghuà, duō zuò shíshì forsake empty talk in favour of practical work 以少勝多 yǐshǎoshèngduō defeat the many with the few 最近我們很少見到他。 Zuìjìn wǒmen hěn shǎo jiàndào tā. We’ve seen very little of him lately. adverb a little while; a moment 請少候。 Qǐng shǎo hòu. Wait a moment, please.

adjective 1 many; much; more (opp. 少, 寡) 很多人 hěn duō rén many people 多思。 Duō sī. Think more. 人多議論多。 Rén duō yìlùn duō. More people mean more ideas. 這樣簡單多了。 Zhèyàng jiǎndān duō le. This is much simpler. 要辦的事情很多。 Yào bàn de shìqing hěn duō. There are many things to do. 他多喝了一點兒 (= 喝多了一點兒)。 tā duō hē le yīdiǎnr . He’s had a drop too much. 我在那兒多住了幾天。 Wǒ zài nàr duō zhù le jǐ tiān. I stayed there a few days longer. 時間緊迫, 我不能多考慮。 Shíjiān jǐnpò, wǒ bù néng duō kǎolǜ. Time is running out so I can’t give it much thought. 我們比原計劃多打了十口井。 Wǒmen bǐ yuán jìhuà duō dǎ le shí kǒu jǐng. We have sunk ten more wells than planned. 昨天很熱, 今天涼快多了。 Zuótiān hěn rè, jīntiān liángkuai duō le. It was quite hot yesterday but today it’s a lot cooler. 2 excessive 多疑 duōyí suspicious; distrusting adverb over a specified amount; and more 十多斤 shí duō jīn a dozen or more jin 十斤多 shí jīn duō over ten jin 六十多歲 liùshí duō suì over sixty years old 三個多月 sān ge duō yuè over three months; three months and more 一百多個人 yībǎi duō ge rén more than 100 people 全書一千多頁。 Quánshū yīqiān duō yè. It’s a book of 1,000-odd pages. verb 1 have (a specified amount) more or too much (opp. 少) 班上多了三個新同學。 Bān shàng duō le sān ge xīn tóngxué. There are three more new students in the class. 這個句子多了一個詞。 zhège jùziduō le yī ge cí. There is one word too many in this sentence. 2 have sth. in abundance 南方多水, 利於灌溉。 Nánfāng duō shuǐ, lìyú guàngài. Irrigation is easy in the South because of the abundance of water. 這裡春天多風, 夏天多雨。 Zhèlǐ chūntiān duō fēng, xiàtiān duō yǔ. Here we have a lot of wind in spring and a lot of rain in summer. adverb 1 [in questions] to what extent 他多大年紀了？ Tā duō dà niánjì le？ How old is he? 天安門有多高？ Tiān'ānmén yǒu duō gāo？ How high is Tian’anmen? 多厚的木板才能做桌面呢？ Duō hòu de mùbǎn cái néng zuò zhuōmiàn ne？ How thick must a wooden plank be to make a table top? 2 [in exclamations] to what an extent 看她多漂亮！ Kàn tā duō piàoliang! Look how pretty she is! 這天兒多悶哪！ Zhètiānr duō mēn nǎ! What stuffy weather! 3 to an unspecified extent 有多大勁兒使多大勁兒。 Yǒu duō dà jìnr shǐ duō dà jìnr. Use out all the strength you have. 走出不多遠, 他又回來了。 Zǒu chū bù duō yuǎn, tā yòu huílai le. He turned back before going far. 多複雜的算術題他都能做出來。 Duō fùzá de suànshù tí tā dōu néng zuò chūlai. He can figure out any arithmetic problem, no matter how complicated.
noun 1 snacks; refreshments 2 cold dishes

conjunction then; after that; afterwards 我們先研究一下, 然後再決定。 Wǒmen xiān yánjiū yīxià, ránhòu zài juédìng. We’ll consider the problem carefully before coming to any decision. 我們看了一場電影, 然後就回家了。 Wǒmen kàn le yī chǎng diànyǐng, ránhòu jiù huíjiā le. We saw a film, and then (we) went home.

verb 1 get; obtain; gain (opp. 失) 得第一名 dé dì-yī míng get a first; win first place 得了結核病 Déle jiéhébìng have (or contract) tuberculosis 得了一大筆錢 Déle yī dàbǐ qián have obtained a large sum of money 他得了個壞名聲。 Tā déle ge huài míngshēng. He gained a bad reputation. 今天的幸福生活得來不易。 Jīntiān de xìngfú shēnghuó dé lái bùyì. The happy life we have today was not easily won. 2 (of a calculation) result in 二三得六。 Èr-sān dé liù. Twice three is six. 3 fit; suit See 19772928得用de2yong4得用 4 literary be satisfied; be complacent 自得 zìdé self-complacent 5 colloquial be finished; be ready 飯得了。 Fàn dé le. Dinner is ready. 6 colloquial [expressing approval or prohibition] 得, 就這麼辦。 Dé, jiù zhème bàn. All right! Just go ahead. 得了, 別再說了。 Dé le, bié zài shuō le. That’s enough. Let it go at that. 7 colloquial [expressing helplessness or frustration] 得, 又搞錯了！ Dé, yòu gǎo cuò le! Oh, shoot! I’ve got it wrong again! 8 [usu. in laws and decrees before verbs to express permission] 國家在必要時得設立特別行政區。 Guójiā zài bìyào shí dé shèlì tèbié xíngzhèngqū. The state may establish special administrative regions when necessary. 9 [before other verbs to indicate probability, usu. in the negative] 看樣子, 這雨一時半會兒不得完。 Kànyàngzi, zhè yǔ yīshí-bànhuǐr bù dé wán. It seems the rain won’t stop soon.

auxiliary 1 [added to a verb or adjective to indicate a continued action or state, often with the particle 呢 at the end of the sentence] 大門敞著。 Dàmén chǎngzhe. The gate is wide open. 雪正下著呢。 Xuě zhèng xià zhe ne. It’s snowing. 別站著, 坐下吧。 Bié zhànzhe, zuòxia ba. No need to stand, please sit down. 他穿著一身新衣服。 Tā chuānzhe yī shēn xīn yīfu. He is wearing new clothes. 夜深了, 屋裡的燈卻還亮著。 Yèshēn le, wū lǐ de dēng què hái liàng zhe. It was late at night, but the lights in the room were still on. 他們正談著話呢, 請你在外頭等幾分鐘吧。 Tāmen zhèng tán zhe huà ne, qǐng nǐ zài wàitou děng jǐ fēnzhōng ba. They are talking just now, please wait outside a few minutes. 2 [in sentences beginning with a place word, added to the verb to indicate a resultant state, the verb plus 著 having the force of “there is”] 牆上掛著一幅山水畫。 Qiáng shàng guà zhe yī fú shānshuǐhuà. On the wall hangs a landscape painting. 桌上放著好些東西。 Zhuō shàng fàng zhe hǎoxiē dōngxi. There are a lot of things on the table. 3 [verb plus 著 placed before another verb, indicating an accompanying action or state] a [verb plus 著 serving as an adverbial modifier] 他愛吃著飯看報。 Tā ài chī zhe fàn kànbào. He likes to read the newspaper while eating. 他老低著頭走路。 Tā lǎo dī zhe tóu zǒulù. He always walks with his head bent. 他正忙著準備考試。 Tā zhèng mángzhe zhǔnbèi kǎoshì. He is busy preparing for the examination. 孩子們急著要出去玩兒。 Háizi men jí zhe yào chūqu wánr. The children are in a hurry to go outside and play. 路不遠, 咱們走著去吧。 Lù bù yuǎn, zánmen zǒu zhe qù ba. It’s quite near, let’s go on foot. 探險隊冒著大雪上山。 Tànxiǎnduì mào zhe dàxuě shàngshān. The expedition climbed the mountain in spite of the heavy snow. b [verb plus 著 repeated, indicating that while one action is in progress another is expected] 她想著想著笑了起來。 Tā xiǎng zhe xiǎng zhe xiào le qǐlai. She thought for a while and then burst out laughing. 走著走著天色暗了下來。 Zǒu zhe zǒu zhe tiānsè àn le xiàlai. As we walked along, it began to grow dark. 4 [in imperative sentences, used after verbs or adjectives for emphasis, often with 點兒 added] 等著！ Děngzhe! Wait! 慢著！ Mànzhe! Hold it! 快著點兒。 Kuài zhe diǎnr. Hurry! 你聽著。 Nǐ tīngzhe. Listen! 過馬路看著點兒。 Guò mǎlù kànzhe diǎnr. Mind when you cross the street. 這事你記著點兒。 Zhè shì nǐ jì zhe diǎnr. Be sure to remember this. or Don’t forget! 5 [in forming a preposition] 向著 xiàngzhe towards 沿著馬路 Yán zhe mǎlù along the road

noun 1 cup 茶杯 chábēi teacup 瓷杯 Cí bēi china cup 酒杯 jiǔbēi beer mug 高腳杯 gāojiǎobēi goblet; wine glass 2 (alcoholic) drink 貪杯 tānbēi too fond of drinking (or the bottle) 咱們喝一杯。 Zánmen hē yī bēi. Let’s have a drink. 3 (prize) cup; trophy 世界杯 shìjièbēi World Cup 獲得獎杯 huòdé jiǎng bēi win the cup measure word cup; glass 一杯茶 yī bēi chá a cup of tea 兩杯啤酒 liǎng bēi píjiǔ two glasses of beer; two beers

noun 1 cup 茶杯 chábēi teacup 瓷杯 Cí bēi china cup 酒杯 jiǔbēi beer mug 高腳杯 gāojiǎobēi goblet; wine glass 2 (alcoholic) drink 貪杯 tānbēi too fond of drinking (or the bottle) 咱們喝一杯。 Zánmen hē yī bēi. Let’s have a drink. 3 (prize) cup; trophy 世界杯 shìjièbēi World Cup 獲得獎杯 huòdé jiǎng bēi win the cup measure word cup; glass 一杯茶 yī bēi chá a cup of tea 兩杯啤酒 liǎng bēi píjiǔ two glasses of beer; two beers

noun 1 egg 2 egg-shaped thing
noun 1 shop; store 服裝店 fúzhuāngdiàn clothing store 文具店 wénjùdiàn stationer’s 2 inn 住店 zhùdiàn stop at an inn

adjective short; brief (opp. 長) 開個短會 Kāi ge duǎn huì have a brief meeting 這條路最短。 Zhè tiáo lù zuì duǎn. This is the shortest way. 冬季日短夜長。 Dōngjì rì duǎn yè cháng. In winter, the days are short and the nights long. 她頭髮剪得短短的。 Tā tóufa jiǎn de duǎnduǎn de. She had her hair cut short. or Her hair is cut short. 我給他寫了封短信。 Wǒ gěi tā xiě le fēng duǎn xìn. I dropped him a few lines. verb lack; owe 一個月短兩天 yī ge yuè duǎn liǎng tiān two days short of a month; a month less two days 短你三塊錢。 Duǎn nǐ sān kuài qián. I owe you three yuan. 別人都來了, 就短他一個。 Biéren dōu lái le, jiù duǎn tā yī ge. All the others are here; only he’s missing. noun weak point; fault; failing 揭短 jiēduǎn expose sb.’s shortcomings (or weaknesses)

adjective 1 eat one's fill; full (opp. 餓) 吃飽喝足 chībǎohēzú eat and drink one’s fill 吃得過飽 Chīde guò bǎo overeat 我飽了, 一點兒也吃不下了。 wǒ bǎo le, yīdiǎnr yě chībuxià le. I’m full and can’t eat any more. 2 full; plump 穀粒很飽。 Gǔlì hěn bǎo. The grains are full and plump. adverb fully; to the full 飽嘗辛酸 bǎochángxīnsuān suffer in life; have a very hard life; go through the mill; have a hard time 飽覽海島的美麗風光 bǎolǎn hǎidǎo de měilì fēngguāng drink in the beauty of the island scenery 她的眼眶裡飽含著幸福的熱淚。 Tā de yǎnkuàng lǐ bǎohán zhe xìngfú de rèlèi. Her eyes filled with tears of joy. 舊中國飽經憂患。 Jiù Zhōngguó bǎojīngyōuhuàn. adjective 1 new; fresh; up-to-date (opp. 老, 舊) 新技術 xīnjìshù new (or up-to-date) technique 新品種 xīn pǐnzhǒng new variety 最新消息 zuìxīn xiāoxi the latest news 2 brand new; unused (opp. 舊) 新筆 xīn bǐ new pen 新衣服 xīn yīfu new clothes 3 recently married or just being married 新女婿 Xīn nǚxu man newly married to one’s daughter; daughter’s bridegroom 新媳婦 xīnxífu woman newly married to one’s son; son’s bride adverb newly; freshly; recently 新漆的門 xīn qī de mén freshly painted door 新建的工廠 xīnjiàn de gōngchǎng newly built factory 他是新來的。 Tā shì xīn lái de. The money is not enough to buy a dictionary. 只舉一個例子就夠了。 zhǐ jǔ yī ge lìzi jiù gòu le. A single example will suffice. 這活兒夠我們忙幾天的。 Zhè huór gòu wǒmen máng jǐ tiān de. verb catch sight of; see; get a view of 他們航行了二十天才看見陸地。 Tāmen hángxíng le èrshí tiān cái kànjian lùdì. They sighted land after being at sea for twenty days. 我們站在人們可以完全看見的地方。 Wǒmen zhàn zài rénmen kěyǐ wánquán kànjian de dìfang. We stood in full view of the crowd.

I heard a knock at the door. 我聽了一會兒, 可什麼也沒聽見。 Wǒ tīng le yīhuìr, kě shénme yě méi tīngjian. I listened for a while, but heard nothing.

adjective (be) tired; weary; fatigued 累壞了 lèi huài le tired out; worn out; exhausted 不怕苦, 不怕累 Bù pà kǔ, bù pà lèi fear neither hardship nor fatigue verb 1 tire; wear out; strain 累死人的差事 lèi sǐrén de chāishi fatiguing errand (or job) 看小字累眼睛。 Kàn xiǎozì lèi yǎnjing. Reading small print strains the eyes. 這個活兒真累人。 Zhège huór zhēn lèi rén. This work really makes you tired. 這件事別人做不了, 還得累你。 Zhè jiàn shì biéren zuòbuliǎo, hái děi lèi nǐ. Since no one else can do it, I have to bother you. 2 work hard; toil 累死累活 lèisǐlèihuó tire oneself out with back-breaking work; work oneself to death 為孩子累了一輩子 wèi háizilèi le yībèizi toil all one’s life for one’s child 你累了一天, 該休息了。 Nǐ lèi le yī tiān, gāi xiūxi le. noun clothing; clothes 衣服裡子 yīfu lǐzi lining 外邊冷, 多穿些衣服。 Wàibian lěng, duō chuān xiē yīfu. It’s cold outside. Put on more clothes.

verb 1 compare; contrast 比不上 bǐbùshàng no match for; can not hold a candle to 比得上 bǐdeshàng can compare with; compare favourably with 比幹勁 bǐ gànjìn compete in energy 想想過去, 比比現在 xiǎngxiang guòqu, bǐbǐ xiànzài recall the past and contrast it with the present 2 emulate; compete; match 學先進, 比先進 xué xiānjìn, bǐ xiānjìn emulate the advanced 咱倆比一比, 看誰高。 Zán liǎ bǐ yī bǐ, kàn shuí gāo. Let’s stand back to back and see who is taller. 這家旅館的服務質量誰也比不上。 Zhè jiā lǚguǎn de fúwù zhìliàng shuí yě bǐ bù shàng. This hotel can’t be matched for its good service. or This hotel has incomparable service. 3 gesture; gesticulate 連說帶比 Lián shuō dài bǐ gesticulate as one talks 4 dialect aim at; direct towards 警察用槍比著罪犯。 Jǐngchá yòng qiāng bǐ zhe zuìfàn. The policeman pointed his gun at the criminal. 5 copy; model after 比著舊衣裁新衣 Bǐ zhe jiù yī cái xīnyī pattern a new garment on an old one; copy an old garment 用尺比著畫。 Yòng chǐ bǐ zhe huà. Use a ruler for drawing. 6 draw an analogy; liken to; compare to 我們這小小的公司可以比作一個大家庭。 Wǒmen zhè xiǎoxiǎo de gōngsī kěyǐ bǐ zuò yī ge dàjiātíng. Our little company can be likened to a big family. 7 literary cling to; collude with 朋比呼應 péng bǐ hūyìng act in collusion with sb. noun ratio; proportion 這裡小麥同水稻的年產量約為一與三之比。 Zhèlǐ xiǎomài tóng shuǐdào de niánchǎnliàng yuē wéi yī yǔ sān zhī bǐ. Here the annual yield of wheat and rice is about one to three. preposition 1 to (in a score) 現在幾比幾？ Xiànzài jǐ bǐ jǐ？ What’s the score? 甲隊以二比一勝乙隊。 Jiǎ duì yǐ èr bǐ yī shèng yǐ duì. Team A beat team B (by a score of) two to one. 2 than 你比我幹得好。 nǐ bǐ wǒ gàn de hǎo. You have done better than I. 人民的生活一年比一年好。 Rénmín de shēnghuó yī nián bǐ yī nián hǎo. The life of the people improves by the year. 他吃的比平常少。 Tā chī de bǐ píngcháng shǎo. He’s eating less than usual. 我比你早來一個鐘頭。 Wǒ bǐ nǐ zǎo lái yī ge zhōngtóu. I came an hour earlier than you did. 3 literary close together; next to See 17456640比肩bi3jian1比肩 adverb literary lately 比聞 bǐwén recently heard

noun main points; essentials 擇要記錄 Zéyào jìlù note down the essential points adjective important; essential 要法 yào fǎ important method; necessary way 上述規定希嚴格執行為要。 Shàngshù guīdìng xī yángé zhíxíng wéi yào. It is imperative that the above rules be strictly observed. verb 1 want; ask for; wish; desire 誰沒有票, 問她要。 Shuí méi yǒu piào, wèn tā yào. Anyone without a ticket can ask her for one. 他要一架手風琴。 Tā yào yī jià shǒufēngqín. He wants an accordion. 我要了兩個菜。 Wǒ yào le liǎng ge cài. I ordered two dishes. 這雙鞋我還要呢。 Zhè shuāng xié wǒ háiyào ne. I want to keep these shoes. 2 ask (or want) sb. to do sth. 不是你要我來的嗎？ Bù shì nǐ yào wǒ lái de ma？ Wasn’t it you who asked me to come? 3 need; take 這活兒要不了這麼多人。 Zhè huór yàobuliǎo zhème duō rén. You don’t need so many people for this job. 這項任務要十天才能完成。 Zhè xiàng rènwu yào shí tiān cái néng wánchéng. It will take ten days to get the work done. verb 1 must; should; it is necessary (or imperative, essential) 借東西要還。 Jiè dōngxi yào huán. One should return what one borrows. 我要不要留下來？ Wǒ yào bù yào liú xià lái？ Shall I stay? 這個問題要仔細考慮。 Zhège wèntí yào zǐxì kǎolǜ. This question calls for careful consideration. 2 shall; will; be going to 要下雨了。 Yào xià yǔ le. It’s going to rain. 他快要回來了。 Tā kuàiyào huílai le. He will soon be back. 天要黑了, 快走吧。 Tiān yào hēi le, kuài zǒu ba. It’s getting dark. Let’s hurry up! 會議要到月底才能結束。 Huìyì yào dào yuèdǐ cái néng jiéshù. The conference will not end till the end of the month. 3 want to; wish to 他要學游泳。 Tā yào xué yóuyǒng. He wants to learn swimming. 我還有幾句話要說。 Wǒ háiyǒu jǐ jù huà yào shuō. I’d like to say a few more words. 4 [in comparisons to indicate an estimate] 樹蔭底下比屋子裡要涼快些。 shùyīn dǐxia bǐ wūzi lǐ yào liángkuai xiē. It is cooler under the tree than in the room. conjunction 1 if; suppose; in case 明天要下雨, 我們就不去了。 Míngtiān yào xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù bù qù le. If it rains tomorrow, we won’t go. 他要來不了呢？ Tā yào láibuliǎo ne？ Suppose he can’t come? 我要趕不回來, 你替我說一聲。 Wǒ yào gǎn bù huílai, nǐ tì wǒ shuō yī shēng. In case I can’t get back in time, please apologize for me. 這有什麼可怕的, 要我就不怕。 Zhè yǒu shénme kěpà de, yào wǒ jiù bù pà. What is there to be afraid of? I wouldn’t be afraid if I were you. 2 [usu. with 就 or 就是] or; either... or... 要就去跳舞, 要就去聽音樂, 別處我不去。 Yào jiù qù tiàowǔ, yào jiù qù tīng yīnyuè, biéchù wǒ bù qù. noun 1 belt; girdle; ribbon; band; tape 磁帶 cídài tape 絲帶 sīdài silk ribbon 2 tyre 自行車帶 zìxíngchē dài bicycle tyre 3 zone; area; belt 他在這一帶開過公司。 tā zài zhè yī dài kāi guò gōngsī. verb 1 speak; talk; say 說話和氣 Shuōhuà héqi speak politely 說話算數 shuōhuà suànshù honour one’s word; mean what one says; every promise being trustworthy 說話的權利 shuōhuà de quánlì right to speak 說話不算話 Shuōhuà bù suàn huà go back on one’s word 他不愛說話。 Tā bù ài shuōhuà. verb 1 open 開鎖 kāisuǒ open a lock; unlock 門開了。 Mén kāi le. The door opened. 2 make an opening; open up 牆上開了個窗口。 Qiáng shàng kāi le ge chuāngkǒu. The knot has come untied. 兩塊木板沒粘好, 又開了。 Liǎng kuài mùbǎn méi zhān hǎo, yòu kāi le. The two pieces of wood were not glued together properly. They have come loose again. 5 (of a frozen river) thaw out 河開了。 hé kāi le. Two regiments came yesterday and set off today. 11 start or run (a factory, school, store, etc.); set up; open 開茶館 kāi cháguǎn run a teahouse 開工廠 Kāi gōngchǎng set up a factory 百貨店就開在十字路口。 Bǎihuòdiàn jiù kāi zài shízì lùkǒu. The department store is located at the intersection. 12 (of an institute, organization, etc.) open to the public See 64455907開館kai1guan3開館 / 13 (of film shooting, auction, etc.) begin; start See 24814080開拍kai1pai1開拍 / 14 hold (a meeting, exhibition, etc.) 開運動會 Kāi yùndònghuì hold a sports meet 舞會開了一夜。 Wǔhuì kāi le yī yè. The dance lasted all night. 15 make a list of; write out; prescribe 開支票 kāi zhīpiào write out a cheque 開介紹信 kāi jièshàoxìn write a letter of introduction 開信用證 kāi xìnyòngzhèng issue a credit 醫生給我開了些藥片。 Yīshēng gěi wǒ kāi le xiē yàopiàn. The doctor prescribed some pills for me. 16 pay (wages, fares, etc.) 開工資 kāi gōngzī pay wages 17 dialect fire (an employee); fire out; give sb. the sack; kick out 這個公司剛剛開了幾個人。 zhège gōngsī gānggāng kāi le jǐ gèrén. The company has just fired several of its employees. 18 boil 水開了。 Shuǐ kāi le. The water is boiling. 19 colloquial eat up 他把包子都開了。 Tā bǎ bāozi dōu kāi le. He ate up all the stuffed buns. adjective open 開循環 kāi xúnhuán open cycle measure word 1 [expressing a ratio between two things considered as parts of a whole which is 10] 二八開 Èrbā kāi 2:8 大家認為他的功過是三七開。 Dàjiā rènwéi tā de gōng-guò shì sānqī kāi. The general assessment of his work is 70% achievements and 30% mistakes. 2 printing division of standard size printing paper 對開 duìkāi folio 四開 sìkāi quarto measure word 1 transliteration carat (ct) 十四開金 14- Shísì kāi jīn carat gold 2 abbreviation VARIANT OF 64450787開爾文kai1er3wen2開爾文 physics degree Kelvin; kelvin (K)

adjective low (opp. 高) 低工資 dī gōngzī low pay 低水位 Dī shuǐwèi low water level 情緒低 qíngxù dī low spirits; dejected 壓低嗓門 yādī sǎngmén lower one’s voice 飛機飛得很低。 Fēijī fēi de hěn dī. The plane flew very low. 這個音女聲唱太低。 Zhège yīn nǚshēng chàng tài dī. The note is too low for the female voice. 我比他低一年級。 Wǒ bǐ tā dī yī niánjí. I am one year below him. verb droop; hang down 他把頭低了下來。 Tā bǎ tóu dī le xiàlai. He hung his head.

adjective 1 correct; right 這個答案一點兒不錯。 Zhège dá'àn yīdiǎnr bùcuò. noun 1 (of a building, vehicle or vessel) entrance 請走南門。 Qǐng zǒu nánmén. Please use the south entrance. 2 door; gate; entrance 校門 xiàomén school gate 3 any opening 櫃門兒 guì ménr cabinet door 爐門兒 lúménr stove door 4 valve; switch 電門 diànmén power switch 氣門 qìmén gas valve 5 orifice in the human body 肛門 gāngmén anus 6 way to do sth.; knack; method; access 對使用計算機已經摸著門兒 duì shǐyòng jìsuànjī yǐjing mō zhe mén r have learned how to use a computer 7 branch of a family or clan; family 豪門 háomén prominent family 8 (religious) sect; school (of thought) 佛門 Fómén Buddhism 9 study with the same teacher 同門 tóngmén fellow disciple 10 position in a gambling game (relative to where one sits or where one lays a stake) 11 class; category; branch of study 門門精通 ménmén jīngtōng proficient in everything 分門別類 fēnménbiélèi categorize 12 biology phylum 亞門 yàmén subphylum 脊椎動物門 jǐzhuī dòngwù mén Vertebrata 13 computing gate “非”門 “fēi”mén NOT gate “與”門 “yǔ”mén AND gate 14 (Mén) a surname measure word 1 [for subjects of study or field of technical training] 兩門功課 liǎng mén gōngkè two subjects; two courses 這門學問 zhè mén xuéwen this area of study 2 [for language] 兩門外語 liǎng mén wàiyǔ two foreign languages 3 [for cannon] 一門大炮 yī mén dàpào one piece of artillery; one cannon; one gun 4 [for marriage] 一門親事 yī mén qīnshì a marriage 5 [for relatives] 一門親戚 Yī mén qīnqi a set of relatives

adjective 1 ordinary; common; normal 人之常情 rénzhīchángqíng natural (or normal) human feelings 2 constant; invariable 冬夏常青 dōng xià chángqīng remain green throughout the year; evergreen adverb frequently; often; usually 常來常往 chángláichángwǎng exchange frequent visits; pay frequent calls 我們常見面。 Wǒmen cháng jiànmiàn. He only said it for fun. or He was only joking. 2 employ; resort to 玩手段 wán shǒuduàn resort to crafty manoeuvres; play tricks 玩邪的 wán xié de employ underhand means; not play fair 3 engage in; take part in 想玩股票可不容易。 Xiǎng wán gǔpiào kěbu róngyì. Playing the stock market is no joke. verb 1 trifle with; treat lightly; toy with 玩女人 wán nǚ ren dally with women 2 enjoy; appreciate 玩月 wányuè enjoy a beautiful moonlight night 玩兒郵票 wánr yóupiào collect stamps as a hobby 3 ponder; think carefully noun object for appreciation 古玩 gǔwán antique; curio

verb 1 pierce through; penetrate 穿個窟窿 Chuān ge kūlong pierce (or bore) a hole 鞋底磨穿了。 Xiédǐ mó chuān le. The sole of the shoe was worn through. 2 pass through; cross 飛機穿雲而降。 Fēijī chuān yún ér jiàng. The plane descended through the clouds. 3 wear; put on; be dressed in 穿上工作服 Chuān shàng gōngzuòfú put on work clothes 穿灰大衣的那個女的 chuān huī dàyī de nàge nǚ de the woman in a grey overcoat 衣服穿舊了。 Yīfu chuān jiù le. The clothes show signs of wear. 穿得這麼少, 不冷嗎？ Chuān de zhème shǎo, bù lěng ma？ Aren’t you cold with so little on? 這種鞋小點兒不要緊, 穿穿就大了。 zhèzhǒng xié xiǎo diǎnr bù yàojǐn, chuānchuān jiù dà le. It doesn’t matter if the shoes feel a bit tight. They’ll stretch with wearing. 4 string together 用珠子穿成一串項鏈 yòng zhūzi chuān chéng yī chuàn xiàngliàn string the beads into a necklace

verb get up; get out of bed 他們已經起床了。 Tāmen yǐjing qǐchuáng le. They are already up. 我習慣六點起床。 Wǒ xíguàn liù diǎn qǐchuáng. I am in the habit of getting up at six o’clock. 我起了床還想睡。 Wǒ qǐ le chuáng hái xiǎng shuì. After I got up I still felt like going back to sleep.

verb 1 make things convenient for sb. 方便群眾 fāngbiàn qúnzhòng make things convenient for the people 2 euphemistic have money to spare or lend 手頭不方便 shǒutóu bù fāngbiàn have little money to spare 3 euphemistic go to the lavatory 你要不要方便一下？ Nǐ yào bù yào fāngbiàn yīxià？ Do you want to use the lavatory (or wash your hands)? 稍候, 我去方便方便。 Shāohòu, wǒ qù fāngbiàn fāngbiàn. Wait a few minutes. verb sleep 該睡覺了。 Gāi shuìjiào le. It’s time to go to bed. or It’s time for bed. 馬上上床, 好好地睡一覺。 Mǎshàng shàng chuáng, hǎohāo de shuì yī jiào. Get straight into bed and have a good sleep.

verb 1 stand up; sit up; rise to one's feet 你起來吃藥吧。 Nǐ qǐ lai chī yào ba. Sit up and take your medicine. 有個小伙子起來給老太太讓了個座兒。 Yǒu ge xiǎohuǒzi qǐ lai gěi lǎotàitai ràng le ge zuòr. A youngster stood up and offered his seat to the old lady. 2 get up; get out of bed 他們一起來就下地了。 Tāmen yīqǐ lai jiù xiàdì le. They went to work in the fields as soon as they got up. 3 rise; arise; revolt 起來反抗壓迫 qǐ lai fǎnkàng yāpò rise against oppression 起來捍衛真理 qǐ lai hànwèi zhēnlǐ come forward in defence of truth 起來, 飢寒交迫的奴隸！ qǐ lai, jīhánjiāopò de núlì! Arise, ye prisoners of starvation!

verb 1 motion; movement 運動的形式 yùndòng de xíngshì form of motion 運動中的物質 yùndòng zhòngdì wùzhì matter in motion 行星的運動 xíngxīng de yùndòng movement of a planet 運動是物質的存在方式。 Yùndòng shì wùzhì de cúnzài fāngshì. Motion is the mode of existence of matter. 乘敵運動之際, 打擊敵人。 Chéng dí yùndòng zhījì, dǎjī dírén. Attack the enemy while he is on the move. 2 sports; athletics; exercise 室外運動 Shìwài yùndòng outdoor sports 散步也是一種運動。 Sànbù yě shì yī zhǒng yùndòng. Walking is also a form of exercise. 游泳是我喜愛的運動。 Yóuyǒng shì wǒ xǐ'ài de yùndòng. Swimming is my favourite sport. noun (political or cultural) movement; campaign; drive 競選運動 Jìngxuǎn yùndòng election campaign 技術革新運動 jìshù géxīn yùndòng drive for technological innovation

verb 1 walk; go on foot 孩子已經學會走路了。 Háizi yǐjing xuéhuì zǒulù le. The baby has learned to walk. 你們是坐車去還是走路去？ Nǐmen shì zuò chē qù hái shì zǒulù qù？ Will you go by bus or on foot? 打運動戰, 走路的時間常多於作戰的時間。 dǎ yùndòngzhàn, zǒulù de shíjiān cháng duōyú zuòzhàn de shíjiān. In mobile warfare, more time is often spent on the move than fighting. 2 leave; go away
verb sing (a song) 她很會唱歌。 Tā hěn huì chànggē. She is a good singer.

verb 1 jump; leap; bounce 跳過一條溝 tiào guò yī tiáo gōu leap over a ditch 跳下自行車 tiào xià zìxíngchē jump off a bicycle 高興得跳起來 Gāoxìng de tiào qǐlai jump for (or with) joy 他跳過了二米的高度。 Tā tiào guò le èr mǐ de gāodù. He cleared two metres in the high jump. 球在籃框上跳了一下滾入籃內。 Qiú zài lán kuàng shàng tiào le yīxià gǔn rù lán nèi. The ball bounced once on the ring and dropped into the net. 2 move up and down; beat 他激動得心直跳。 Tā jīdòng de xīn zhí tiào. His heart was throbbing with emotion. 我眼皮老是跳。 Wǒ yǎnpí lǎoshi tiào. My eyelids keep twitching. 3 skip (over); make omissions 跳一針 tiào yī zhēn drop a stitch (in knitting) 跳過三頁 tiào guò sān yè skip three pages 從第一頁跳到第五頁 Cóng dì-yī yè tiào dào dì-wǔ yè jump from page 1 to page 5

adverb 1 still; yet 還有一些具體問題要解決。 Háiyǒu yīxiē jùtǐ wèntí yào jiějué. Some specific problems have yet to be solved. 我們還沒有開始。 Wǒmen hái méiyǒu kāishǐ. We haven’t started yet. 夜深了, 他還在學習。 Yèshēn le, tā hái zài xuéxí. It was late at night and he was still studying. 2 even more; still more 今年的收成比去年還要好。 Jīnnián de shōucheng bǐ qùnián hái yào hǎo. This year’s harvest is even better than last year’s. 3 as well; in addition 我們不但要提高產量, 還要保證質量。 Wǒmen bùdàn yào tígāo chǎnliàng, hái yào bǎozhèng zhìliàng. We want not only to increase the quantity of products, but also to ensure the quality. 這本書我還想看一遍。 Zhè běn shū wǒ hái xiǎng kàn yī biàn. I want to read the book once more. 4 passably; fairly 屋子不大, 收拾得倒還幹凈。 Wūzi bùdà, shōushi de dào hái gānjìng. The room is small, but it’s kept quite tidy. 這張畫兒畫得還可以。 Zhè zhāng huàr huà de hái kěyǐ. The painting wasn’t done too badly. or This painting’s not very bad. 5 as early as 還在三年前他們就認識了。 hái zài sān niánqián tāmen jiù rènshi le. They got to know each other three years ago. 他還在讀中學時就開始寫小說。 Tā hái zài dú zhōngxué shí jiù kāishǐ xiě xiǎoshuō. He started to write novels when he was in middle school. 6 even 你跑那麼快還趕不上他, 何況我呢？ Nǐ pǎo nàme kuài hái gǎnbùshàng tā, hékuàng wǒ ne? Even a good runner like you can’t catch up with him, how can I? 7 [for emphasis] 那還用說！ Nà hái yòng shuō! That goes without saying. 這還了得！ Zhè hái liǎode! This is the limit! or This is simply atrocious! 8 [expressing realization or discovery] 他還真有辦法。 Tā hái zhēn yǒu bànfǎ. You’ve got to admit he’s resourceful. or He really is resourceful. 下這麼大的雨, 沒想到你還真準時到了。 Xià zhème dà de yǔ, méi xiǎngdào nǐ hái zhēn zhǔnshí dàoliǎo. I didn’t expect you’d arrive on time as it’s raining so hard.

noun 1 elder generation; ancestor; forebear 先業 xiānyè outstanding achievement of the forebears 2 beginning (opp. 後) 有言在先 yǒuyán-zàixiān make clear beforehand 3 term of respect for the dead; deceased; late 先父 xiānfù my late father 4 (Xiān) a surname adverb 1 earlier; before; first; in advance (opp. 後) 他比我先到。 Tā bǐ wǒ xiān dào. He arrived before me. 我先說兩句。 Wǒ xiān shuō liǎng jù. Let me say a few words first. 你不必先付款。 Nǐ bù bì xiān fùkuǎn. You don’t have to pay in advance. 正式動筆前, 你先擬個提綱。 zhèngshì dòngbǐ qián, nǐ xiān nǐ ge tígāng. Make an outline before you start writing. 沒有什麼先於經驗的知識。 Méiyǒu shénme xiān yú jīngyàn de zhīshi. There is no knowledge prior to experience. 2 [with a negative word “不”,“別”,etc.] for the time being; for the moment 你先別走, 我有話跟你說。 Nǐ xiān bié zǒu, wǒ yǒu huà gēn nǐ shuō. Don’t leave yet, I want to have a word with you. 這個問題先不談吧。 Zhège wèntí xiān bù tán ba. Let’s put this aside for the time being. 3 colloquial earlier on; before; at first 你先怎麼不告訴我呢？ Nǐ xiān zěnme bù gàosu wǒ ne？ Why didn’t you tell me before? 他先說不去, 後來又改了主意。 Tā xiān shuō bù qù, hòulái yòu gǎi le zhǔyi. First he refused to go, but later changed his mind.

verb 1 exist; be alive 人在人情在。 Rén zài rénqíng zài. Friendship lasts as long as the person remains. 他父親還在, 母親早就不在了。 Tā fùqin hái zài, mǔqin zǎo jiù bù zài le. The problem still exists and is not resolved yet. 2 be at, in, or on (a place) 你去那兒找他, 他準在。 Nǐ qù nàr zhǎo tā, tā zhǔn zài. Go and see him; he’s sure to be there. 他在家, 不在這兒。 Tā zài jiā, bù zài zhèr. My parents are in the countryside. 3 depend on; rest with 去不去在你自己。 Qù bù qù zài nǐ zìjǐ. It’s up to you whether to go or not. 收不收他在學校領導。 Shōu bù shōu tā zài xuéxiào lǐngdǎo. verb courteous work hard; go to great trouble; go through hardships 路上辛苦了。 Lùshang xīnkǔ le. verb 1 smile; laugh 笑得合不攏嘴 Xiào de hébùlǒng zuǐ grin from ear to ear 哈哈大笑 hāhādàxiào laugh heartily; roar with laughter 真笑死人 zhēn xiào sǐ rén be terribly funny 2 ridicule; laugh at 他剛學, 別笑他。 Tā gāng xué, bié xiào tā. He’s just started learning. Don’t laugh at him.

noun habit; custom; usual practice 從小培養勞動習慣 Cóngxiǎo péiyǎng láodòng xíguàn cultivate from childhood the habit of working with one’s own hands 破除舊習慣, 樹立新風尚 Pòchú jiù xíguàn, shùlì xīn fēngshàng discard outmoded customs and establish new ones 別養成抽煙的習慣。 Bié yǎngchéng chōuyān de xíguàn. I’ve become accustomed to the northern climate. 這樣潮濕的天氣我實在不習慣。 Zhèyàng cháoshī de tiānqì wǒ shízài bù xíguàn. I just can’t get used to this damp weather.

adjective glad; happy; cheerful (opp. 傷心) 看到孩子們有進步, 他心裡很高興。 kàndào háizimen yǒu jìnbù, tā xīnli hěn gāoxìng. He was very pleased to see that the kids had made progress. 小強高高興興地上學去了。 Xiǎo qiáng gāogāoxìngxìng de shàngxué qù le. Xiao Qiang cheerfully went off to school. 兩人談得可高興了。 Liǎng rén tán de kě gāoxìng le. The two of them chatted merrily. 我們昨天玩得真高興。 Wǒmen zuótiān wán de zhēn gāoxìng. We had a wonderful time yesterday. verb 1 be glad; be happy; be cheerful 他平時話不多, 高興時才說上幾句。 Tā píngshí huà bù duō, gāoxìng shí cái shuōshàng jǐ jù. He’s usually reticent and only talks a little when in high spirits. 把這消息告訴你爺爺, 叫他老人家也高興高興。 Bǎ zhè xiāoxi gàosu nǐ yéye, jiào tā lǎorenjia yě gāoxìng gāoxìng. Tell Grandpa the good news so that he can share our joy. 他們高興得太早了。 Tāmen gāoxìng de tài zǎo le. They rejoiced too soon. 2 be willing to; be happy to 你不高興就甭去了。 Nǐ bù gāoxìng jiù béng qùle. You needn’t go if you don’t feel like it. 他就是高興看電影, 對看戲不感興趣。 Tā jiùshì gāoxìng kàn diànyǐng, duì kànxì bù gǎn xìngqù. He’s fond of seeing films, and not at all interested in watching plays.

adverb without doubt; certainly; of course 這樣做當然最好。 Zhèyàng zuò dāngrán zuì hǎo. Of course this is the best way to do it. 借你的筆用一下可以嗎？——當然可以。 Jiè nǐ de bǐ yòng yī xià kěyǐ ma？ —— dāngrán kěyǐ. adjective 1 nervous; keyed up 神情緊張 Shénqíng jǐnzhāng look nervous; on edge 慢慢講, 別緊張。 Mànmàn jiǎng, bié jǐnzhāng. Everybody was keyed up as the experiment reached a crucial point. 2 tense; intense; strained 緊張局勢 jǐnzhāng júshì tense situation 緊張氣氛 jǐnzhāng qìfēn tense atmosphere 緊張的戰鬥 jǐnzhāng de zhàndòu intense fighting 緊張而有秩序的工作 jǐnzhāng ér yǒu zhìxù de gōngzuò intense but orderly work 緩和交通運輸的緊張狀況 Huǎnhé jiāotōng yùnshū de jǐnzhāng zhuàngkuàng relieve the pressure on transport 兩國關係緊張。 Liǎng guó guānxi jǐnzhāng. Relations between the two countries are strained. 這場比賽真緊張！ Zhè chǎng bǐsài zhēn jǐnzhāng! What an exciting game! 日程安排得太緊張。 Rìchéng ānpái de tài jǐnzhāng. It’s rather a tight schedule. 工程正在緊張地進行。 Gōngchéng zhèngzài jǐnzhāng de jìnxíng. Construction was in full swing. 3 in short supply; tight 這幾天汽油供應有點兒緊張。 zhè jǐ tiān qìyóu gōngyìng yǒudiǎnrjǐnzhāng. Gasoline has been in short supply for the last few days. 目前這裡住房相當緊張。 Mùqián zhèlǐ zhùfáng xiāngdāng jǐnzhāng. Accommodation here is pretty tight at present. or Housing here is in short supply now. 這裡只有一口井, 用水比較緊張。 Zhèlǐ zhǐ yǒu yī kǒu jǐng, yòng shuǐ bǐjiào jǐnzhāng. There’s only one well here and water is in great demand.

There is little hope of his recovery. or He is unlikely to recover. 2 that on which hope is placed 青少年是我們的未來, 是我們的希望。 Qīng-shàonián shì wǒmen de wèilái, shì wǒmen de xīwàng.
