noun 1 appearance; shape 這件大衣的樣子很好看。 Zhè jiàn dàyī de yàngzi hěn hǎokàn. This coat is well cut. 這活兒做得不像樣子。 Zhè huór zuòdé bù xiàng yàngzi. This job has been done too crudely. 2 manner; air 裝出一副公正的樣子 Zhuāng chū yī fù gōngzhèng de yàngzi assume a righteous posture (or manner, air) 看他那高興的樣子。 Kàn tā nà gāoxìng de yàngzi. How happy he looks! 3 sample; model; pattern 衣服樣子 yīfu yàngzi clothes pattern 做出樣子來 Zuòchū yàngzi lái set an example 給我個樣子, 我好照著做。 Gěi wǒ ge yàngzi, wǒ hǎo zhào zhe zuò. Give me a model to follow. 4 colloquial tendency; likelihood 看樣子這星期他來不了。 Kànyàngzi zhè xīngqī tā láibuliǎo. It seems (or looks as if ) he won’t be able to come this week. 天像是要下雨的樣子。 Tiān xiàng shì yào xià yǔ de yàngzi. It looks like rain.

noun 1 among; between 坐在他們兩人中間 zuò zài tāmen liǎng rén zhōngjiān sit between them both 她是我們三人中間最年輕的。 Tā shì wǒmen sān rén zhōngjiān zuì niánqīng de. She is the youngest of us three. 2 centre; middle 中間剝削 zhōngjiān bōxuē middleman’s exploitation 中間突破 Zhōngjiān tūpò make a breakthrough at the centre (or in the middle) 3 on the way; in the course 從我家到工廠, 中間要換車。 Cóng wǒ jiā dào gōngchǎng, zhōngjiān yào huàn chē. I have to change buses to get from home to the factory. 中間派 zhōngjiānpài the moderates; those with moderate views 中間人 zhōngjiānrén middleman; go-between; mediator; intermediary 中間道路 zhōngjiān dàolù the middle road 中間地帶 zhōngjiān dìdài intermediate zone 中間分子 zhōngjiān fènzǐ moderate element 中間階層 zhōngjiān jiēcéng intermediate strata; middle layer 中間力量 zhōngjiān lìliàng moderate forces; moderates 中間路線 zhōngjiān lùxiàn middle-of-the-road line; moderate course of action 中間狀態 zhōngjiān zhuàngtài intermediate state

adjective special; particular; out of the ordinary 特別的愛好 tèbié de àihào an unusual hobby 他的口音很特別。 Tā de kǒuyin hěn tèbié. He has a peculiar accent. 這棟樓的設計沒有什麼特別的地方。 Zhè dòng lóu de shèjì méiyǒu shénmetèbié de dìfang. The design of this building is nothing out of the ordinary. 這種花每當夜晚就散發出一種特別的香味兒。 Zhèzhǒng huā měidāng yèwǎn jiù sànfā chū yī zhǒng tèbié de xiāngwèir. As evening approaches, this flower gives off a distinctive fragrance. adverb 1 especially; particularly 質量特別好 zhìliàng tèbié hǎo of extra fine quality 工作特別努力 Gōngzuò tèbié nǔlì especially hard-working 建設一支特別能戰鬥的隊伍 jiànshè yī zhī tèbié néng zhàndòu de duìwu train a contingent of exceptional fighters 今天特別熱。 Jīntiān tèbié rè. It’s extremely hot today. 這個報告特別有教育意義。 zhège bàogào tèbié yǒu jiàoyù yìyì. The talk was particularly instructive. 2 for a special purpose; specially; deliberately 他臨走時特別去向女主人道謝。 Tā línzǒu shí tèbié qùxiàng nǚzhǔrén dàoxiè. He made a point of thanking his hostess before he left the party. 這些花是我特別為你摘的。 Zhèxiē huā shì wǒ tèbié wèi nǐ zhāi de. I picked these flowers specially for you. 3 all the more; in particular 他喜愛體育, 特別是籃球。 Tā xǐ'ài tǐyù, tèbié shì lánqiú. He loves sports, particularly basketball. 這裡最需要醫務人員, 特別是外科醫生。 Zhèlǐ zuì xūyào yīwù rényuán, tèbié shì wàikē yīshēng. There’s a huge need for medical workers here, especially surgeons.

verb 1 leave; part from 離京赴穗 lí jīng fù suì leave Beijing for Guangzhou 遠離家鄉 yuǎnlí jiāxiāng go far away from home 農民離土不離鄉, 發展鄉鎮企業。 nóngmín lí tǔ bù lí xiāng, fāzhǎn xiāng-zhèn qǐyè. Peasants leave the land but not their home to develop rural enterprises. 2 be at a distance from; be away from 離這裡不遠 lí zhèlǐ bù yuǎn be not far from here; a little way off 離國慶節只有十天了。 Lí Guóqìngjié zhǐ yǒu shí tiān le. National Day is only ten days away. 3 lack; be short of 他離不了酒。 Tā líbuliǎo jiǔ. He can’t stay away from the bottle. 發展工業離不了鋼鐵。 Fāzhǎn gōngyè líbuliǎo gāngtiě. Industry cannot develop without steel. 4 deviate from; shift from See 65399267離譜兒li2pu3r5離譜兒 noun li (one of the Eight Trigrams (八卦) which represents fire ())

verb 1 let go; set free; release 放他走 fàng tā zǒu let him go 把俘虜放了 bǎ fúlǔ fàng le release the captives 抓住繩子不放 zhuāzhù shéngzi bù fàng won’t let go of the rope 把游泳池裡的水放掉 bǎ yóuyǒngchí lǐ de shuǐ fàng diào let the water out of the swimming pool 2 give way to; let oneself go See 20836096放膽fang4dan3放膽;20852224放聲fang4sheng1 放聲 3 put out to feed; graze 放牛 fàngniú put cattle out to pasture; graze cattle 放鴨子 fàng yāzi put ducks out to feed in a pond, stream, etc. 4 let off; give off (or out) 放箭 fàng jiàn shoot an arrow 放槍 fàngqiāng fire a gun 放爆竹 fàng bàozhú set off firecrackers 放風箏 fàng fēngzheng fly a kite 鍋爐放汽了。 Guōlú fàng qì le. The boiler is letting off steam. 月亮本身不放光。 Yuèliang běnshēn bù fàng guāng. The moon does not give off light by itself. 5 show (a film, etc.); play (a record, etc.) 放錄像 fàng lùxiàng play a video tape 放錄音 fàng lùyīn play back a recording 放幻燈片 fàng huàndēngpiàn show some lantern slides 放點兒音樂聽聽 fàng diǎnr yīnyuè tīngting play some music records (or tapes) 6 light; kindle See 20839936放火fang4huo3放火 7 lend (money) at interest; loan 他的錢全放出去了, 一時收不回來。 Tā de qián quán fàng chūqu le, yīshí shōu bù huílai. All his money has been loaned out. He can’t get it back for the moment. 8 make larger or longer; let out; let down 放幾張相片 Fàng jǐ zhāng xiàng piān have a few photos enlarged 把這條裙子放長一點兒。 Bǎ zhè tiáo qúnzi fàng cháng yīdiǎnr. Let out the hem on this skirt a little. 褲腰要放一釐米。 Kùyāo yào fàng yī límǐ. Please let these trousers out 1 cm at the waist. 9 moderate (one's attitude or behaviour) 放老實點兒！ Fàng lǎoshi diǎnr! You behave yourself! 放明白些。 Fàng míngbai xiē. Be sensible. 放低聲音慢慢地說。 Fàng dī shēngyīn mànmàn de shuō. Lower your voice and speak slowly. 腳步請放輕些！ Jiǎobù qǐng fàng qīng xiē! Tread softly, please. 把速度放慢點兒。 Bǎ sùdù fàngmàn diǎnr. Slow down a little. 10 (of flowers) blossom; open 花園裡百花齊放。 Huāyuán lǐ bǎihuā qí fàng. The garden is blooming with flowers. 11 put; place; lay 把書放在桌上。 Bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō shàng. Put the book on the desk. 你來放碗筷吧。 Nǐ lái fàng wǎn-kuài ba. Will you set the table for dinner? 她放下筆, 拿起書。 Tā fàngxia bǐ, ná qǐ shū. She laid down her pen and took up a book. 湯裡放點兒胡椒粉。 Tāng lǐ fàng diǎnr hújiāofěn. Put some pepper in the soup. 把人民利益放在個人利益之上。 Bǎ rénmín lìyì fàng zài gèrén lìyì zhīshàng. Place the interests of the people above personal interests. 12 colloquial cause sth. (or sb.) to fall to the ground 上山放樹 Shàngshān fàng shù go to the mountains to fell trees 他三下兩下就把那個壞蛋放倒了。 Tā sān xià liǎng xià jiù bǎ nàge huàidàn fàng dào le. With just a few blows, he knocked the hooligan down to the ground. 13 lay aside; store away (for future use); keep 鮮牛奶不能放得太久。 Xiān niúnǎi bù néng fàng de tài jiǔ. Fresh milk won’t keep long. 這魚怕放不住。 Zhè yú pà fàng bù zhù. This fish won’t keep, I’m afraid. 這事不急, 先放一放再說。 Zhè shì bù jí, xiān fàng yī fàng zàishuō. It’s not an urgent matter. Let’s lay it aside for the moment. 14 [followed by 著…不…] allow sth. to remain (undone, untaken, unused, etc.) 怎麼了, 放著覺不睡, 卻到處亂跑？ Zěnme le, fàng zhe jiào bù shuì, què dàochù luànpǎo？ Why are you running around instead of going to bed? 放著這麼多好書不看, 多可惜啊！ fàng zhe zhème duō hǎo shū bù kàn, duō kěxī a! What a pity all these fine books are left untouched!

verb approach; approximate; be close to 年近六十 nián jìn liùshí approaching sixty; getting on for sixty 觀眾近萬人。 Guānzhòng jìn wàn rén. There were nearly 10,000 spectators. adjective 1 near; close 近百年史 Jìn bǎinián shǐ history of the last hundred years 住得近 Zhù de jìn live nearby 歌聲由遠而近。 Gēshēng yóu yuǎn ér jìn. The singing came closer and closer. 離國慶節很近了。 Lí Guóqìngjié hěn jìn le. National Day is drawing near. or It’ll soon be National Day. 2 intimate; closely related 兩家走得挺近。 Liǎng jiā zǒu de tǐng jìn. The two families are on intimate terms. 3 easy to understand 淺近 qiǎnjìn simple; easy to understand

adjective 1 (of space or time) far away; distant; remote 遠山 yuǎnshān distant mountain 離這兒多遠？ Lí zhèr duō yuǎn？ How far is it from here? 到山頂上挺遠的。 Dào shāndǐng shàng tǐng yuǎn de. It’s a long way to the top of the mountain. 誰能看得這麼遠？ Shuínéng kànde zhèmeyuǎn? Who could have seen so far ahead? 遠在公元十一世紀, 中國已使用火藥。 Yuǎn zài gōngyuán shíyī shìjì, Zhōngguó yǐ shǐyòng huǒyào. Gunpowder was used in China as far back as the 11th century. 2 (of blood relationship) distant 遠表 yuǎn biǎo distant cousin 3 (of mind, learning, etc.) abstruse; profound 遠奧 yuǎn'ào abstruse; recondite verb keep away from; keep at a distance 遠避 yuǎnbì avoid and keep away from 他這個人很危險, 你最好遠著他一點兒。 Tā zhège rén hěn wēixiǎn, nǐ zuì hǎo yuǎn zhe tā yīdiǎnr. He is quite dangerous; you’d better keep away from him. 親賢臣, 遠小人, 此先漢所以興隆也; 親小人, 遠賢臣, 此後漢所以傾頹也。(諸葛亮《出師表》) qīn xiánchén, yuǎn xiǎorén, cǐ xiān Hàn suǒyǐ xīnglóng yě; qīn xiǎorén, yuǎn xiánchén, cǐhòu Hàn suǒyǐ qīngtuí yě. Attracting worthy men and repelling mean men—this achieved the glory of the Former Han; attracting mean men and repelling worthy men—this ruined the Later Han. adverb (of difference) by far; far and away 遠遠超過 yuǎnyuǎn chāoguò far exceed 我遠不及我姐姐聰明。 Wǒ yuǎn bùjí wǒ jiějie cōngming. I’m nowhere near as clever as my sister. 這個問題遠比那個重要。 Zhège wèntí yuǎn bǐ nàge zhòngyào. This problem is far more important than that. 城裡這家飯店遠比別家好。 Chénglǐ zhè jiā fàndiàn yuǎn bǐ bié jiā hǎo. This is by far the best hotel in town.

noun 1 face (of people or animals) 背過臉去 bèiguo liǎn qù turn one’s face away 2 front part of sth. 門臉兒 mènliǎnr front of a shop 3 figurative face; self-respect 露臉 lòuliǎn gain face 竟然有臉來 jìngrán yǒu liǎn lái have the impudence to come 4 facial expression; face 變臉 biànliǎn get angry 拉長了臉 lācháng le liǎn pull (or put on, wear) a long face

verb leave; depart from; deviate from 離開北京去上海 líkāi Běijīng qù Shànghǎi leave Beijing for Shanghai 離開崗位 líkāi gǎngwèi leave one’s post 離開正道 líkāi zhèngdào stray from (or off) the right path 離開主題 líkāi zhǔtí depart (or digress) from the subject 突然離開 tūrán líkāi take one’s departure suddenly 小孩子離不開媽媽。 xiǎoháizilí bù kāi māma. Children cannot do without their mothers.

noun process; course 事件的全部經過 Shìjiàn de quánbù jīngguò the whole course of the incident; the whole process from beginning to end 事情的經過是這樣的。 Shìqing de jīngguò shì zhèyàng de. This is how it happened. verb pass; go through; undergo 經過長期磨煉 jīngguò chángqī mó liàn undergo a long process of tempering 這路車經過動物園嗎？ zhè lù chē jīngguò dòngwùyuán ma? Does this bus pass the Zoo? preposition as a result of; after; through 經過討論, 取得了一致意見。 jīngguò tǎolùn, qǔdé le yīzhì yìjian. After discussion unanimity was achieved. 經過搶救, 病人脫離了危險。 Jīngguò qiǎngjiù, bìngrén tuōlí le wēixiǎn. The patient is out of danger after emergency treatment.

verb 1 live; reside; stay 住城外 Zhù chéngwài live in the suburbs 住旅館 zhù lǚguǎn stay at a hotel 對面沒人住。 Duìmiàn méi rén zhù. Nobody lives opposite me. 他住在北京。 Tā zhù zài Běijīng. He lives in Beijing. 我住這間屋。 Wǒ zhù zhè jiān wū. I live in this room. or This is my room. 我們住上了新房。 Wǒmen zhù shàng le xīnfáng. We’ve moved into a new house. 2 stop; cease 雨住了。 Yǔ zhù le. The rain has stopped. 等風住了再走。 Děng fēng zhù le zài zǒu. Go when the wind drops. 3 [after a verb] firmly; to a stop 支持不住 zhīchíbuzhù cannot withstand; cannot hold out 拿住了, 別撒手。 Ná zhù le, bié sāshǒu. Hold tight and don’t let go. 她擋住了我的去路。 Tā dǎngzhù le wǒ de qù lù. She blocked my way. 這一下你可把我問住了。 Zhè yī xià nǐ kě bǎ wǒ wèn zhù le. You’ve got me there. or I don’t know what to say. 聽到這個消息我一下子愣住了。 Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi wǒ yīxiàzi lèng zhù le. I was struck dumb at the news. 悠揚的小提琴聲把我吸引住了。 Yōuyáng de xiǎotíqín shēng bǎ wǒ xīyǐn zhù le. The beautiful notes of a violin held me spellbound.

My home is only two bus stops from the square. 9 indicating state of mind 心地善良 xīndì shànliáng kind-hearted; good-natured 頗有見地 Pōyǒu jiàndì very insightful

verb 1 fall; drop; shed; come off 掉眼淚 diào yǎnlèi shed tears 掉水裡了 diào shuǐli le fall into the water 鎬頭掉了。 Gǎotou diào le. The pick-head has fallen off. 車前燈掉了。 chēqiándēng diào le. They seem to have been close friends for many years. 她們倆處得好像親姐妹一樣。 Tāmen liǎ chǔ de hǎoxiàng qīnjiěmèi yīyàng. The two of them were as intimate as sisters. 這個人我好像在哪兒見過。 zhège rén wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎr jiàn guò. I seem to have met this man before.

adjective 1 simple; uncomplicated (opp. 複雜) 簡單明了 jiǎndānmíngliǎo simple and clear; concise and explicit 簡單拼湊 jiǎndān pīncòu simply piercing together 吃得很簡單 Chī de hěn jiǎndān have simple food 生活得很簡單 shēnghuó de hěn jiǎndān lead a simple life 事情沒那麼簡單。 Shìqing méi nàme jiǎndān. There is more to it. 這機器構造簡單。 Zhè jīqì gòuzào jiǎndān. The machine is simple in structure. 2 [usu. in the negative] commonplace; ordinary 她的槍法那麼準, 真不簡單。 Tā de qiāngfǎ nàme zhǔn, zhēn bù jiǎndān. She’s a marvel to be able to shoot with such accuracy. 這家伙鬼點子特多, 可不簡單。 Zhè jiāhuo guǐdiǎnzi tè duō, kě bù jiǎndān. This fellow is no simpleton. He is full of tricks. 3 oversimplified; casual 簡單粗暴 jiǎndāncūbào do things in an oversimplified and crude way 不能用簡單的方法去解決這個問題。 Bù néng yòng jiǎndān de fāngfǎ qù jiějué zhège wèntí. This matter cannot be settled in a summary fashion. 這篇文章我只是簡單地看了看。 Zhè piān wénzhāng wǒ zhǐshì jiǎndān de kàn le kàn. I only skimmed through this article.

pronoun other; else 見到其他人了嗎？ Jiàndào qítā rén le ma？ Did you see anybody else? 老李在這兒, 其他人呢？ Lǎo lǐ zài zhèr, qítā rén ne？ Lao Li’s here. Where are the others? 先揀重要的說, 再說其他。 Xiān jiǎn zhòngyào de shuō, zàishuō qítā. Say what you think is most important first, then go on to other things. 還有什麼其他事情要我們做嗎？ Háiyǒu shénme qítā shìqing yào wǒmen zuò ma？ Is there anything else you want us to do? 除了小馮以外, 其他人都去了。 Chúle Xiǎo Féng yǐwài, qítā rén dōu qùle. Everybody went except Xiao Feng. 我同意老王的建議, 沒有其他意見。 Wǒ tóngyì lǎo wáng de jiànyì, méiyǒu qítā yìjian. I agree with Lao Wang on his proposal and have nothing else to add.

colloquial adjective 1 about the same; similar 姐妹倆長相差不多。 Jiěmèi liǎ zhǎngxiàng chàbuduō. The two sisters look very much alike. 他們倆高矮差不多。 Tāmen liǎ gāo'ǎi chàbuduō. The two of them are about the same height. 2 just about right; just about enough; not far off; not bad 麥子熟得差不多了, 該割了。 Màizi shú de chàbuduō le, gāi gē le. The wheat is just about ripe enough to be cut. 那件行李你扛不動, 我扛還差不多。 Nà jiàn xíngli nǐ káng budong, wǒ káng hái chàbuduō. That luggage is too heavy for you, but I can carry it. adverb almost; nearly 差不多一半同學都學過英語。 Chàbuduō yībàn tóngxué dōu xué guò Yīngyǔ. Nearly half the students have learned English. 你比我差不多高一頭。 Nǐ bǐ wǒ chàbuduō gāo yī tóu. You’re almost a head taller than me. 我差不多等了兩個小時。 Wǒ chàbuduō děng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí. I waited for nearly two hours.

You’ll like it, I assure you. or Satisfaction guaranteed. 6 hire; book; charter 包一條船 bāo yī tiáo chuán hire (or charter) a boat 包三桌酒席 bāo sān zhuō jiǔxí reserve three tables for a banquet measure word package; bundle 兩包大米 liǎng bāo dàmǐ two sacks of rice 一包棉紗 yī bāo miánshā a bale of cotton yarn 一包香煙 yī bāo xiāngyān a packet (or pack) of cigarettes 一大包衣服 yī dà bāo yīfu a big bundle of clothes

noun 1 sugar 你喝茶擱糖嗎？ Nǐ hēchá gē táng ma？ Do you take sugar in your tea? 咖啡裡少擱點兒糖。 Kāfēi lǐ shǎo gē diǎnr táng. Don’t put too much sugar in the coffee. 2 sweets; candy; sweetmeats 一袋糖 yī dài táng a bag of sweets 吃塊兒糖。 Chī kuàirtáng. Have a candy. 3 VARIANT OF 31168000碳水化合物tan4shui3hua4he2wu4碳水化合物 carbohydrate

noun 1 taste; flavour 這個菜味道很好。 Zhège cài wèidao hěn hǎo. This dish is delicious. 感冒時吃東西沒味道。 gǎnmào shí chī dōngxi méi wèidao. When you have a cold, you can’t taste anything. 2 feeling; taste; experience 心裡有一股說不出的味道 Xīnli yǒu yī gǔ shuō bù chū de wèidao have an indescribable feeling 他的話裡有點兒諷刺的味道。 Tā dehuà lǐ yǒudiǎnr fěngcì dewèidao. There’s a touch of irony in his remarks. 3 interest; delight 這本書越看越有味道。 Zhè běn shū yuè kàn yuè yǒu wèidao. The more you read of the book, the more it absorbs you. 4 dialect smell; odour 這味道真難聞。 Zhè wèidao zhēn nánwén. What an unpleasant smell! or This smells bad! 她身上散發著一種特別的味道。 Tā shēnshang sànfā zhe yī zhǒng tèbié dewèidao. She gives off a special smell.

noun chemistry acid 酸污染 suān wūrǎn acid pollution adjective 1 sour; tart 酸果 suān guǒ tart fruit 酸梨 suānlí sour pear 牛奶酸了。 Niúnǎi suān le. The milk has turned sour. 2 sick at heart; grieved; distressed 大娘鼻子一酸, 流下淚來。 Dàniáng bízi yī suān, liúxià lèi lái. Feeling a twinge in her nose, the old woman began to weep. 3 pedantic; impractical 酸秀才 suānxiùcai impractical old scholar; priggish pedant adjective tingle; ache 腰酸背痛 yāosuānbèitòng have a pain in the back; have a backache

adjective 1 bitter (opp. 甘, 甜) 這藥苦極了。 Zhè yào kǔ jíle. This medicine tastes very bitter. 2 hardship; suffering; pain 苦地方 kǔ dìfang place with harsh natural conditions 苦慣了 kǔ guàn le (be) inured to hardships 苦日子 Kǔrìzi hard times 3 dialect cut off too much; be worn out 指甲剪得太苦 Zhǐjia jiǎn de tài kǔ trim one’s nails too short verb 1 cause sb. suffering; give sb. a hard time 這事可苦了他了。 Zhè shì kě kǔ le tā le. This matter really gave him a hard time. 2 suffer from; be troubled by 苦旱 kǔhàn suffer from drought adverb painstakingly; doing one's utmost 苦讀 kǔdú study hard 苦勸 kǔquàn earnestly advise; try hard to persuade meaningful bound form picr(o)- 苦醇 kǔ chún picrol

noun 1 archaic washbasin 2 shallow flat receptacle, as a tray, plate, dish, etc. 茶盤 chápán tea tray 3 dialect face; appearance 盤亮 pán liàng good-looking; pretty 4 market quotation; current price 大盤 dàpán overall situation in the securities market verb 1 coil (up); wind; twist 把繩子盤起來 bǎ shéngzi pán qǐlai coil up the rope 把頭髮盤成一個髻 bǎ tóufa pán chéng yī ge jì comb one’s hair into a coil or bun 2 build (by laying bricks, stones, etc.) 盤灶 pán zào build a brick cooking range 3 check; examine; interrogate 盤究 pánjiū cross-question; investigate 4 transfer the ownership of; make over to sb. else 把整個廠連同設備盤給人家 bǎ zhěnggè chǎng liántóng shèbèi pán gěi rénjia transfer the ownership of the factory with all its equipment to another person 5 carry; transport 從倉庫往外頭盤東西 cóng cāngkù wǎng wài tóu pán dōngxi carry things out of the warehouse measure word 1 [for dishes, millstones, etc.] 四盤菜 sì pán cài four dishes 一盤磨 yī pán mó a pair of millstones 一盤電線 yī pán diànxiàn a coil of electric cable 2 sports game; set 下一盤棋 xià yī pán qí play a game of chess 以六比零勝了這一盤 yǐ liù bǐ líng shèng le zhè yī pán win the set in six straight games

adjective whole; complete; total; all 全部開支 Quánbù kāizhī total expenditure 糧食全部自給 liángshi quánbù zìjǐ be completely self-supporting in food grain 要求賠償全部損失 yāoqiú péicháng quánbù sǔnshī demand full compensation for the loss incurred 全部情況就這樣。 Quánbù qíngkuàng jiù zhèyàng. That’s all there is to it. 他們全部是學生。 Tāmen quánbù shì xuésheng. All of them are students.

conjunction but; yet; still; nevertheless 一項宏大但是不切實際的計劃 Yī xiàng hóngdà dànshì bùqièshíjì de jìhuà a grandiose but impracticable plan 他雖然能幹, 但是這個問題太難, 他也不好解決。 tā suīrán nénggàn, dànshì zhège wèntí tài nán, tā yě bù hǎo jiějué. He’s an able man, but the problem is too hard for him. 不能聽從你, 但是我感謝你說了這番話。 Bùnéng tīngcóng nǐ, dànshì wǒ gǎnxiè nǐ shuō le zhèfān huà. I can’t follow your advice. Nevertheless, thank you for giving it.
adjective salted; pickled; salty 鹹蛋 xiándàn salted egg 鹹魚 xiányú salt fish 菜太鹹了。 Cài tài xián le. The dish is too salty.

noun possessions 盡其所有 jìnqísuǒyǒu give everything one has; give one’s all verb own; possess 這些樂器屬學校所有。 Zhèxiē yuèqì shǔ xuéxiào suǒyǒu. These musical instruments belong to the school. adjective all 把所有的勁兒都使出來 Bǎ suǒyǒu de jìnr dōu shǐ chūlai exert all one’s strength

noun need 從群眾的需要出發 Cóng qúnzhòng de xūyào chūfā make the needs of the masses our starting point 適應形勢發展的需要 shìyìng xíngshì fāzhǎn de xūyào adapt to the needs of the developing conditions verb need; want; require; demand 這本書我非常需要。 Zhè běn shū wǒ fēicháng xūyào. I need this book badly. 這所房子需要修理。 Zhè suǒ fángzi xūyào xiūlǐ. The house wants repairing. 這種情況需要立即採取措施。 Zhèzhǒng qíngkuàng xūyào lìjí cǎiqǔ cuòshī. This situation requires (or demands) immediate action. 壞習慣一旦養成, 需要很長的時間才能根除。 Huài xíguàn yīdàn yǎngchéng, xūyào hěn cháng de shíjiān cái néng gēnchú. A bad habit once contracted takes a very long time to uproot (or root up).

verb 1 bake; roast; toast; broil 烤鵝 kǎo é roast goose 烤魚 kǎoyú grilled fish 烤白薯 kǎo báishǔ baked sweet potatoes 烤焦了 kǎo jiāo le scorched 烤饅頭 kǎo mántou toasted steamed buns 烤牛肉 kǎoniúròu broiled beef 烤鮮貝 kǎo xiān bèi baked scallop 把濕衣裳烤幹 bǎ shī yīshang kǎo gān dry wet clothes by a fire 2 keep warm by a fire 在火邊烤烤腳 zài huǒ biān kǎo kǎo jiǎo toast (or warm) one’s feet by a fire adjective scorching; broiling; parching 這爐子太烤人。 Zhè lúzi tài kǎo rén. This stove is really scorching.
1 or 2 either one or the other

conjunction colloquial if; suppose; in case 要是下雨怎麼辦？ Yào shi xiàyǔ zěnme bàn？ What if it rains? or Suppose it rains? 要是別人, 我才不管呢。 Yào shi biéren, wǒ cái bù guǎn ne. If it had been somebody else, I wouldn’t have bothered myself.

verb 1 cross; pass 過河 guòhé cross a river 爬雪山, 過草地 pá xuěshān, guò cǎodì climb snow-topped mountains and cross the grasslands 遊行隊伍要從我們街區過。 yóuxíng duìwu yào cóng wǒmen jiēqū guò. The parade will pass through our neighbourhood. 2 spend (time); pass (time) 過生日 guò shēngri celebrate one’s birthday 春節在工地上過 Chūnjié zài gōngdì shàng guò spend the Spring Festival at the construction site 假期過得怎樣？ Jiàqī guò de zěnyàng？ How did you spend your holiday? 日子越來越好過了。 Rìzi yuèláiyuè hǎo guò le. Life is getting better and better. 3 transfer; move to 你的工資已過到賬上。 nǐ de gōngzī yǐ guò dào zhàng shàng. Your salary has been transferred to your account. 4 go through; undergo (a process) See 22212864過秤guo4cheng4過秤 5 review; go over 咱們把稿子再過一遍。 Zánmen bǎ gǎozi zài guò yī biàn. Let’s go over the draft once again. 6 go beyond; after (a certain point of time) 我過兩天再來。 Wǒ guò liǎng tiān zài lái. I’ll come again in a couple of days. 過了夏至, 天就開始變短。 Guò le Xiàzhì, tiān jiù kāishǐ biàn duǎn. The days get shorter after the Summer Solstice. 過了好幾個月我才收到他的信。 Guò le hǎojǐ ge yuè wǒ cái shōudào tā de xìn. Several months passed before I heard from him. 7 exceed; go beyond 雪深過膝。 Xuě shēn guò xī. The snow is more than knee-deep. 畝產過千斤。 Mǔchǎn guò qiān jīn. The yield is over 1,000 jin per mu. 樹長得過了房。 Shù zhǎng de guò le fáng. The tree has grown taller than the house. 小心別坐過了站。 Xiǎoxīn bié zuò guò le zhàn. Make sure you don’t go past your station. 8 visit See 22216192過訪guo4fang3過訪 9 euphemistic pass away; die 老太太過了好幾天了。 Lǎotàitaiguò le hǎojǐtiān le. The old woman died several days ago. noun fault; mistake (opp. 功) See 22213376過錯guo4cuo4過錯 adverb 1 excessively; over 過長 guò cháng too long; unduly long 過早 guòzǎo too early; premature 雨水過多 Yǔshuǐ guò duō excessive rainfall; too much rain 2 physics chemistry per-; super-; over- 過熔 guò róng superfusion See 61551843過氧化物guo4yang3hua4wu4過氧化物 3 [after a verb plus 得 or 不 to indicate winning or deserving] 要說跑, 咱們誰也比不過他。 Yào shuō pǎo, zánmen shuí yě bǐ bù guò tā. None of us runs as fast as he. 這樣的大學生, 我們信得過。 Zhèyàng de dàxuéshēng, wǒmen xìndeguò. We have confidence in college students like this sort.

noun 1 handle (of a pushcart, etc.) 自行車把 Zìxíngchē bǎ bicycle handlebars 2 bundle; bunch 草把 cǎo bǎ a bundle of straw verb 1 hold; grasp 把犁 bǎ lí handle a plough 把著手教 bǎzhe shǒu jiāo patiently teach step by step 把住欄杆 Bǎ zhù lángān hold on to a railing 2 hold (a baby while it urinates) 給孩子把尿 gěi háizi bǎ niào hold a baby out to pee 3 control; monopolize; dominate 什麼都把著不放手 shénme dōu bǎ zhe bù fàngshǒu keep a tight control on everything 4 guard; watch 把大門 bǎ dàmén guard a gate 5 colloquial close to; be located at 把牆角兒站著 Bǎ qiáng juér zhànzhe stand in the corner 把著衚衕口兒有個小飯館。 Bǎ zhe hútòng kǒur yǒu ge xiǎo fànguǎn. There is a small restaurant at the entrance of the alley. 6 colloquial give measure word 1 [for sth. with a handle] 一把茶壺 yī bǎ cháhú a teapot 一把刀 yī bǎ dāo a knife 一把扇子 Yī bǎ shànzi a fan 2 handful of 一把花 yī bǎ huā a bunch of flowers 一把米 yī bǎ mǐ a handful of rice 3 [for certain abstract concepts] 加把勁兒 Jiā bǎ jìnr! make an extra effort; put on a spurt 一把好手 yī bǎ hǎoshǒu an efficient (or skillful) worker 有把力氣 yǒu bǎ lìqi be quite strong 有一把年紀 yǒu yī bǎ niánjì be getting on in years 4 [for sth. done with the hand] 幫他一把 bāng tā yī bǎ give him a helping hand; pull him out of difficulties 拉他一把 lā tā yī bǎ give him a pull; give (or lend) him a hand preposition [used to shift the object ahead of the verb, which must be reduplicated or accompanied by some other word or expression] 把人急死 bǎ rén jí sǐ worry one to death; extremely worried 把頭一扭 bǎ tóu yī niǔ toss one’s head 把衣服洗洗 bǎ yīfu xǐ xǐ wash the clothes 把方便讓給別人, 把困難留給自己 bǎ fāngbiàn ràng gěi biéren, bǎ kùnnan liúgěi zìjǐ take on the difficulties and leave the easy part to others 他不把我當人。 Tā bù bǎ wǒ dāng rén. He doesn’t treat me like a human being. or He treats me without respect. 別害怕, 他能把你怎麼樣？ Bié hàipà, tā néng bǎ nǐ zěnmeyàng？ Don’t be afraid, what can he do to you? 這一趟可把他累壞了。 Zhè yī tàng kě bǎ tā lèi huài le. That trip really tired him out. auxiliary [after 百, 千, 萬, 里, 丈, 頃, 斤, 個, etc., without numeral] about; or so 百把人 bǎi bǎ rén some hundred people; around a hundred people 個把月 gèbǎyuè about a month; a month or so adjective dated sworn 把嫂 bǎ sǎo a sworn sister-in-law 把兄 bǎxiōng a sworn brother

preposition [used in a passive structure to introduce either the doer of the action, or the action alone] 被擒 bèiqín be caught 他被對手擊倒。 Tā bèi duìshǒu jīdǎo. He was knocked down by his opponent. 她被選為主席。 Tā bèi xuǎn wéi zhǔxí. She was elected chairwoman. 那棵樹被大風颳倒了。 Nà kē shù bèi dà fēng guā dǎo le. The tree was uprooted by the gale. noun quilt 做一床被 Zuò yī chuáng bèi make a new quilt verb literary 1 cover (with) See 17376768被覆bei4fu4被覆 2 suffer 被災 bèi zāi suffer from a disaster

verb 1 give way; give ground; yield; give up; concede 各不相讓。 Gèbùxiāngràng. Neither is willing to give ground. 誰都讓他三分。 Shuí dōu ràng tā sānfēn. Everybody has to let him have his way somehow. 我讓了他兩步棋(=兩個子)。 Wǒ ràng le tā liǎng bù qí. I have conceded him two moves (or two pieces) (in a chess game). 你該讓著弟弟一點兒。 Nǐ gāi ràng zhe dìdi yīdiǎnr. You ought to humour your younger brother a little. 2 invite; offer 讓茶 Ràngchá offer sb. tea 把客人讓進裡屋 bǎ kèren ràng jìn lǐwū invite guests into the inner room 3 let; allow; make 讓我想一想。 Ràng wǒ xiǎng yī xiǎng. Let me think it over. 展品不讓摸。 Zhǎnpǐn bù ràng mō. The exhibits are not to be touched. 別讓老王為難了。 Bié ràng lǎo wáng wéinán le. Don’t embarrass Wang. or Don’t make things awkward for Wang. 對不起, 讓你久等了。 Duìbuqǐ, ràng nǐ jiǔděng le. Sorry to have kept you waiting. 4 let sb. have sth. at a fair price 我把書按原價讓給他了。 Wǒ bǎ shū àn yuánjià ràng gěi tā le. I’ve turned my book over to him at the original price. 5 be inferior to; not as good as 巾幗不讓鬚眉。 Jīnguó bù ràng xūméi. Women are no inferior to men. 6 give way; step aside 請讓一讓。 Qǐng ràng yī ràng. Please make way. or Excuse me. 7 [expressing wishes] 讓我們永不分離。 ràng wǒmen yǒngbù fēnlí. May we never separate. preposition [in a passive sentence to introduce the doer of the action] 行李讓雨淋濕了。 Xíngli ràng yǔ lín shī le. The luggage got wet in the rain. 她讓他給氣跑了。 Tā ràng tā gěi qì pǎo le. He made her so angry that she left in a huff.

conjunction [often correlatively with 但是, 可是,etc.] though; although 他雖然在北京住了十來年, 可家鄉口音一點兒沒改。 Tā suīrán zài Běijīng zhù le shí láinián, kě jiāxiāng kǒuyin yīdiǎnr méi gǎi. Though he has lived in Beijing for ten years or so, he still speaks with a heavy accent.

pronoun so; such; this way; like this 大家都這麼說。 Dàjiā dōu zhème shuō. So they all say. or That’s what everyone says. 那個句子應該這麼譯。 Nàge jùzi yīnggāi zhème yì. The sentence should be translated like this. 他就是這麼個人。 Tā jiù shì zhème ge rén. That’s just like him. 有這麼回事。 Yǒu zhème huí shì. Yes, that’s true. 往這麼挪一挪。 Wǎng zhème nuó yī nuó. Move over this way a little bit.

adjective original 本來的意思 běnlái de yìsi original meaning (or intention) adverb 1 originally; at first 大會本來定於星期五舉行。 dàhuì běnlái dìngyú Xīngqīwǔ jǔxíng. The meeting was originally fixed for Friday. 他本來身體很瘦弱。 Tā běnlái shēntǐ hěn shòuruò. He used to be thin and weak. 我本來就反對這項計劃。 Wǒ běnlái jiù fǎnduì zhè xiàng jìhuà. I opposed the plan from the very first. 2 it goes without saying; of course 本來就該這樣辦。 Běnlái jiù gāi zhèyàng bàn. Of course it should be handled that way. 你本來用不著著急。 Nǐ běnlái yòngbuzháo zháojí. You needn’t have worried. 這樣的事本來不應該發生。 Zhèyàng de shì běnlái bù yīnggāi fāshēng. Such a thing should never have happened in the first place.

auxiliary [fusion of 了and 啊] 他早來啦！ Tā zǎo lái la! Why, he’s been here a long time! 她真來啦？ Tā zhēn lái la？ Has she really come? 二組跟我們挑戰啦。 Èr zǔ gēn wǒmen tiǎozhàn la. Look! Group B has sent us a challenge. 這回我可親眼看見啦！ Zhè huí wǒ kě qīnyǎn kànjian la! This time I’ve actually seen it for myself.
auxiliary [used in place of 啊 when the preceding word ends in sound a, e, i, o, or ü ] 快來呀。 Kuài lái ya. Come here, quick! 她是誰呀？ Tā shì shuí ya？ Who is she?

pronoun 1 like that; in that way; so 你不該那麼做。 Nǐ bù gāi nàme zuò. You shouldn’t have done that. or You oughtn’t to have acted that way. 她不好意思那麼說。 Tā bù hǎoyìsi nàme shuō. She was embarrassed to say that. 你那麼喜歡它, 就送給你作個紀念吧。 Nǐ nàme xǐhuan tā, jiù sòng gěi nǐ zuò ge jìniàn ba. Since you like it so much, take it as a keepsake. 說說容易, 做起來可並不那麼容易。 Shuōshuo róngyì, zuò qǐlai kě bìng bù nàme róngyì. It’s easier said than done. 問題沒有他想象的那麼複雜。 Wèntí méiyǒu tā xiǎngxiàng denàme fùzá. The problem is not as complicated as he imagines. 2 [before numerals to indicate approximation] about; or so 估計得走那麼三四個鐘頭才能到。 Gūjì de zǒu nàme sān, sì ge zhōngtóu cái néng dào. I think it will take three or four hours to get there. 再有那麼三公斤就夠了。 Zài yǒu nàme sān gōngjīn jiù gòu le. Another three kilograms or so will probably be enough. conjunction [used to connect a clause expressing a logical consequence to a conditional clause] then; in that case 既然這樣不行, 那麼你打算怎麼辦呢？ Jìrán zhèyàng bùxíng, nàme nǐ dǎsuan zěnme bàn ne？ Since that’s impossible, what are you going to do? 如果你們都要去, 那麼我就一個人留下吧。 Rúguǒ nǐmen dōu yào qù, nàme wǒ jiù yī ge rén liúxià ba. Since you all want to go, I’ll stay home alone.

verb think; believe; consider [usually erroneously] 我還以為是她呢。 Wǒ hái yǐwéi shì tā ne. I had thought it was her. 他以為那樣做比較好。 Tā yǐwéi nàyàng zuò bǐjiào hǎo. He considers it better to do it that way. 不要以為自己不了解的東西, 別人也不了解。 bùyào yǐwéi zìjǐ bù liǎojiě de dōngxi, biéren yě bù liǎojiě. You must not assume that things you yourselves cannot understand are not understood by others.

noun appointment; engagement; date 訂個約會 Dìng ge yuēhui make an appointment 事務性約會 Shìwùxìng yuēhui business appointment 我今天晚上有個約會。 Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang yǒu ge yuēhui. Have a pleasant journey. or Bon voyage! 祝我們兩國人民的友誼萬古長青！ Zhù wǒmen liǎng guó rénmín de yǒuyì wàngǔchángqīng! adjective 1 full; filled; packed 滿身是血 mǎn shēn shì xuè covered with blood 滿滿一卡車煤 mǎnmǎn yī kǎchē méi a full truckload of coal 滿腦子封建思想 mǎn nǎozi fēngjiàn sīxiǎng steeped in feudal ideology 果樹滿山坡。 Guǒshù mǎn shānpō. The slope was covered with fruit trees. 歡聲笑語滿山村。 Huānshēngxiàoyǔ mǎn shāncūn. The mountain village rang with cheers and laughter. 屋裡坐滿了人。 Wū lǐ zuò mǎn le rén. The room was packed with people. 兩個抽屜都滿了。 liǎng ge chōuti dōu mǎn le. Both drawers are full. 話不能說得太滿, 太絕。 huà bùnéng shuōde tài mǎn, tài jué. One shouldn’t speak in absolute terms, leaving no room for compromise. 2 satisfied 不滿 bùmǎn dissatisfied 3 complacent; conceited 自滿 zìmǎn complacent; self-satisfied verb 1 fill 再給你滿上(一杯)。 Zài gěi nǐ mǎn shàng yī bēi. Let me fill your glass once more. 2 expire; reach the limit 年滿十八的公民 Nián mǎn shíbā de gōngmín citizens who have reached the age of 18 假期已滿。 Jiàqī yǐ mǎn. The holidays are over. 她學徒還不滿一年。 Tā xuétú hái bù mǎn yī nián. It’s not quite a year since she became an apprentice. adverb 1 completely; entirely; perfectly 滿有信心 Mǎn yǒu xìnxīn be fully confident 滿不是那麼回事。 Mǎn bù shì nàme huí shì. That’s not what happened at all. 我滿以為他會同意的。 Wǒ mǎn yǐwéi tā huì tóngyì de. I had counted on him to agree. 2 quite; very 您說的滿對。 Nín shuō de mǎn duì. What you said is quite right. 這首歌滿好聽。 Zhè shǒu gē mǎn hǎotīng. This song is very pleasing. 節目倒也滿不錯。 Jiémù dào yě mǎn bùcuò. The performances were pretty good. noun (Mǎn) 1 Manchu ethnic group See 26518528滿族man3zu2滿族 2 a surname

verb 1 lose; mislay 這套書丟了一本。 Zhè tào shū diū le yī běn. There’s a book missing from the set. 我把鉗子丟哪兒了？ Wǒ bǎ qiánzi diū nǎr le？ Where have I left my pliers? 2 throw; cast; toss 把菜幫子丟給小兔吃 bǎ cài bāngzi diū gěi xiǎo tù chī throw the outer cabbage leaves to the rabbit 不要隨地丟果皮。 Bùyào suídì diū guǒpí. Please don’t litter. 3 put (or lay) aside 丟在腦後 diū zài nǎohòu put out of one’s mind; clean forget; completely ignore 只有這件事丟不開。 Zhǐyǒu zhè jiàn shì diū bù kāi. That’s the thing that keeps worrying me. or That’s my only worry. 我的法語丟了好幾年, 忘得差不多了。 wǒ de Fǎyǔ diū le hǎojǐ nián, wàng de chàbuduō le. I haven’t used my French for years and have forgotten most of it.

verb 1 exchange; barter; trade 用石油換工業品 Yòng shíyóu huàn gōngyèpǐn exchange (or barter) oil for industrial products 用鮮血換來的教訓 yòng xiānxuè huàn lái de jiàoxun lesson paid in blood 2 change 換衣服 huàn yīfu change one’s clothes 他換工作了嗎？ Tā huàn gōngzuò le ma？ Has he changed his job? 出去走一下, 換換腦筋。 Chūqu zǒu yī xià, huàn huàn nǎojīn. noun the same place 在一塊兒工作 Zài yīkuàir gōngzuò work at the same place 兩個人說不到一塊兒。 Liǎng ge rén shuō bù dào yīkuàir. The two of them can never see eye to eye. adverb together 我們一塊兒走吧。 Wǒmen yīkuàir zǒu ba. Let’s go together. 這兩個問題最好一塊兒研究。 Zhè liǎng ge wèntí zuì hǎo yīkuàir yánjiū. It would be best to consider the two questions together.

noun at the same time; simultaneously; meanwhile; in the meantime 同時存在 tóngshí cúnzài exist simultaneously; exist side by side; coexist 同時發生 tóngshí fāshēng happen at the same time; coincide; concur 在加快工程進度的同時, 必須注意質量。 Zài jiākuài gōngchéng jìndù detóngshí, bìxū zhùyì zhìliàng. While speeding up work on the project, we must pay attention to ensuring its quality. conjunction moreover; besides; furthermore 任務艱巨, 同時時間又很緊迫。 Rènwu jiānjù, tóngshí shíjiān yòu hěn jǐnpò. The task is arduous and besides, there’s little time. 造林可以保持水土, 同時也可以制止流沙。 Zàolín kěyǐ bǎochí shuǐtǔ, tóngshí yě kěyǐ zhìzhǐ liúshā. Afforestation conserves soil and water and also checks drift sand.

The gymnasts have all learnt to protect each other and themselves from injuries. noun protection; safeguarding 提供防盜保護 tígōng fángdào bǎohù provide protection from theft; burglary protection 在嚴密的保護下 zài yánmì debǎohù xià under heavy guard

verb 1 go out 他剛出門, 一會兒就回來。 Tā gāng chū mén, yīhuìr jiù huílai. He’s just gone out, and will be back soon. 2 leave home; go on a journey 出門在外, 要多加小心。 Chūmén zàiwài, yào duō jiā xiǎoxīn. Look after yourself when you’re away from home. 3 dialect (of a woman) get married; marry

verb 1 put up; build 搭窩 dāwō build a nest 搭帳篷 dā zhàngpeng pitch a tent 搭一個臨時舞臺 Dā yī ge línshí wǔtái put up a makeshift stage 2 hang over; put over 把洗好的衣服搭在繩上 bǎ xǐ hǎo de yīfu dā zài shéng shàng hang the washing on a line 3 come into contact; join 搭上關係 dāshang guānxi strike up a relationship with; establish contact with 前言不搭後語 qiányán bù dā hòuyǔ speak incoherently 4 throw in (more people, money, etc.); add 你忙不過來, 給你搭個人吧。 Nǐ mángbuguòlai, gěi nǐ dā gèrén ba. You’re terribly busy. We’ll send someone to help you. 5 lift sth. together 請幫我把這包大米搭上卡車。 qǐng bāng wǒ bǎ zhè bāo dàmǐ dā shàng kǎchē. Please help me lift the bag of rice onto the truck. 6 take (a ship, plane, etc.); travel (or go) by 搭輪船去上海 Dā lúnchuán qù Shànghǎi go to Shanghai by boat 搭某人的車走 dā mǒurén de chē zǒu get a lift in sb.’s car 7 combine 各種食物要搭著吃, 以保證營養均衡。 gèzhǒng shíwù yào dā zháochī, yǐ bǎozhèng yíngyǎng jūnhéng. Various kinds of food should be combined in diet to ensure balanced nutrition.

verb 1 (of birds or insects) fly; flit 飛鳥 fēiniǎo flying bird 老鷹飛得高。 Lǎoyīng fēi de gāo. Eagles fly high. 小鳥飛(走)了。 Xiǎoniǎo fēi le. The bird flew away. 蜜蜂在花叢中飛來飛去。 Mìfēng zài huā cóng zhōng fēi lái fēi qù. Bees are flitting from flower to flower. 2 (of an aircraft or its occupants) fly; travel by plane 我明天飛上海。 Wǒ míngtiān fēi Shànghǎi. I’m flying to Shanghai tomorrow. 那架飛機從北京直飛廣州。 Nà jià fēijī cóng Běijīng zhí fēi Guǎngzhōu. That plane flies nonstop from Beijing to Guangzhou. 3 hover or flutter in the air 飛絮 fēi xù willow catkins fluttering in the air 飛鳶 Fēi yuān a hovering kite 飛雪花了。 Fēi xuě huā le. It’s snowing. 4 colloquial disappear through volatilization 樟腦丸放久了會飛凈的。 Zhāngnǎowán fàng jiǔ le huì fēi jìng de. Camphor balls will disappear as time goes on. adverb (move) swiftly See 20860928飛奔fei1ben1飛奔 adjective unexpected; accidental; unfounded; groundless 飛禍 fēihuò unexpected disaster See 26086144流言飛語liu2yan2fei1yu3流言飛語 noun dialect free wheel (of a bicycle)

noun 1 [used alone, esp. in contrast to 上] below 上有父母, 下有兒女 Shàng yǒu fùmǔ, xià yǒu ér-nǚ have parents above and children below—have a large family to care for 上至市長, 下至一般市民 shàng zhì shìzhǎng, xià zhì yībān shìmín from the mayor down to ordinary townsfolk 2 [after a preposition] down; downward 往下看 wǎng xià kàn look down 他將帽沿向下拉了拉。 Tā jiāng mào yán xiàng xià lā le lā. He pulled his hat down slightly. 3 [after a noun] under 山下 shān xià at the foot of a hill 樹下 shù xià under a tree 零下五度 língxià wǔ dù five degrees below zero 在月光下散步 zài yuèguāng xià sànbù take a walk in the moonlight 4 [usu. before a noun] lower (in position, rank, or quality) 分為上, 中, 下三等 fēnwéi shàng, zhōng, xià sānděng divided into three grades: upper, middle and lower 那本書在書架的最下一層。 Nà běn shū zài shūjià de zuì xià yī céng. The book is on the bottom shelf. 5 next (in time or order); latter; second 下次 xiàcì next time 下禮拜 xiàlǐbài next week 下兩批 xià liǎng pī next two batches 下個世紀 xià ge shìjì next century 下一班車 xià yī bānchē next bus or train 6 the second of two, or the last of three 下集 xiàjí Volume Two or Three; Vol. II or III 下半學期 Xià bàn xuéqī second (or latter) half of the term 這部詞典分上, 中, 下三冊。 zhè bù cídiǎn fēn shàng, zhōng, xià sān cè. This dictionary comes in three volumes. 7 [before a verb] downward; down 防止圓木下滑 fángzhǐ yuán mù xiàhuá prevent the logs from rolling down 8 [indicating scope, state, condition, etc.] 在黨的領導下 zài dǎng de lǐngdǎo xià under the leadership of the Party 在這種情況下 zài zhèzhǒng qíngkuàng xià under these circumstances 在朋友們的幫助下 Zài péngyou men de bāngzhù xià with the help of friends 9 [in certain expressions of time] 時下 shíxià nowadays 年下 niánxià colloquial the lunar new year 10 [after numerals to indicate location or direction] 四下 sìxià far and near; all around 兩下裡 liǎngxiàli colloquial both parties; both sides verb 1 proceed down from; descend 下床 xiàchuáng get out of bed 下樓 xiàlóu descend the stairs; go or come downstairs 下山 xiàshān descend the mountain; come or go down a mountain 順流而下 shùnliú'érxià sail or go downstream 2 get off or get out of (a conveyance); alight; disembark 下車 xiàchē get off a car or bus 下電梯 xià diàntī get off an elevator 下飛機 xià fēijī get off a plane; alight from a plane; disembark 3 (of rain, snow, etc.) come down; fall 下雨 xiàyǔ rain 下雪 xiàxuě snow 下雹子了。 Xià báozi le. It’s hailing. 下霜了。 Xià shuāng le. There is frost. 下霧了。 Xià wù le. There’s a fog. 雪下得很大。 Xuě xià de hěn dà. A heavy snow is falling. or It’s snowing hard. 4 issue (an order, etc.); deliver; send out (an invitation, etc.) 下命令 xià mìnglìng issue (or give) orders 下請帖 xià qǐngtiě send an invitation 我們早下過通知了。 Wǒmen zǎo xià guò tōngzhī le. We have already sent out notices. 下訂單 xiàdìngdān place an order 5 go to (a place usu. thought of as lower or below) 下地獄 xià dìyù go to hell 下館子 xià guǎnzi go to eat in a restaurant; eat out 廠長下車間了。 Chǎngzhǎng xià chējiān le. The factory director has gone to the workshop. 6 leave (the stage, field, etc.); exit 這場戲你從右邊的旁門下。 Zhè chǎng xì nǐ cóng yòubian de pángmén xià. In this scene, you exit stage right. 換人, 四號下, 三號上。 Huànrén, sì hào xià, sān hào shàng. Substitution, No. 3 on, No. 4 off. 7 put in (ingredients or components of food, fertilizer, poison, capital, etc.); cast 下肥料 xià féiliào apply fertilizer 下麵條 xiàmian tiáo place noodles in a pot of boiling water; cook noodles in boiling water 下作料 Xià zuóliao put in the condiments; add seasonings; season 下網撈魚 xià wǎng lāo yú cast a net to catch fish 8 play (a board game); make a move (in a board game) 下圍棋 xià wéiqí play go 該你下了。 Gāi nǐ xià le. Your move. 9 take down or off; dismantle; unload 下了歹徒的槍 xià le dǎitú de qiāng disarm the brigand 把紗窗下下來 bǎ shāchuāng xià xiàlai take the screen window off 船上的貨還沒下完。 Chuánshàng de huò hái méi xià wán. The cargo is not fully unloaded yet. 10 give (a definition, conclusion, etc.) 下定義 xià dìngyì give a definition；define 下結論 xià jiélùn draw a conclusion 下決心 xià juéxīn make a resolution;determine;resolve to 11 apply; use 下刀 xià dāo cut; slice; put a knife to 下力氣 xià lìqi apply strength; make an effort; exert oneself 12 (of animals) give birth to; drop (a litter); lay (eggs) 下了一窩小豬 xià le yī wō xiǎo zhū give birth to (or drop) a litter of piglets 13 capture (a city); take 連下數城 lián xià shù chéng take several cities in succession 14 give in 相持不下 xiāngchíbùxià deadlock 15 get off (work); get out of (class) 下夜班 xià yèbān come off night duty 課早下了。 Kè zǎo xià le. The class was over a long time ago. 16 [in the negative] less than; at least 參加大會的不下三千人。 Cānjiā dàhuì de bù xià sānqiān rén. No less than 3,000 people attended the conference. or At least 3,000 people came to the conference. measure word 1 a [for verbs of action] stroke; time(s) 敲三下門 qiāo sān xià mén give three knocks on the door 推了我一下 Tuī le wǒ yīxià gave me a push 打了孩子幾下 dǎ le háizi jǐ xià spanked the child a couple of times 搖了幾下旗子 yáo le jǐ xià qízi waved the flag a few times b [for the capacity of a container] dialect 瓶子裡裝了半下墨水。 Píngzi lǐ zhuāng le bàn xià mòshuǐ. The bottle is half full of ink. 這麼大碗麵條, 他足足吃了三下。 Zhème dà wǎn miàntiáo, tā zúzú chī le sān xià. He wolfed down three large bowls of noodles. 2 [after 兩 or 幾] skill; ability; capability 我就會這麼兩下。 Wǒ jiù huì zhème liǎng xià. That’s all I can do. 想不到他還有幾下。 Xiǎng bù dào tā háiyǒu jǐ xià.
