adverb have to; forced to 只好作罷 zhǐhǎo zuòbà be forced to give up 銀行不給我們貸款, 我們只好另想辦法。 Yínháng bù gěi wǒmen dàikuǎn, wǒmen zhǐhǎo lìng xiǎng bànfǎ. The bank refused to grant us a loan so we had to seek other means. 末班車過去了, 我們只好走回家。 Mòbānchē guòqu le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zǒu huíjiā. The last bus has gone, so we have to walk home. 十點鐘他還不來, 只好我一個人先去了。 Shí diǎn zhōng tā hái bù lái, zhǐhǎo wǒ yī ge rén xiān qù le. By ten o’clock he still hadn’t turned up, so I had to go by myself.

adverb 1 perhaps; maybe; probably 代表團明晨或可到達。 Dàibiǎotuán míng chén huò kě dàodá. The delegation may arrive tomorrow morning. 2 literary [usu. in the negative] a little; a bit; slightly 不可或緩 bùkěhuòhuǎn brook no delay; urgent conjunction or; either... or... 無論唱或跳, 她都行。 Wúlùn chàng huò tiào, tā dōu xíng. She is good at both singing and dancing. 這塊地可以種高粱或玉米。 Zhè kuài dì kěyǐ zhòng gāoliang huò yùmǐ. You can grow sorghum or maize on this plot. pronoun literary someone; some people 或曰 huòyuē some may say; some people say

adjective 1 smelly; foul; stinking 臭味兒 chòu wèir stink; offensive odour; foul smell 臭雞蛋 chòu jīdàn rotten egg 2 disgusting; disgraceful 他的名聲早就臭了。 Tā de míngshēng zǎojiù chòu le. He has long been discredited. 3 colloquial poor; bad; lousy 臭招 chòuzhāo lousy move verb dialect fail to detonate 這顆子彈臭了。 Zhè kē zǐdàn chòu le. This bullet is a dud. adverb severely 被臭罵了一頓 Bèi chòumà le yī dùn get a tongue-lashing; get a dressing down 挨了一頓臭打 ái le yī dùn chòu dǎ get a good beating

noun 1 mouth (of a human being or animal) 張口 zhāngkǒu open one’s mouth 2 opening; mouth; entrance; exit 瓶口 píngkǒu mouth of a bottle 碗口 wǎnkǒu rim of a bowl 胡同口 hú·tòng kǒu entrance of an alley 信箱口 xìnxiāng kǒu slit of a letter box 3 [usu. in place names] gateway of the Great Wall 張家口 zhāng jiākǒu Zhangjiakou (in Hebei Province) 4 cut; hole; crack 衣服撕了個口。 yīfu sī le ge kǒu. A hole was torn in the jacket. 茶碗缺了個口。 Cháwǎn quē le ge kǒu. The rim of the teacup is chipped. 5 edge of a knife, etc.; blade 刀捲口了。 Dāo juǎn kǒu le. The edge of the knife is turned. 6 age of a draft animal 六歲口 Liù suì kǒu six years of age 這匹馬口還輕。 Zhè pǐ mǎ kǒu hái qīng. This horse is still young. 7 branch of government organs; departments 文教口 Wénjiào kǒu departments of cultural and educational affairs 8 one's taste See 25080320口輕kou3qing1口輕;25091072口重kou3zhong4 口重 measure word 1 [for family members, pigs, knives, etc.] 三口豬 sān kǒu zhū three pigs 一口井 yī kǒu jǐng a well 一家五口人 yī jiā wǔ kǒu rén a family of five 吸一口氣 Xī yī kǒu qì take a breath 被狗咬了一口 bèi gǒu yǎo le yī kǒu get bitten by a dog 說一口漂亮的北京話 shuō yī kǒu piàoliang de Běijīnghuà speak excellent Beijing dialect 2 mouthful 只吃了一口飯 zhǐ chī le yī kǒu fàn have only a mouthful of meal
noun 1 jar; pot; tin 水罐 shuǐguàn water pitcher 茶葉罐 cháyèguàn tea caddy 2 mining coal tub measure word jar; pot; tin 一罐蘋果醬 yī guàn píngguǒjiàng a jar of apple jam

measure word [usu. for sth. roundish] 一顆黃豆 yī kē huángdòu a soya bean 一顆炸彈 yī kē zhàdàn a bomb 無數顆星星 wúshù kē xīngxing an uncountable number of stars 他臉上的汗珠子一顆顆往下掉。 Tā liǎnshàng de hànzhū zi yī kē kē wǎng xià diào. Beads of sweat were dripping down from his face.

pronoun any; whichever; whatever; whoever; wherever 任何一方 Rènhé yī fāng either party; any of the parties 沒有任何理由拒絕這個建議。 Méiyǒu rènhé lǐyóu jùjué zhège jiànyì. There’s no reason whatsoever to turn down this suggestion.

noun possibility; probability 唯一可能 wéiyī kěnéng the only possible 事情發展有兩種可能。 Shìqing fāzhǎn yǒu liǎng zhǒng kěnéng. The matter may develop in two possible directions. adjective possible; probable; likely 可能的範圍 kěnéng de fànwéi possible range 可能的投資者 kěnéng de tóuzīzhě potential investor 唯一可能的解釋 Wéiyī kěnéng de jiěshì the only possible explanation adverb probably; possibly; maybe 可能要下雪了。 Kěnéng yào xiàxuě le. It looks like snow. 他不可能這麼快就到家。 Tā bù kěnéng zhème kuài jiù dào jiā. He couldn’t have got home so soon. 問題可能會得到解決。 Wèntí kěnéng huì dédào jiějué. The problem may be settled.

conjunction 1 and also 屋子很寬敞, 而且光線充足。 Wūzi hěn kuānchang, érqiě guāngxiàn chōngzú. The room is spacious and bright. 2 but also 我們不但戰勝了災害, 而且獲得了豐收。 Wǒmen bùdàn zhànshèng le zāihài, érqiě huòdé le fēngshōu. We not only came through the natural calamity, but also won a bumper harvest.

noun originally; formerly; at first 原來我抽煙, 現在不抽了。 yuánlái wǒ chōuyān, xiànzài bù chōu le. I used to smoke, but not now. adjective original; former 原來的計劃 Yuánlái de jìhuà original plan 他還是住在原來的地方。 Tā hái shì zhù zài yuánlái de dìfang. He still lives in the same place. adverb as a matter of fact; as it turns out; actually 原來是你呀！ Yuánlái shì nǐ ya! So it’s you. 這原來是個騙局。 Zhè yuánlái shì ge piànjú. It turned out to be a fraud. 你原來是這樣的朋友！ Nǐ yuánlái shì zhèyàng de péngyou! So that’s the kind of friend you are!
adverb perhaps; probably; maybe 他也許病了。 Tā yěxǔ bìng le. Perhaps he’s ill. 也許我不該告訴他的。 Yěxǔ wǒ bù gāi gàosu tā de. Perhaps I shouldn’t have told him.

adverb must; have to 必須指出 Bìxū zhǐchū it must be pointed out that 必須厲行節約。 Bìxū lìxíngjiéyuē. It is imperative to practise economy. 學習必須刻苦。 Xuéxí bìxū kèkǔ. Learning requires diligence. 共產黨員必須勇於批評和自我批評。 Gòngchǎndǎngyuán bìxū yǒngyú pīpíng hé zìwǒ pīpíng. A Communist must have the courage to criticize others as well as themselves.

number many; much; a great deal of; a lot of 許多人 xǔduō rén many people 積累了許多經驗 jīlěi le xǔduō jīngyàn have accumulated much experience 他講的內容, 許多是我不知道的。 Tā jiǎng de nèiróng, xǔduō shì wǒ bù zhīdao de. Much of what he said was new to me. 她好像一下子老了許多。 Tā hǎoxiàng yīxiàzi lǎo le xǔduō. She seems to have aged a lot. 現在也顧不得這許多了, 送病人去醫院要緊。 Xiànzài yě gùbude zhè xǔduō le, sòng bìngrén qù yīyuàn yào jǐn. We have no time to consider anything else. We have to rush the patient to hospital without delay.

adjective 1 fresh 新鮮空氣 xīnxian kōngqì fresh air 新鮮牛奶 xīnxian niúnǎi fresh milk 新鮮血液 xīnxian xuèyè fresh (or new) blood; new members (or forces); newcomer 新鮮的水果 xīnxian de shuǐguǒ fresh fruit 嘗個新鮮 Cháng ge xīnxian have a taste of what is just in season 魚有點兒不新鮮了。 yú yǒudiǎnr bù xīnxian le. The fish is slightly off. 2 new; novel; strange 新鮮經驗 xīnxian jīngyàn new (or fresh) experience 這話真新鮮。 Zhè huà zhēn xīnxian. That’s a strange thing to say.

adjective 1 ripe (opp. 生) 一年兩熟 yīniánliǎngshú two crops a year 西紅柿熟了。 Xīhóngshì shú le. The tomatoes are ripe. 2 cooked; done (opp. 生) 熟肉 shúròu cooked meat 飯熟了。 Fàn shú le. The rice is done. 3 processed (opp. 生) 熟皮子 shú pízi tanned leather 4 familiar; well acquainted (opp. 生) 我跟他很熟。 wǒ gēn tā hěn shú. I’m on familiar terms with him. 這條路他最熟。 Zhè tiáo lù tā zuì shú. He knows this route best. 這個地方我很熟。 Zhège dìfang wǒ hěn shú. I’m familiar with this place. 這口音聽起來很熟。 Zhè kǒuyin tīng qǐlai hěn shú. The voice sounds familiar. 5 skilled; experienced; practised (opp. 生) 熟精 shújīng be versed in sth. 6 (of a sleep) deep; sound 睡得很熟 Shuì de hěn shú sleep soundly

verb 1 stir-fry; sauté 炒黃瓜 chǎo huánggua sautéed cucumber 炒肉絲 chǎoròusī stir-fried shredded pork 2 roast and stir 糖炒栗子 táng chǎo lìzi chestnuts roasted (in sand) with brown sugar 3 colloquial speculate (in the stock exchange, etc.) 炒地皮 chǎodìpí speculate in real estate 炒股票 chǎogǔpiào speculate in shares 4 colloquial give exaggerated publicity; hype up 這部電影目前炒得很火。 Zhè bù diànyǐng mùqián chǎo de hěn huǒ. The film is being hyped up at the moment. 5 dialect fire; sack

verb 1 explode; burst 暖瓶炸了。 Nuǎnpíng zhà le. The thermos flask has burst. 2 blow up; blast; bomb 炸沉 zhàchén bomb and sink 炸毀 zhàhuǐ blow up; blast to pieces; demolish 炸平 zhà píng bomb flat 炸橋 Zhà qiáo blow up a bridge 把障礙物炸掉 bǎ zhàng'àiwù zhàdiào blast away the barriers 3 colloquial fly into a rage; flare up 肺都氣炸了 fèi dōu qì zhà le flare up; explode with rage 4 dialect scamper; flee in terror 炸市 zhàshì (of people in a marketplace) run in terror in all directions; stampede

adverb 1 [in questions, often replaced by 多 in spoken language] to what extent 洛陽離這裡有多麼遠？ Luòyáng lí zhèlǐ yǒu duōme yuǎn？ How far is Luoyang from here? 2 [in exclamations] to what an extent 多麼新鮮的水果啊！ Duōme xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ a. How fresh the fruit is! or What fresh fruit! 這是多麼高尚的精神！ Zhè shì duōme gāoshàng de jīngshén. What a noble spirit! 3 to an unspecified extent 不管天多麼冷, 他都堅持戶外鍛煉。 Bùguǎn tiān duōme lěng, tā dōu jiānchí hùwài duànliàn. However cold, he never stopped exercising outdoors.

pronoun so; such; like this; this way 一會兒這樣, 一會兒那樣 Yīhuìr zhèyàng, yīhuìr nàyàng now one way, now another 別走這樣快。 Bié zǒu zhèyàng kuài. Don’t walk so fast. 竟有這樣的事？ Jìng yǒu zhèyàng de shì? How could such a thing happen? or Is this possible? 情況就是這樣。 Qíngkuàng jiù shì zhèyàng. That’s how it is. or That’s the situation. 他怎麼病成這樣了？ Tā zěnme bìng chéng zhèyàng le？ How did he get so ill? or How did he get into such a state? 這樣的文學作品很受群眾歡迎。 Zhèyàng de wénxué zuòpǐn hěn shòu qúnzhòng huānyíng. Literary works of this kind are very popular. 如果你們覺得可以這樣辦, 那就這樣辦吧。 Rúguǒ nǐmen juéde kěyǐ zhèyàng bàn, nàjiù zhèyàng bàn ba. If you people feel this is the right thing to do, then do it.

pronoun of that kind; like that; such; so 那樣兒也好, 先試試再說。 Nàyàngr yěhǎo, xiān shìshi zàishuō. All right, let’s try it out. 別這樣那樣的了, 你還是親自去一趟的好。 Bié zhèyàng nàyàng de le, nǐ háishi qīnzì qù yī tàng de hǎo. No more shilly-shallying, you had better go yourself. 他不像你那樣仔細。 Tā bù xiàng nǐ nàyàng zǐxì. He’s not careful as you. 這點兒小事你怎麼就急得那樣兒了。 Zhèdiǎnr xiǎoshì nǐ zěnme jiù jí de nàyàng r le. Why let such trifles worry you so?

noun 1 class; grade; rank 分為三等 fēnwéi sān děng classify into three grades 2 kind; sort 此等人 cǐ děng rén this kind of person 這等事 zhè děng shì this sort of thing verb wait; await 等車 děng chē wait for a train, bus, etc. 等上級批准 děng shàngjí pīzhǔn await approval by the higher authorities 請等一下。 Qǐng děng yīxià. Would you mind waiting a minute, please. or Please wait a minute. adjective equal; equivalent 相等 xiāngděng equal preposition when; till 等我做完再走。 Děng wǒ zuò wán zài zǒu. Stay till I'm through. auxiliary 1 literary [after a personal pronoun or name to show plurality] 彼等 bǐděng they 我等 wǒděng we 該犯等 gāi fàn děng the aforesaid criminals 2 and so on; and so forth; etc. 購置書籍, 紙張文具等 gòuzhì shūjí, zhǐzhāng wénjù děng buy books, stationery and so on 赴瀋陽, 鞍山等地視察 fù Shěnyáng, ān shān děng de shìchá go to Shenyang, Anshan and other places on a tour of inspection 3 [indicating the end of an enumeration] 長江, 黃河, 黑龍江, 珠江等四大河流 Cháng Jiāng, Huáng Hé, Hēilóng Jiāng, Zhū Jiāng děng sìdà héliú the four large rivers—the Chang Jiang, the Huang He, the Heilong Jiang and the Zhu Jiang

verb 1 taste; try the flavour of 來嘗嘗。 Lái chángcháng. Have a taste. 2 experience 嘗到甜頭 chángdào tiántou become aware of the benefits of; come to know the good of; experience the advantage of adverb literary ever; once 早年嘗習英文 Zǎonián cháng xí Yīngwén learnt English in one’s early years 他未嘗認真想過這事。 tā wèi cháng rènzhēn xiǎng guò zhè shì. He hasn’t given it serious thought.

noun 1 outfit; clothing 滑雪裝 huáxuězhuāng ski suit 2 stage makeup and costume 卸裝 xièzhuāng remove stage makeup and costume verb 1 dress up; attire; deck; play the part (or role) of; act 她裝老大娘真像。 Tā zhuāng lǎodàniáng zhēn xiàng. She acted an old woman and really looked the part. 2 pretend; feign; make believe 裝出一副可憐相 Zhuāng chū yī fù kěliánxiàng assume a pitiful look 不要不懂裝懂。 Bùyào bùdǒngzhuāngdǒng. Don’t pretend to know when you don’t. 她不是真哭, 是裝的。 Tā bù shì zhēn kū, shì zhuāng de. She wasn’t really crying, just pretending. verb 1 load; pack; hold 裝桶 zhuāng tǒng fill the cask (or barrel) 裝箱 zhuāngxiāng pack a box; put in a crate; crate 裝煙袋 zhuāng yāndài fill one’s pipe 這書包裝不下這麼多東西。 Zhè shūbāo zhuāng bù xià zhème duō dōngxi. This satchel can’t hold so much. 2 install; fit; assemble 裝個無線電 zhuāng ge wúxiàndiàn assemble a radio set 給門裝上鎖 Gěi mén zhuāng shàng suǒ fit a lock on the door 我們村家家戶戶都裝上了電燈。 Wǒmen cūn jiājiāhùhù dōu zhuāng shàng le diàndēng. Electric lights have been installed in every house in our village. or Every house in our village now has electric lights.
adverb need not 不用著急。 Bù yòng zháojí. You needn’t worry. or There is no need to worry.

conjunction [correlatively with 而且, 並且, 也 or 還] not only 他不但會講英語, 還會講法語。 Tā bùdàn huì jiǎng Yīngyǔ, hái huì jiǎng Fǎyǔ. He can speak both English and French. 我們的產品不但要求數量多, 而且要求質量好。 Wǒmen de chǎnpǐn bù dàn yāoqiú shùliàng duō, érqiě yāoqiú zhìliàng hǎo. We demand not only production quantity but also quality.

adverb need not; not have to 不必說 bù bì shuō needless to say; it goes without saying 不必擔心(驚慌) Bùbì dānxīn No need to worry (or panic). 不必客氣。 bùbì kèqi Don’t stand on ceremony. 你不必去了。 Nǐ bùbì qù le. You needn’t go.

preposition 1 except 除了老王, 我都通知到了。 Chúle lǎo wáng, wǒ dōu tōngzhī dào le. I’ve notified everyone except Lao Wang. 除了下雨, 我每天都堅持長跑。 Chúle xiàyǔ, wǒ měitiān dōu jiānchí chángpǎo. I practise long-distance running every day except on rainy days. 2 [correlatively with 還, 也, etc.] besides; in addition to 懂日語的, 除了我還有兩個人。 Dǒng Rìyǔ de, chúle wǒ háiyǒu liǎng ge rén. There are two others besides me who know some Japanese. 3 [correlatively with 就是] if not ... (then...); either ... (or...) 剛生下來的孩子, 除了吃就是睡。 Gāng shēng xiàlai de háizi, chúle chī jiù shì shuì. If a newborn baby isn’t eating, then it’s sleeping. 這幾天除了颳風, 就是下雨。 Zhè jǐ tiān chúle guāfēng, jiù shì xià yǔ. Recently we’ve been having either windy or rainy days.

adverb from the past till the present; always; at all times; all along 我從來沒有見過他。 Wǒ cónglái méiyǒu jiàn guò tā. I’ve never seen him before. 對我的工作他從來都是大力支持的。 Duì wǒ de gōngzuò tā cónglái dōu shì dàlì zhīchí de. He has always given full support to my work.

adjective general; rough; approximate 大概的估計 dàgài de gūjì a rough estimate 大概的數字 dàgài de shùzì an approximate figure 作一個大概的分析 Zuò yī ge dàgài de fēnxi make a general analysis adverb 1 generally; briefly 我大概跟他說了說。 Wǒ dàgài gēn tā shuō le shuō. I told him briefly. 2 probably; most likely; presumably 會議大概要延期。 Huìyì dàgài yào yánqī. The meeting will probably be postponed. 你大概知道他吧。 Nǐ dàgài zhīdao tā ba. Presumably you know him. 大概將有五百人出席。 Dàgài jiāng yǒu wǔbǎi rén chūxí. There will be approximately 500 people present. noun general idea; broad outline 我只知道個大概。 Wǒ zhǐ zhīdao ge dàgài. I have only a general idea.

adjective not bad; passable 不想還好, 一想就生氣。 Bù xiǎng hái hǎo, yī xiǎng jiù shēngqì. It’s all right if I don’t think about it, but whenever I do, I always get angry. 你今天感覺怎樣？——還好。 Nǐ jīntiān gǎnjué zěnyàng？ —— hái hǎo. How are you feeling today? —Not so bad. 你最近很忙吧？ ——還好。 Nǐ zuìjìn hěn máng ba？ —— hái hǎo. Are you very busy these days? —So so. adverb fortunately 還好, 電話總算打通了。 Hái hǎo, diànhuà zǒngsuàn dǎtōng le. I was fortunate enough to get through finally. 還好, 這場大水沒有把堤壩沖壞。 Hái hǎo, zhè cháng dà shuǐ méiyǒu bǎ dībà chōng huài. Fortunately, the flood did not break the dyke.

noun 1 utmost point; extremity 極而言之 jí'éryánzhī talk in extreme terms 愚蠢之極 yúchǔn zhī jí be at the height of folly 2 pole 極區 jíqū polar region verb literary do one's utmost 極一時之盛 jí yīshí zhī chéng reach a temporary magnificence adjective extreme; of the highest degree See 23446016極品ji2pin3極品 adverb extremely; to the greatest extent; exceedingly 極好 jí hǎo extremely good 極快 jí kuài extremely fast 極慢 jí màn extremely slow 極光滑 jí guānghuá dead smooth 極少數 jíshǎoshù tiny minority; only a few; a handful 極需要 jí xūyào badly in need (of ) 極重要 jí zhòngyào of the utmost importance 極少例外 jí shǎo lìwài with few exceptions 我最近忙極了。 Wǒ zuìjìn máng jíle. I’ve been extremely busy lately. 這件事極能說明問題。 Zhè jiàn shì jí néng shuōmíng wèntí. This incident is very illustrative (of the issue in question). 這樣操作機器極不安全。 Zhèyàng cāozuò jīqì jí bù ānquán. It’s absolutely unsafe if you operate the machine this way. 他對你的工作滿意極了。 Tā duì nǐ de gōngzuò mǎnyì jíle. He’s thoroughly satisfied with your work.

common phrase colloquial 1 no end of trouble; desperately serious 哎呀, 不得了(了), 著火了！ Āiyā, bùdéliǎo, zháohuǒ le! Oh dear, how awful! Fire! Fire! 沒有什麼不得了的事。 Méiyǒu shénme bùdéliǎo de shì. It’s not really serious. 讓人口這樣增長下去, 那可不得了。 Ràng rénkǒu zhèyàng zēngzhǎng xiàqu, nà kě bùdéliǎo. If the population is allowed to grow like this, things will be very serious. 要是這樣做, 那可不得了。 Yào shì zhèyàng zuò, nà kě bùdéliǎo. If you do this, there’ll be no end of trouble. 2 [after 得 as a complement] extremely; exceedingly 壞得不得了 huài de bùdéliǎo very bad; couldn’t be worse 高興得不得了 Gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo extremely happy; wild with joy 後悔得不得了 hòuhuǐ de bùdéliǎo regret very much; overcome with remorse 頭疼得不得了 Tóuténg de bùdéliǎo have a splitting headache 熱得不得了。 rè de bùdéliǎo. It’s awfully hot.

verb take no care of; not look after 他整天忙, 從來不管孩子。 Tā zhěngtiān máng, cónglái bùguǎn háizi. He is always busy and never has time to care for his child. 他對公司裡的事不管不顧。 Tā duì gōngsī lǐ de shì bùguǎn bù gù. He has no interest in what’s going on in the company. conjunction regardless of; no matter (what, who, etc.) 不管多大的困難, 我們都能克服。 bùguǎn duō dà de kùnnan, wǒmen dōu néng kèfú. We can overcome any difficulty, however great. 不管他來不來, 我們(都)得走了。 bùguǎn tā lái bù lái, wǒmen děi zǒu le. Regardless of whether he comes or not, we’ve got to leave. 不管怎樣我不想去。 Bùguǎnzěnyàng wǒ bù xiǎng qù. In any case I don’t want to go.
verb wait a minute

pronoun 1 all; every 抓住一切機會 Zhuāzhù yīqiè jīhuì seize every opportunity 一切儘在不言中。 yīqiè jǐn zài bù yán zhōng. All is understood, and no word is necessary. 一切行動聽指揮。 Yīqiè xíngdòng tīng zhǐhuī. Obey orders in all your actions. 2 everything; all 一切向錢看 yīqiè xiàng “qián” kàn put money above all else; money-oriented 把一切獻給祖國 bǎ yīqiè xiàngěi zǔguó give one’s all to one’s country 這裡一切都好, 請放心。 Zhèlǐ yīqiè dōu hǎo, qǐng fàngxīn. Don’t worry. Everything here is OK.

verb literary stop; cease; end 爭論不已 zhēnglùn bùyǐ argue endlessly; be bogged down in endless argument adverb 1 already (opp. 未) 已成定局 yǐchéngdìngjú be a foregone conclusion 已付賬款 yǐ fùzhàng kuǎn account paid 為時已晚。 Wéishí yǐ wǎn. It’s too late. 問題已解決。 Wèntí yǐ jiějué. The problem has already been solved. 雨季已過。 Yǔjì yǐ guò. The rainy season is over. 2 literary too 觀者已眾 guān zhě yǐ zhòng too many spectators 3 literary thereafter; afterwards See 34538496已而yi3er2已而

verb 1 colloquial catch 給你一個蘋果, 接著！ Gěi nǐ yī ge píngguǒ, jiēzhe! Here’s an apple for you. Catch! 2 follow; carry on 一個接著一個 Yī ge jiēzhe yī ge one after another 接著幹吧。 Jiēzhe gàn ba. Carry on with your work. 你說完了, 我接著說幾句。 Nǐ shuō wán le, wǒ jiēzhe shuō jǐ jù. Let me add a few words when you finish. 我接著剛纔的講下去。 Wǒ jiēzhe gāngcái de jiǎng xiàqu. Let me continue from where I left off a moment ago. adverb after that; and then 接著我們又討論了明年的計劃。 Jiēzhe wǒmen yòu tǎolùn le míngnián de jìhuà. Next (or Then, After that), we discussed plans for the following year.
verb bear fruit; fructify 這棵樹去年結了好多果兒。 Zhè kē shù qùnián jiē le hǎoduō guǒr. This tree bore a lot of fruit last year.

adverb immediately; at once; right away; in the turn of a hand 立刻去 lìkè qù go right away 立刻回答 lìkè huídá answer (a question) immediately; make an instant reply 鈴聲一響, 教室裡立刻安靜下來。 Língshēng yī xiǎng, jiàoshì lǐ lìkè ānjìng xiàlai. As soon as the bell rang, the classroom quietened down at once.
didn't expect

adverb actually; in fact; as a matter of fact 其實情況不是那樣。 Qíshí qíngkuàng bù shì nàyàng. Actually, that is not the case. 還要討論？其實沒有這個必要。 Hái yào tǎolùn？ Qíshí méiyǒu zhège bìyào. Why have another discussion? I don’t think there’s any need for it. 何必大家掏錢？其實讓我做東得了。 Hébì dàjiā tāoqián？ Qíshí ràng wǒ zuòdōng déliǎo. Why go Dutch? Let me play the host. 這臺機器看起來復雜, 其實不難掌握。 Zhè tái jīqì kàn qǐlai fùzá, qíshí bù nán zhǎngwò. This machine looks complicated, but it’s really not difficult to operate. 你們只知道她會說英語, 其實她的日語也挺好。 Nǐmen zhǐ zhīdao tā huì shuō Yīngyǔ, qíshí tā de Rìyǔ yě tǐng hǎo. You only know that she speaks English. As a matter of fact, her Japanese is pretty good too.

adverb especially; particularly 講話的第一部分尤其重要。 Jiǎnghuà de dì-yī bùfen yóuqí zhòngyào. The first part of the speech is particularly important. 多喝酒對身體不好, 尤其影響心臟。 Duō hē jiǔ duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, yóuqí yǐngxiǎng xīnzàng. Heavy drinking is harmful to health, especially to the heart.

verb 1 get over; jump over 越牆而逃 Yuè qiáng ér táo escape by climbing over the wall 2 exceed; overstep 越出範圍 yuè chū fànwéi overstep the bounds; exceed the limits 越出政策界限 yuè chū zhèngcè jièxiàn go beyond the bounds of policy 3 pass; go through See 35486720越冬yue4dong1越冬 4 (of one's voice or emotion) be at a high pitch 激越 jīyuè be excited 清越 qīngyuè clear and far-reaching 5 literary plunder; pillage; loot 殺人越貨 shārényuèhuò rob and kill adjective superior 優越 yōuyuè superior adverb [in 越…越…] the more… the more… 越幫越忙 yuèbāngyuèmáng futile help 越多越好 yuè duō yuè hǎo the more the better 越不見越想。 yuè bùjiàn yuè xiǎng. Absence makes the heart grow fonder. noun 1 one of the Warring States into which China was divided during the Eastern Zhou period (770-256 BC), comprising parts of modern Zhejiang and Jiangsu provinces 2 name for eastern Zhejiang Province 3 abbreviation Vietnam 越戰 Yuèzhàn Vietnam War

verb 1 put in order; rectify 整一下領帶 zhěng yīxià lǐngdài adjust one’s tie 2 repair; mend; renovate 整舊如新 zhěngjiùrúxīn repair sth. old and make it as good as new; renovate 3 make sb. suffer; punish; fix 挨整 áizhěng get punished; made to pay 4 dialect do; make; work 這東西我看見人整過, 並不難。 Zhè dōngxi wǒ kànjian rén zhěng guò, bìng bù nán. I once saw somebody do it and it’s not very difficult. 繩子給整斷了。 Shéngzi gěi zhěng duàn le. The rope has broken. adjective 1 whole; complete; full; entire (opp. 零) 整夜 zhěngyè whole night; all night long 整磚 zhěng zhuān whole (or unbroken) brick 一整頁 Yī zhěng yè a full page 十二點整 shí'èr diǎn zhěng twelve o’clock sharp 恰好整一年。 Qiàhǎo zhěng yī nián. It’s a year to the day. 2 in good order; neat; tidy 整然有序 zhěng rán yǒuxù in good order; well arranged 衣冠不整 yīguānbùzhěng slovenly in dress; not properly dressed 儀容不整 Yíróng bù zhěng untidy appearance

verb 1 rectify; straighten; set right 把領帶正一正 bǎ lǐngdài zhèng yī zhèng straighten one’s tie 把帽子正一正 bǎ màozi zhèng yī zhèng put one’s cap straight 2 make right; correct See 36094208正音zheng4yin1正音 3 rectify; correct one's thinking 正人先正己 zhèngrén xiān zhèngjǐ correct your own faults before you try to correct those of others; sweep before your own door adjective 1 situated in the middle; main (opp. 側, 偏) See 36081664正門zheng4men2正門 2 obverse; right (opp. 反) 布的這一面是正的嗎？ Bù de zhè yī miàn shì zhèng de ma？ Is this the right side of the fabric? 這件夾克正穿反穿都可以。 Zhè jiàn jiākè zhèng chuān fǎnchuān dōu kěyǐ. This is a reversible jacket. or This jacket can be worn on both sides. 3 honest; upright 他作風不正。 Tā zuòfēng bù zhèng. He behaves with impropriety. or He does not act decently. 4 correct; right 路子走得正 Lùzi zǒu de zhèng follow a correct path 5 (of colour, flavour, etc.) pure; right 正黃 zhèng huáng pure yellow 味兒不正 wèir bù zhèng not the right flavour; taste off 6 regular; standard See 36079872正楷zheng4kai3正楷 7 principal; chief (opp. 副) 正副主任 zhèng-fù zhǔrèn director and deputy director 正駕駛員 zhèng jiàshǐyuán first pilot 8 (of figures, designs, etc.) regular 正八邊形 zhèngbābiānxíng regular octagon 正多面體 zhèng duōmiàntǐ regular polyhedron 9 mathematics positive; plus (opp. 負) 10 physics positive; plus (opp. 負) 正晶體 zhèng jīngtǐ positive crystal 正離子 zhènglízǐ positive ion; cation adverb 1 straight; upright 正前方 zhèngqiánfāng straight ahead 正東 zhèngdōng due east 正南 zhèngnán due south 正西 zhèngxī due west 正北 zhèngběi due north 把柱子扶正 bǎ zhùzi fú zhèng set the post upright 這幅畫掛得不正。 Zhè fú huà guà de bù zhèng. This picture is crooked. 2 punctual; sharp 九點正 Jiǔ diǎn zhèng at nine o’clock sharp 3 just; right; precisely; exactly 正如上文所述 zhèng rú shàngwén suǒ shù just as mentioned above 大小正合適 dàxiǎo zhèng héshì just the right size; fit perfectly 到劇場正趕上開演。 Dào jùchǎng zhèng gǎnshàng kāiyǎn. I got to the theater just as the performance was starting. 那人正是張先生。 Nà rén zhèng shì zhāng xiānsheng. It was Mr. Zhang himself. 我正要談這個問題。 Wǒ zhèng yào tán zhège wèntí. I’m just coming to that point. 這正是我想要的。 Zhè zhèngshì wǒ xiǎng yào de. This is exactly what I want. 正是這些人創造了如此偉大的奇跡。 Zhèngshì zhèxiē rén chuàngzào le rúcǐ wěidà de qíjì. They are the ones who worked such wonders. 4 just (doing sth.); just now 正下著雨呢。 Zhèng xià zhe yǔ ne. It’s raining. 他正吃著飯呢。 Tā zhèng chī zhe fàn ne. He’s eating just now.

conjunction [usu. with 就 or 便] if only; as long as; provided 只要你有錢就辦得到。 Zhǐyào nǐ yǒu qián jiù bàn de dào. You can do it if you have the money. 只要你在這兒, 我就放心了。 Zhǐyào nǐ zài zhèr, wǒ jiù fàngxīn le. As long as you’re here, I’m not worried. 只要虛心, 就會進步。 Zhǐ yào xūxīn, jiù huì jìnbù. If you are modest, you are sure to make progress.

noun among them; of them; in it 樂在其中 lèzàiqízhōng find pleasure in it 我們車間有五百人, 其中婦女占百分之六十。 Wǒmen chējiān yǒu wǔbǎi rén, qízhōng fùnǚ zhàn bǎifēn zhī liùshí. There are 500 workers in our shop, and 60 per cent of them are women. 飯疏食, 飲水, 曲肱而枕之, 樂亦在其中矣。(《論語》) Fàn shū shí, yǐnshuǐ, qū gōng ér zhěn zhī, lè yì zài qízhōng yǐ. (《Lúnyǔ》) It is in eating coarse rice and drinking water, and using one’s elbow for a pillow, that joy is to be found.

adjective complete; whole 他話沒說完全。 Tā huà méi shuō wánquán. He didn’t give a full picture. adverb completely; fully; wholly; entirely; absolutely 完全不同 wánquán bùtóng totally different; have nothing in common 完全錯了 Wánquán cuò le completely wrong 完全相反 wánquán xiāngfǎn exactly the opposite 完全正確 wánquán zhèngquè perfectly right; absolutely correct 完全有資格 wánquán yǒu zīgé fully qualified (or eligible) 完全徹底為人民服務 wánquán chèdǐ wèi rénmín fúwù serve the people heart and soul 他完全同意我們的意見。 Tā wánquán tóngyì wǒmen de yìjian. He fully agrees with us. 她完全不考慮個人得失。 Tā wánquán bù kǎolǜ gèrén dé-shī. She gives no thought to personal gain or loss.

verb match; balance; correspond to; about equal to; commensurate with 得失相當。 Dé-shī xiāngdāng. The gains balance the losses. 兩隊實力相當。 Liǎng duì shílì xiāngdāng. The two teams are about equal in strength. 他們倆年齡相當。 Tāmen liǎ niánlíng xiāngdāng. They are well-matched in age. or They’re about the same age. 你的月薪相當(於)我的兩倍。 nǐ de yuèxīn xiāngdāng wǒ de liǎng bèi. Your salary is twice mine. 這筆錢大概相當(於)我三個月的開銷。 Zhè bǐ qián dàgài xiāngdāng wǒ sān ge yuè de kāixiao. This amount is about what I spend in three months. 水壩高達七十八米, 相當於二十層的大樓。 Shuǐbà gāo dá qīshíbā mǐ, xiāngdāngyú èrshí céng de dàlóu. The dam is 78 metres high, as tall as a 20-storey building. adjective suitable; fit; appropriate 他一時想不出相當的字眼來。 Tā yīshí xiǎng bù chū xiāngdāng de zìyǎn lái. At the time he couldn’t think of a suitable word for it. 這個工作還沒有找到相當的人。 Zhège gōngzuò hái méiyǒu zhǎodào xiāngdāng de rén. We haven’t found a good person for the job yet. adverb quite; considerably 相當好 Xiāngdāng hǎo quite good 演出相當成功。 Yǎnchū xiāngdāng chénggōng. The performance was a total success.

adverb 1 no more; no less; just right; exactly 你們來得剛好。 Nǐmen lái de gānghǎo. You’ve come in the nick of time. 我們剛好趕上末班車。 Wǒmen gānghǎo gǎnshàng mòbānchē. We just managed to catch the last bus. 我體重剛好五十公斤。 Wǒ tǐzhòng gānghǎo wǔshí gōngjīn. I weigh just 50 kilograms, no more, no less. 這件上衣你穿著不大不小, 剛好。 Zhè jiàn shàngyī nǐ chuānzhe bùdàbùxiǎo, gānghǎo. This jacket fits you beautifully. 2 by chance; by coincidence 他剛好在這兒。 Tā gānghǎo zài zhèr. He happens to be here.

adverb perhaps; maybe 快點走, 或者還趕得上他。 Kuài diǎn zǒu, huòzhě hái gǎndeshàng tā. Hurry up, we may catch up with him yet. 這個建議對於改進工作或者有點兒好處。 zhège jiànyì duìyú gǎijìn gōngzuò huòzhě yǒudiǎnr hǎochu. This suggestion may help to improve our work. conjunction 1 or; either... or... 請你把這本書交給小王或者小李。 Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè běn shū jiāo gěi xiǎo wáng huòzhě xiǎo lǐ. Please give this book to either Xiao Wang or Xiao Li. 2 no matter what, how, etc. 不論大事或者小事, 大家都願意找他商量。 Bùlùn dàshì huòzhě xiǎoshì, dàjiā dōu yuànyi zhǎo tā shāngliang. Everybody likes to consult with him about their problems, large or small.

adjective best; first-rate (opp. 最壞) 最好的辦法 zuì hǎo de bànfǎ the best way 最好的幹部 zuì hǎo de gànbù first-rate cadres; best cadres 質量最好 zhìliàng zuì hǎo best in quality; highest quality adverb had better; it would be best 你最好今天把它搞完。 Nǐ zuì hǎo jīntiān bǎ tā gǎo wán. It would be best if you finished it today. 我們最好在天黑以前趕到目的地。 Wǒmen zuì hǎo zài tiān hēi yǐqián gǎndào mùdìdì. It would be best if we reached our destination before dark.

adjective same; equal; similar 同樣懂得 tóngyàng dǒngde know equally well 同樣的方法 Tóngyàng de fāngfǎ the same method 同樣情況下 tóngyàng qíngkuàng xià under similar circumstances 他說英語和法語同樣流利。 Tā shuō Yīngyǔ hé Fǎyǔ tóngyàng liúlì. He speaks English and French with equal fluency. or He is equally fluent in both English and French. 對中國古代的文化, 我們要吸收其中有益的東西, 同樣, 對外國的也應如此。 Duì Zhōngguó gǔdài de wénhuà, wǒmen yào xīshōu qízhōng yǒuyì de dōngxi, tóngyàng, duì wàiguó de yě yīng rúcǐ. We should assimilate the good things in ancient Chinese culture, as well as in foreign cultures.

adjective empty; hollow; void; unoccupied; vacant 空箱子 kōng xiāngzi empty box 把抽屜騰空 bǎ chōuti téngkōng empty out a drawer 書已銷售一空。 Shū yǐ xiāoshòu yīkōng. All the books have been sold out. noun sky; air 晴空 qíngkōng clear (or cloudless) sky adverb for nothing; in vain 空忙 kōngmáng make fruitless efforts 空喊口號 kōnghǎn kǒuhào chant empty slogans 空跑一趟 kōngpǎo yī tàng make a journey for nothing; make a wasted trip 說了半天是空歡喜一陣。 Shuō le bàntiān shì kōng huānxǐ yīzhèn. We spoke too soon, only to have our hopes dashed to pieces.

adjective empty; hollow; void; unoccupied; vacant 空箱子 kōng xiāngzi empty box 把抽屜騰空 bǎ chōuti téngkōng empty out a drawer 書已銷售一空。 Shū yǐ xiāoshòu yīkōng. All the books have been sold out. noun sky; air 晴空 qíngkōng clear (or cloudless) sky adverb for nothing; in vain 空忙 kōngmáng make fruitless efforts 空喊口號 kōnghǎn kǒuhào chant empty slogans 空跑一趟 kōngpǎo yī tàng make a journey for nothing; make a wasted trip 說了半天是空歡喜一陣。 Shuō le bàntiān shì kōng huānxǐ yīzhèn. We spoke too soon, only to have our hopes dashed to pieces.

noun 1 military company 一個營有三個連。 yī ge yíng yǒu sān ge lián. A battalion has three companies. 2 (Lián) a surname verb 1 link; join; connect 把兩條電線連起來 bǎ liǎng tiáo diànxiàn lián qǐlai connect two electric wires 把零散的土地連成一片 Bǎ língsǎn de tǔdì liánchéng yī piàn join together scattered pieces of land 天連水, 水連天。 Tiān lián shuǐ, shuǐ liántiān. The sky and the water seem to merge. 這兩句話連不起來。 Zhè liǎng jù huà lián bù qǐlai. The two sentences are disconnected (or don’t hang together). 2 involve (in trouble); implicate 那件事把他也連上了。 nà jiàn shì bǎ tā yě lián shàng le. He was involved in that too. adverb continuously; in succession; one after another 連挫強手 lián cuò qiángshǒu defeat strong opponents one after another 連發三條短信 Liánfā sān tiáo duǎnxìn send three short messages in succession preposition 1 including 連你一共十個人。 Lián nǐ yī gòng shí ge rén. There are ten people, including you. 2 [used correlatively with 也,都, etc.] even 連我都知道。 Lián wǒ dōu zhīdao. Even I know. 他連報也看不懂。 Tā lián bào yě kàn bù dǒng. He can’t even read a newspaper. 他連看都沒看。 Tā lián kàn dōu méi kàn. He didn’t even look. 她緊張得連他姓什麼也沒問。 tā jǐnzhāng de lián tā xìng shénme yě méi wèn. She was so nervous that she didn’t even ask for his name.
auxiliary [used in place of 啊 after a word ending in u or ao] 你怎麼還不走哇？ Nǐ zěnme hái bù zǒu wa？ Why haven’t you left yet, eh? 你好哇？ Nǐ hǎo wa？ Well, how are you?
noun necessaries; needs 軍需 jūnxū military supplies verb need; want; require 需款甚巨 xū kuǎn shèn jù require a big sum of money 所需物品 suǒ xū wùpǐn goods in great need
verb [as aux.] must; have to 我們須作出很大努力。 Wǒmen xū zuò chū hěn dà nǔlì. We’ll have to make a great effort. verb literary wait; await 須我片刻。 Xū wǒ piànkè. Wait a moment for me.

adjective direct; immediate (opp. 間接) 直接會晤 zhíjiē huìwù meet in person 直接交涉 zhíjiē jiāoshè negotiate directly with; talk things over face to face with 直接原因 zhíjiē yuányīn immediate (or direct) cause 由公司直接經營 yóu gōngsī zhíjiē jīngyíng run directly by the company

verb assemble; put together; sum up 縂起來說 zǒngqǐlai shuō to sum up 把兩筆賬縂到一塊算 bǎ liǎng bǐ zhàng zǒng dào yīkuài suàn settle the two accounts together adjective 1 general; overall; total 縂產量 zǒngchǎnliàng total output 縂根源 zǒnggēnyuán root cause 縂趨勢 zǒngqūshì general trend 縂市值 zǒng shìzhí market capitalization 縂收入 zǒngshōurù gross; total income (or revenue) 縂的說(來) zǒng de shuōlái generally speaking; by and large 2 chief; head; general 縂頭目 zǒng tóumù chief; boss; chieftain adverb 1 always; invariably 我不是縂在這兒。 Wǒ bù shì zǒng zài zhèr. I am not always here. 我一去那兒天縂下雨。 Wǒ yī qù nàr tiān zǒng xià yǔ. It invariably rains when I go there. 2 anyway; after all; eventually; sooner or later 你縂會成功的。 Nǐ zǒng huì chénggōng de. You’re bound to succeed. 問題縂(是)要解決的。 Wèntí zǒngshì yào jiějué de. The problem will be settled sooner or later. 他縂還是個孩子, 哪能像大人那樣有力氣？ Tā zǒng háishi ge háizi, nǎ néng xiàng dà rén nàyàng yǒu lìqi？ After all, he’s only a child so how can he be as strong as a grown-up? 3 surely; certainly; probably 她說的你縂不會相信吧？ Tā shuō de nǐ zǒng bù huì xiāngxìn ba？ You don’t believe what she said, surely? 他縂不大可能寫這樣一封信。 Tā zǒng bùdà kěnéng xiě zhèyàng yī fēng xìn. It’s most unlikely that he wrote such a letter. 明天他縂該回來了。 Míngtiān tā zǒng gāi huílai le. He certainly ought to be back tomorrow. 他縂有一千多塊錢吧。 tā zǒng yǒu yīqiān duō kuài qián ba. He is sure to have more than 1,000 yuan. noun courteous [short for 總編, 總裁, 總工程師, 總經理, etc. following a surname] editor-in-chief; president; chief engineer; director-general 王縂 wáng zǒng President Wang or Editor-in-Chief Wang

measure word times; -fold 大一倍 Dà yī bèi twice as big; twice the size 四倍 sì bèi four times; fourfold 增長了五倍 zēngzhǎng le wǔ bèi increase by 500%; register a 500% increase; be six times as much 產量成倍增長。 Chǎnliàng chéngbèi zēngzhǎng. Output has doubled and redoubled. 二的五倍是十。 Èr de wǔ bèi shì shí. Five times two is ten. 十是五的兩倍。 Shí shì wǔ de liǎng bèi. Ten is twice as much as five. 戰勝了兩倍於我的敵人。 Zhànshèng le liǎng bèi yú wǒ de dírén. We defeated an enemy outnumbering us two to one. adverb 1 even more; especially 倍感親切 bèi gǎn qīn qiè feel especially close; very warm 加倍努力 Jiābèi nǔlì with redoubled efforts 2 dialect [before certain adjectives] very; particularly 倍兒棒 Bèir bàng. awfully good 倍兒香 bèi r xiāng very delicious 倍兒聰明 Bèir cōngming terribly clever

verb include; consist of; comprise; incorporate 報價中不包括運費。 bàojià zhōng bù bāokuò yùnfèi. Carriage is not included in the quotation. 房租每月四百元, 水電費包括在內。 Fángzū měi yuè sìbǎi yuán, shuǐ-diànfèi bāokuò zàinèi. The rent is 400 yuan a month, including water and electricity. 他的報告包括三個方面。 Tā de bàogào bāokuò sān ge fāngmiàn. His report touched on three aspects. 我們的設計已經包括了你們的意見。 Wǒmen de shèjì yǐjing bāokuò le nǐmen de yìjian. Our design has incorporated your suggestions.

noun 1 step; pace 大步前進 Dà bù qiánjìn advance with big strides 走一步棋 zǒu yī bù qí make a move (in chess, etc.) 只有幾步路了。 Zhǐyǒu jǐ bù lù le. It’s only a few steps away. or It’s not far now. 2 stage; step 下一步怎麼辦？ Xià yī bù zěnme bàn？ What’s the next step (or move)? 這只好一步一步地去做。 Zhè zhǐ hǎo yī bù yī bù de qù zuò. This will have to be done step by step. 3 condition; situation; state 事情怎麼發展到這一步？ Shìqing zěnme fāzhǎn dào zhè yī bù？ How did things get to this state? verb 1 walk; go on foot 步入會場 bùrù huìchǎng walk into the assembly hall 2 literary tread See 18041344步人後塵bu4ren2hou4chen2步人後塵 3 dialect measure by paces; pace out 步一步這塊地夠不夠三畝。 Bù yī bù zhè kuài dì gòu bù gòu sān mǔ. Pace out this piece of land and see if it’s 3 mu in area. measure word bu (a traditional unit of length, equivalent to 5 chi) VARIANT OF 18050048埠bu4埠 bù noun 1 wharf; pier 2 dated port; port city 1 [usu. in place names] 鹽步 Yán bù Yanbu (in Guangdong Province)
noun that time 當時我並不知道。 Dāngshí wǒ bìng bù zhīdao. I didn’t know then.
preposition by the time; when

noun 1 bubble 冒泡兒 màopàor bubble; bubble up 肥皂泡兒 féizàopàor soap bubbles 2 sth. shaped like a bubble 手上起了泡 shǒushang qǐ le pào get (or raise) blisters on one’s palm verb 1 steep; soak 泡腳 pàojiǎo soak one’s feet in water 把種子放在溫水裡泡一下 bǎ zhǒngzi fàng zài wēnshuǐ lǐ pào yīxià steep the seeds in lukewarm water 2 pour boiling water into (tea, instant soup, etc.) 泡方便麵 pào fāngbiànmiàn make instant noodles 3 dawdle; dally; hang about 別泡時間了, 快把工作做完！ Bié pào shíjiān le, kuài bǎ gōngzuò zuò wán! Stop dawdling and finish your work! 4 colloquial (of a male) play the field; fool around with a female 想泡我妹妹, 做夢！ xiǎng pào wǒ mèimei, zuòmèng! How dare you dream of fooling around with my sister!

adverb 1 just; for the time being 且不說中文期刊, 外文期刊也訂了不少。 Qiěbù shuō Zhōngwén qīkān, wàiwén qīkān yě dìng le bùshǎo. Lots of periodicals in foreign languages have been subscribed to, not to mention those in Chinese. 你且等一下。 Nǐ qiě děng yīxià. Just wait a little while. 這事且放一下。 Zhè shì qiě fàng yīxià. Let the matter rest for the time being. 2 dialect for a long time 他且來不了呢。 Tā qiě láibuliǎo ne. He’s a long time coming. or It’ll be a while yet before he gets here. 這種鋼筆且使呢。 Zhèzhǒng gāngbǐ qiě shǐ ne. These fountain pens last a long time. conjunction literary 1 even 死且不懼, 況困難乎！ Sǐ qiě bù jù, kuàng kùnnan hū! Even death holds no fears for us, to say nothing of difficulties. 2 both...and... 既高且大 Jì gāo qiě dà both tall and heavy set; both high and wide 她工作既快且好。 Tā gōngzuò jì kuài qiě hǎo. She works quickly and well.

noun analogy; instance 打比方 Dǎ bǐfang draw an analogy 拿蓋房子作比方 ná gài fángzi zuò bǐfang take building a house for instance 這不過是個比方。 Zhè bùguò shì ge bǐfang. This is only an analogy. conjunction 1 if; suppose 聽說他待人熱情, 比方我求他幫個忙, 他不會拒絕吧？ tīngshuō tā dàirén rèqíng, bǐfang wǒ qiú tā bāng ge máng, tā bù huì jùjué ba? I hear he’s very warm-hearted, so I suppose he would help me if I asked him. 2 VARIANT OF 17463040比如bi3ru2比如 for example; for instance; such as
for example; for instance

verb 1 pass; pass on 此件請按名單順序向下傳。 Cǐ jiàn qǐng àn míngdān shùnxù xiàng xià chuán. Please pass on this document in the order of the name list. 2 hand down 這種藥方沒能傳下來。 Zhèzhǒng yàofāng méi néng chuán xiàlai. That herbal prescription has been lost to posterity. 這是古代傳下來的文化遺產。 Zhè shì gǔdài chuán xiàlai de wénhuà yíchǎn. This is a cultural heritage handed down from ancient times. 3 pass on (knowledge, skill, etc.); impart; teach 把技術傳給徒弟 bǎ jìshù chuán gěi túdi pass one’s skills on to one’s apprentices 4 spread 喜訊傳來, 歡聲雷動。 Xǐxùn chuánlái, huānshēng léidòng. The glad tidings gave rise to thunderous cheers. 消息很快傳開了。 Xiāoxi hěn kuài chuánkāi le. The news spread quickly. or The news soon got around. 這個秘密是他傳出去的。 Zhège mìmì shì tā chuánchū qù de. He’s the one who let out the secret. 5 transmit; conduct 傳熱 chuánrè transmit heat 銅傳電。 Tóng chuán diàn. Copper conducts electricity. 6 convey; express 難以言傳 nányǐ yán chuán hard to express in words 7 summon 傳證人 chuán zhèngrén summon a witness 8 infect; be contagious 小心別讓孩子們傳上流感。 xiǎoxīn bié ràng háizimenchuán shàngliú gǎn. Mind that the children don’t catch the flu. 9 send a document by email or fax 把一篇文章作附件傳給某人 bǎ yī piān wénzhāng zuò fùjiàn chuán gěi mǒurén send an article as an attachment to sb.

verb 1 be vexed; be irritated; be annoyed 你煩什麼？ Nǐ fán shénme？ What are you getting so annoyed about? 2 be tired of 這話我都聽煩了。 Zhè huà wǒ dōu tīng fán le. I'm fed up with this kind of talk. 3 courteous trouble (sb. to do sth.); bother 煩交某人 Fán jiāo mǒurén please forward this to so-and-so 煩您給她捎個信兒。 Fán nín gěi tā shāo ge xìnr. May I trouble you to pass on a message to her? 煩請貴公司盡速將貨樣寄來。 Fán qǐng guì gōngsī jìn sù jiāng huòyàng jì lái. Please mail us a sample of the merchandise as soon as possible. adjective 1 superfluous 要言不煩 yàoyánbùfán terse; succinct; pithy 2 redundant and confusing See 68844330煩雜fan2za2煩雜

adverb 1 in addition; besides 另有多少？ Lìng yǒu duōshao？ How many more are there? 2 in place of 另搞一套 lìng gǎo yī tào go one’s own way; do what suits oneself 另立戶頭 lìng lì hùtóu open another (or separate) bank account 另謀高就 lìngmóugāojiù find better employment elsewhere 另想辦法 lìng xiǎng bànfǎ find some other way 另有打算 Lìng yǒu dǎsuan have other plans 全文另發。 Quánwén lìng fā. The full text will be dispatched separately. pronoun [with nouns] different; other 另信寄上 lìng xìn jìshang send a separate letter 從一個極端跳到另一個極端 Cóng yī ge jíduān tiào dào lìng yī ge jíduān jump from one extreme to another 那是另一回事。 Nà shì lìng yī huí shì. That’s a different matter.

adverb 1 in addition; besides 另外有事 lìngwài yǒushì be otherwise occupied 另外買一份禮物 lìngwài mǎi yī fèn lǐwù buy another gift 2 in place of 我今天有事, 咱們另外再找時間談吧。 Wǒ jīntiān yǒu shì, zánmen lìngwài zài zhǎo shíjiān tán ba. I’ve got some things to attend to today. Shall we find another time to talk? pronoun [with nouns] different; other 另外兩個人我不認識。 Lìngwài liǎng ge rén wǒ bù rènshi. I don’t know the other two people. 我還要跟你談另外一件事情。 Wǒ hái yào gēn nǐ tán lìngwài yī jiàn shìqing. There’s another thing I want to talk over with you. conjunction in addition; besides 這篇文章我改動了幾處, 另外又補充了一小段。 Zhè piān wénzhāng wǒ gǎidòng le jǐ chù, lìngwài yòu bǔchōng le yī xiǎo duàn. I made a few changes in this article. I also supplemented it with one short paragraph.

noun 1 left and right sides 左右搖擺 zuǒ-yòu yáobǎi vacillating; unsteady; hesitant 主席臺左右, 紅旗迎風飄揚。 Zhǔxítái zuǒyòu, hóngqí yíngfēng piāoyáng. Red flags are fluttering on both sides of the rostrum. 2 [after a numeral] about; or so 八點鐘左右 bā diǎn zhōng zuǒyòu around eight o'clock 一個月左右 yī ge yuè zuǒyòu a month or so 身高一米七左右 Shēngāo yī mǐ qī zuǒyòu be about 1.70 metres in height 價值十元左右。 Jiàzhí shí yuán zuǒyòu. It's worth about 10 yuan. 3 those in close attendance; retinue 屏退左右 Píng tuì zuǒyòu order one's attendants to clear out verb master; control; influence 左右局勢 zuǒyòu júshì be master of the situation; in control 為人所左右 wéi rén suǒ zuǒyòu controlled by another; fall under another’s influence 他這個人不是別人能左右得了的。 Tā zhège rén bù shì biéren néng zuǒyòu déle de. He is not a man to be influenced by others. adverb dialect anyway; anyhow; in any case 左右閒沒事, 我就陪你走一趟吧。 Zuǒyòu xiánzhe méishì, wǒ jiù péi nǐ zǒu yī tàng ba. Ānyway I’m free now so let me go with you.

verb 1 work as; serve as; be 選他當組長 Xuǎn tā dāng zǔzhǎng elect him group leader 我長大要當飛行員。 Wǒ zhǎngdà yào dāng fēixíngyuán. I want to be a pilot when I grow up. 2 bear; accept; deserve 敢做敢當 gǎnzuògǎndāng dare to act and to take the consequences 我可當不起這樣的誇獎。 Wǒ kě dāng bù qǐ zhèyàng de kuājiǎng. I just don’t deserve such praise. 3 direct; manage; be in charge of See 19645696當家dang1jia1當家 4 [as aux.] ought to; should; must 能省的就省, 當用的還是得用。 Néng shěng de jiù shěng, dāng yòng de háishi dé yòng. Save what you can, but use what you must. 5 literary hold back; block See 31200768螳臂當車tang2bi4dang1che1螳臂當車 adjective equal See 26675200門當戶對men2dang1hu4dui4門當戶對 preposition 1 in sb.'s presence; to sb.'s face 咱當著大家談一談。 Zán dāng zhe dàjiā tán yī tán. Let’s speak out in the presence of everyone. 2 just at (a time or place) 當莫扎特四歲時, 就開始寫小步舞曲。 dāng mò zhā tè sì suìshí, jiù kāishǐ xiě xiǎobù wǔqǔ. When only four, Mozart was composing minuets. onomatopoeia sound of a gong or a bell 當當的鐘聲 Dāng dāng de zhōngshēng the tolling of a bell noun literary end 瓦當 wǎdāng eaves tile

noun 1 appearance; shape; look; form 這兩支筆樣兒差不多, 色兒不一樣。 Zhè liǎng zhī bǐ yàngr chàbuduō, sèr bù yīyàng. These two pens are alike except that they’re different colours. 2 manner; air; appearance 幾年沒見, 他還是那個樣兒。 Jǐ nián méi jiàn, tā háishi nà ge yàngr. It’s years since I last saw him, but he still looks the same. 3 sample; model; pattern 鞋樣 xiéyàng shoe pattern; outline of a shoe’s upper and sole 4 tendency; likelihood 看樣兒要下雨了。 kàn yàng r yào xiàyǔ le. It looks like rain. measure word kind; type 三樣點心 Sān yàng diǎnxin three kinds of pastries 商店雖小, 各樣貨物俱全。 Shāngdiàn suī xiǎo, gèyàng huòwù jùquán. Small as it is, the shop stocks all kinds of wares.

noun kind; type; class; category 兔類 tùlèi the rabbit species 各類蝴蝶 gèlèi húdié butterflies of various species 諸如此類 zhūrúcǐlèi things of that sort 這是另一類問題。 Zhè shì lìng yī lèi wèntí. This is a problem of another kind. verb resemble; be similar to 相類 xiānglèi resemble each other affix like; -oid (meaning “similar to, characteristic of”) See 25521664類人猿lei4ren2yuan2類人猿
